integrations.name: 1Password
integrations.description: Manage secrets and items in 1Password vaults
integrations.longDescription: Access and manage secrets stored in 1Password vaults using the Connect API or Service Account SDK. List vaults, retrieve items with their fields and secrets, download attached files, create new items, update existing ones, delete items, and resolve secret references.

operations.name: List Vaults
operations.description: List all vaults accessible by the Connect token or Service Account

operations.name: Get Vault
operations.description: Get details of a specific vault by ID

operations.name: List Items
operations.description: List items in a vault. Returns summaries without field values.

operations.name: Get Item
operations.description: Get full details of an item including all fields and secrets

operations.name: Get Item File
operations.description: Download the content of a file attached to an item

operations.name: Create Item
operations.description: Create a new item in a vault

operations.name: Replace Item
operations.description: Replace an entire item with new data (full update)

operations.name: Update Item
operations.description: Update an existing item using JSON Patch operations (RFC6902)

operations.name: Delete Item
operations.description: Delete an item from a vault

operations.name: Resolve Secret
operations.description: Resolve a secret reference (op://vault/item/field) to its value. Service Account mode only.

integrations.name: Affinity
integrations.description: Read and write companies, people, lists, notes, and relationships in Affinity
integrations.longDescription: Integrates the Affinity v2 API into the workflow. Read and search companies, people, and opportunities, page the rows of any list or saved view, read and write field values one at a time or a hundred at once, write and reply to notes, create reminders, follow logged calls, emails, meetings, and transcripts, find warm introductions through shared work and investment history, search notes and files by keyword, find companies from a description in plain language, and follow the field-value change feed for delta sync. What each operation can reach depends on the permissions granted to the API key.

operations.name: List Companies
operations.description: Page through companies. Companies come back without field data unless Field IDs or Field Types asks for it.

operations.name: Get Company
operations.description: Look up one company by ID. Field data is returned only for the Field IDs or Field Types asked for.

operations.name: Search Companies
operations.description: Search companies by filters, sorts, and a free-text term. Requires the "Export All Organizations directory" permission.

operations.name: List People
operations.description: Page through persons. Persons come back without field data unless Field IDs or Field Types asks for it.

operations.name: Get Person
operations.description: Look up one person by ID. Field data is returned only for the Field IDs or Field Types asked for.

operations.name: Search People
operations.description: Search persons by filters, sorts, and a free-text term. Requires the "Export All People directory" permission.

operations.name: List Opportunities
operations.description: Page through opportunities. Field data lives on the list entry, not here — read it through the list or saved view the opportunity belongs to.

operations.name: Get Opportunity
operations.description: Read one opportunity and the list it belongs to. Its field data lives on the list entry.

operations.name: List Notes On Entity
operations.description: List the notes relevant to one company, person, or opportunity — directly attached notes plus notes reaching it through its people and meetings.

operations.name: List Lists Holding Entity
operations.description: List every list a company or person appears on that the caller can view.

operations.name: List Rows Holding Entity
operations.description: Page through a company's or person's rows across every list, each carrying that list's field values and when the entity was added.

operations.name: List Entity Relationships
operations.description: List who knows a company or person, scored 0.0 to 1.0 by how much the two actually interact. Strongest first by default.

operations.name: List Field Metadata
operations.description: List the non-list company or person fields, with the value type, filter operators, and sort support of each. Start here to find the Field IDs the read and write tools take.

operations.name: List Field Dropdown Options
operations.description: List the selectable options on a dropdown or ranked-dropdown company or person field. Writing such a field needs the option ID, not its text.

operations.name: List Entity Field Values
operations.description: Page through a company's or person's non-list field values. List fields are not returned here — read those through the list entry.

operations.name: Get Entity Field Value
operations.description: Read one non-list field value from a company or person.

operations.name: Update Entity Field Value
operations.description: Write one non-list field value on a company or person. The value type must match how the field is defined.

operations.name: Batch Update Entity Fields
operations.description: Write up to 100 non-list field values on one company or person in a single request.

operations.name: List Lists
operations.description: Page through the lists in the organization that the caller can view.

operations.name: Create List
operations.description: Create a list. Its type fixes which entities it can hold, and the API key holder becomes its creator and owner.

operations.name: Get List
operations.description: Read one list — its name, type, owner, and privacy setting.

operations.name: List List Fields
operations.description: List the fields available on one list, including its list-specific columns. Use these Field IDs when reading or writing list entries.

operations.name: List List Field Dropdown Options
operations.description: List the selectable options on a dropdown, ranked-dropdown, or status-dropdown field of a list.

operations.name: Create List Field Dropdown Option
operations.description: Add a selectable option to a dropdown field on a list. A ranked or status option also needs a rank and a color.

operations.name: Get List Field Dropdown Option
operations.description: Read one dropdown option on a list field.

operations.name: Update List Field Dropdown Option
operations.description: Change a dropdown option on a list field. Every field is optional — supply only what should change, and only fields the option's kind actually has.

operations.name: Delete List Field Dropdown Option
operations.description: Permanently delete a dropdown option on a list field. Every list entry currently set to it is cleared, and those values cannot be recovered.

operations.name: List List Entries
operations.description: Page through the rows of a list. Rows come back without field data unless Field IDs or Field Types asks for it.

operations.name: Search List Entries
operations.description: Search the rows of one list by filters, sorts, and a free-text term. Requires the "Export data from Lists" permission.

operations.name: Get List Entry
operations.description: Read one row of a list with its entity. Field data is returned only for the Field IDs or Field Types asked for.

operations.name: List List Entry Fields
operations.description: Page through every field value on one list row, including the list-specific columns. All fields are returned unless narrowed.

operations.name: Get List Entry Field
operations.description: Read one field value on a list row.

operations.name: Update List Entry Field
operations.description: Write one field value on a list row. Requires the "Export data from Lists" permission.

operations.name: Batch Update List Entry Fields
operations.description: Write up to 100 field values on one list row in a single request. Requires the "Export data from Lists" permission.

operations.name: List List Entry Field Value Changes
operations.description: Page through the history of one list row — who changed which field, when, and to what.

operations.name: List Saved Views
operations.description: List the saved views on a list that the caller can view.

operations.name: Get Saved View
operations.description: Read one saved view — its name, kind, and creation date.

operations.name: List Saved View Entries
operations.description: Page through the rows of a saved view. The view's own filters and columns decide which rows and which field data come back.

operations.name: List Notes
operations.description: Page through every note the caller can see. Replies are excluded.

operations.name: Create Note
operations.description: Write a note — attached to companies, persons, and opportunities, anchored to a meeting, call, or chat message, or posted as a reply to an existing note.

operations.name: Search Notes
operations.description: Search notes by keyword, ordered by relevance. Narrow to specific notes or to one company, or leave both unset to search the whole account.

operations.name: Get Note
operations.description: Read one note with its body, author, mentions, and attached records.

operations.name: Update Note
operations.description: Rewrite a note's body or replace which records it is attached to. Each list of IDs replaces that association wholesale, an empty list clears it, and omitting one leaves it untouched. A note's type cannot be changed.

operations.name: Delete Note
operations.description: Delete a note you created. Deleting a root note also deletes its replies; deleting a reply removes only that reply.

operations.name: List Note Replies
operations.description: Page through the replies on one note, including AI Notetaker replies.

operations.name: List Note Attached Companies
operations.description: List the companies directly attached to one note.

operations.name: List Note Attached People
operations.description: List the persons directly attached to one note.

operations.name: List Note Attached Opportunities
operations.description: List the opportunities directly attached to one note.

operations.name: List Calls
operations.description: Page through logged calls and their participants. Only calls the API key holder can see are returned.

operations.name: List Chat Messages
operations.description: Page through logged chat messages and their participants. Only messages the API key holder can see are returned.

operations.name: List Emails
operations.description: Page through email metadata — subject, participants, and timestamps. Affinity never exposes email bodies through the API.

operations.name: List Meetings
operations.description: Page through past and upcoming meetings with their organizer and attendees.

operations.name: List Transcripts
operations.description: Page through meeting transcript metadata. Read one transcript to get what was actually said.

operations.name: Get Transcript
operations.description: Read one transcript with its first 100 fragments. Page the fragments endpoint for a longer meeting.

operations.name: List Transcript Fragments
operations.description: Page through everything said in a meeting, segment by segment with the speaker.

operations.name: List Reminders
operations.description: Page through the reminders the caller can see. Filter by status to surface what is overdue.

operations.name: Create Reminder
operations.description: Create a reminder on one company, person, or opportunity. A recurring reminder resets whenever the chosen signal happens instead of firing once.

operations.name: List Merges
operations.description: Page through the company or person merges the organization has run, with the status and the records involved in each.

operations.name: Create Merge
operations.description: Fold a duplicate company or person into the record you are keeping. The merge runs asynchronously — poll the returned task to see it finish. Requires the "Manage duplicates" permission and an admin role.

operations.name: Get Merge
operations.description: Read the status of one company or person merge, including why it failed if it did.

operations.name: List Merge Tasks
operations.description: Page through merge tasks, each summarizing how many of its merges are in progress, succeeded, or failed.

operations.name: Get Merge Task
operations.description: Read one merge task and how its merges are progressing. Poll this after starting a merge.

operations.name: Semantic Search
operations.description: Find companies from a description in plain language — industry, technology, stage, or business model. Currently searches companies only.

operations.name: Search Files
operations.description: Search files by keyword, ordered by relevance. Narrow to specific files or to one company, or leave both unset to search the whole account.

operations.name: List Coworker Connections
operations.description: Find warm paths into a company through shared work history: who in your Affinity data once worked alongside the people you want to reach. Grouped by target, strongest first.

operations.name: List Investor Executive Connections
operations.description: Find warm paths into a company through investment history: which investors in your Affinity data backed a company the people you want to reach once led. Grouped by target, strongest first.

operations.name: List Field Value Changes
operations.description: Page through field value changes across the whole workspace. Built for delta sync: follow nextCursor to the end of a run, then resume from the last cursor next time.

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: Page through the internal users in the organization. Email addresses and roles are returned only to callers with the "Manage Users" permission.

operations.name: Get User
operations.description: Read one internal user. A user and their person record share the same numeric ID, so a person ID works here.

operations.name: Get Current User
operations.description: Verify an Affinity API key and return the tenant, the user behind the key, and the scopes the grant carries.

integrations.name: AgentMail
integrations.description: Manage email inboxes, threads, and messages with AgentMail
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AgentMail into your workflow. Create and manage email inboxes, send and receive messages, reply to threads, manage drafts, and organize threads with labels. Requires API Key.

operations.name: Send Message
operations.description: Send an email message from an AgentMail inbox

operations.name: Reply to Message
operations.description: Reply to an existing email message in AgentMail

operations.name: Forward Message
operations.description: Forward an email message to new recipients in AgentMail

operations.name: List Threads
operations.description: List email threads in AgentMail

operations.name: Get Thread
operations.description: Get details of a specific email thread including messages in AgentMail

operations.name: Update Thread Labels
operations.description: Add or remove labels on an email thread in AgentMail

operations.name: Delete Thread
operations.description: Delete an email thread in AgentMail (moves to trash, or permanently deletes if already in trash)

operations.name: List Messages
operations.description: List messages in an inbox in AgentMail

operations.name: Get Message
operations.description: Get details of a specific email message in AgentMail

operations.name: Update Message Labels
operations.description: Add or remove labels on an email message in AgentMail

operations.name: Create Draft
operations.description: Create a new email draft in AgentMail

operations.name: List Drafts
operations.description: List email drafts in an inbox in AgentMail

operations.name: Get Draft
operations.description: Get details of a specific email draft in AgentMail

operations.name: Update Draft
operations.description: Update an existing email draft in AgentMail

operations.name: Delete Draft
operations.description: Delete an email draft in AgentMail

operations.name: Send Draft
operations.description: Send an existing email draft in AgentMail

operations.name: Create Inbox
operations.description: Create a new email inbox with AgentMail

operations.name: List Inboxes
operations.description: List all email inboxes in AgentMail

operations.name: Get Inbox
operations.description: Get details of a specific email inbox in AgentMail

operations.name: Update Inbox
operations.description: Update the display name of an email inbox in AgentMail

operations.name: Delete Inbox
operations.description: Delete an email inbox in AgentMail

integrations.name: AgentPhone
integrations.description: Provision numbers, send SMS and iMessage, and place voice calls with AgentPhone
integrations.longDescription: Give your workflow a phone. Provision SMS- and voice-enabled numbers, send messages and tapback reactions, place outbound voice calls, manage conversations and contacts, and track usage — all through a single AgentPhone API key.

operations.name: Create Number
operations.description: Provision a new SMS- and voice-enabled phone number

operations.name: List Numbers
operations.description: List all phone numbers provisioned for this AgentPhone account

operations.name: Release Number
operations.description: Release (delete) a phone number. This action is irreversible.

operations.name: Get Number Messages
operations.description: Fetch messages received on a specific phone number

operations.name: Create Call
operations.description: Initiate an outbound voice call from an AgentPhone agent

operations.name: List Calls
operations.description: List voice calls for this AgentPhone account

operations.name: Get Call
operations.description: Fetch a call and its full transcript

operations.name: Get Call Transcript
operations.description: Get the full ordered transcript for a call

operations.name: List Conversations
operations.description: List conversations (message threads) for this AgentPhone account

operations.name: Get Conversation
operations.description: Get a conversation along with its recent messages

operations.name: Update Conversation
operations.description: Update conversation metadata (stored state). Pass null to clear existing metadata.

operations.name: Get Conversation Messages
operations.description: Get paginated messages for a conversation

operations.name: Send Message
operations.description: Send an outbound SMS or iMessage from an AgentPhone agent

operations.name: React to Message
operations.description: Send an iMessage tapback reaction to a message (iMessage only)

operations.name: Create Contact
operations.description: Create a new contact in AgentPhone

operations.name: List Contacts
operations.description: List contacts for this AgentPhone account

operations.name: Get Contact
operations.description: Fetch a single contact by ID

operations.name: Update Contact
operations.description: Update a contact's fields

operations.name: Delete Contact
operations.description: Delete a contact by ID

operations.name: Get Usage
operations.description: Retrieve current usage statistics for the AgentPhone account

operations.name: Get Daily Usage
operations.description: Get a daily breakdown of usage (messages, calls, webhooks) for the last N days

operations.name: Get Monthly Usage
operations.description: Get monthly usage aggregation (messages, calls, webhooks) for the last N months

integrations.name: Agiloft
integrations.description: Manage records in Agiloft CLM
integrations.longDescription: Integrate with Agiloft contract lifecycle management to create, read, update, delete, and search records. Supports file attachments, SQL-based selection, saved searches, record locking, and running action buttons across any table in your knowledge base.

operations.name: List Tables & Fields
operations.description: List the tables and fields in an Agiloft knowledge base, to discover the logical names other operations need.

operations.name: Create Record
operations.description: Create a new record in an Agiloft table.

operations.name: Read Record
operations.description: Read a record by ID from an Agiloft table.

operations.name: Update Record
operations.description: Update an existing record in an Agiloft table.

operations.name: Upsert Record
operations.description: Create an Agiloft record, or update it when a record already matches the given fields.

operations.name: Delete Record
operations.description: Delete a record from an Agiloft table.

operations.name: Search Records
operations.description: Search for records in an Agiloft table using a query.

operations.name: Natural Language Search
operations.description: Search Agiloft records by describing what you want in plain language, such as "active NDAs submitted last month".

operations.name: Select Records
operations.description: Select record IDs matching a SQL WHERE clause from an Agiloft table.

operations.name: Attach File
operations.description: Attach a file to a field in an Agiloft record.

operations.name: Retrieve Attachment
operations.description: Download an attached file from an Agiloft record field.

operations.name: Remove Attachment
operations.description: Remove an attached file from a field in an Agiloft record.

operations.name: Attachment Info
operations.description: Get information about file attachments on a record field.

operations.name: Lock Record
operations.description: Lock, unlock, or check the lock status of an Agiloft record.

operations.name: Run Action Button
operations.description: Run an action button on an Agiloft record, such as an approval or send-for-signature step.

operations.name: Async Status
operations.description: Check whether an asynchronous Agiloft call, such as a run action button, has completed.

operations.name: Saved Search
operations.description: List the saved searches defined for an Agiloft table.

operations.name: Get Choice Line ID
operations.description: Resolve the internal numeric ID of a choice-list value, for use in EWSelect WHERE clauses against choice fields.

integrations.name: Ahrefs
integrations.description: SEO analysis with Ahrefs
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Ahrefs SEO tools into your workflow. Analyze domain ratings, backlinks, organic keywords, top pages, and more. Requires an Ahrefs Enterprise plan with API access.

operations.name: Domain Rating
operations.description: Get the Domain Rating (DR) and Ahrefs Rank for a target domain. Domain Rating shows the strength of a website's backlink profile on a scale from 0 to 100.

operations.name: Metrics Overview
operations.description: Get a one-call organic and paid search overview for a target domain or URL: organic traffic, organic keywords, paid traffic, paid keywords, and estimated traffic cost.

operations.name: Backlinks
operations.description: Get a list of backlinks pointing to a target domain or URL. Returns details about each backlink including source URL, anchor text, and domain rating.

operations.name: Backlinks Stats
operations.description: Get backlink and referring domain totals for a target domain or URL, both currently live and across all time.

operations.name: Referring Domains
operations.description: Get a list of domains that link to a target domain or URL. Returns unique referring domains with their domain rating, backlink counts, and discovery dates.

operations.name: Broken Backlinks
operations.description: Get a list of broken backlinks pointing to a target domain or URL. Useful for identifying link reclamation opportunities.

operations.name: Organic Keywords
operations.description: Get organic keywords that a target domain or URL ranks for in Google search results. Returns keyword details including search volume, ranking position, and estimated traffic.

operations.name: Organic Competitors
operations.description: Get domains that compete with a target domain or URL for the same organic keywords, ranked by keyword overlap.

operations.name: Top Pages
operations.description: Get the top pages of a target domain sorted by organic traffic. Returns page URLs with their traffic, keyword counts, and estimated traffic value.

operations.name: Paid Pages
operations.description: Get a target domain's pages that receive paid search traffic, sorted by estimated paid traffic. Returns page URLs with their paid traffic, keyword counts, and estimated spend.

operations.name: Anchors
operations.description: Get the anchor text distribution for a target domain or URL's backlinks, showing how many links and referring domains use each anchor text.

operations.name: Keyword Overview
operations.description: Get detailed metrics for a keyword including search volume, keyword difficulty, CPC, clicks, and traffic potential.

operations.name: Related Terms
operations.description: Get keyword ideas related to a seed keyword: terms the same top-ranking pages also rank for ("also rank for") or also discuss ("also talk about"), with volume, difficulty, and CPC.

operations.name: Domain Rating History
operations.description: Get the historical Domain Rating (DR) trend for a target domain or URL over a date range, grouped daily, weekly, or monthly.

operations.name: Metrics History
operations.description: Get the historical organic and paid traffic trend for a target domain or URL over a date range: organic traffic/cost and paid traffic/cost at each point in time.

operations.name: Referring Domains History
operations.description: Get the historical referring domains trend for a target domain or URL over a date range, grouped daily, weekly, or monthly.

operations.name: Keywords History
operations.description: Get the historical organic keyword ranking distribution for a target domain or URL over a date range: how many keywords rank in each position bucket at each point in time.

operations.name: Batch Analysis
operations.description: Get bulk SEO metrics (Domain Rating, backlinks, referring domains, organic traffic, and more) for multiple domains or URLs in a single request. Useful for comparing many competitors at once.

operations.name: Site Audit Page Explorer
operations.description: Get crawled pages from an Ahrefs Site Audit project with health and SEO metrics: HTTP status, title, link counts, backlinks, indexability, and traffic. Optionally filter to pages affected by a specific issue.

operations.name: Rank Tracker Overview
operations.description: Get ranking overview metrics for the keywords tracked in an Ahrefs Rank Tracker project: position, search volume, keyword difficulty, and estimated traffic. This endpoint is free and does not consume API units.

operations.name: Rank Tracker SERP Overview
operations.description: Get the full SERP (search engine results page) for a keyword tracked in an Ahrefs Rank Tracker project, including every ranking URL with its position, title, and authority metrics. This endpoint is free and does not consume API units.

operations.name: Rank Tracker Competitors Overview
operations.description: Get competitor rankings for the keywords tracked in an Ahrefs Rank Tracker project: each tracked keyword's volume and difficulty alongside every competitor's position, traffic, and traffic value. This endpoint is free and does not consume API units.

operations.name: Rank Tracker Competitors Stats
operations.description: Get aggregate competitor stats for an Ahrefs Rank Tracker project: each competitor's traffic, traffic value, average position, and share of voice across all tracked keywords. This endpoint is free and does not consume API units.

integrations.name: Airtable
integrations.description: Read, create, and update Airtable
integrations.longDescription: Integrates Airtable into the workflow. Can list bases, list tables (with schema), and create, get, list, update, upsert, or delete records. Can also be used in trigger mode to trigger a workflow when an update is made to an Airtable table.

operations.name: List Bases
operations.description: List all bases the authenticated user has access to

operations.name: List Tables
operations.description: List all tables and their schema in an Airtable base

operations.name: Get Base Schema
operations.description: Get the schema of all tables, fields, and views in an Airtable base

operations.name: List Records
operations.description: Read records from an Airtable table

operations.name: Get Record
operations.description: Retrieve a single record from an Airtable table by its ID

operations.name: Create Records
operations.description: Write new records to an Airtable table

operations.name: Update Record
operations.description: Update an existing record in an Airtable table by ID

operations.name: Update Multiple Records
operations.description: Update multiple existing records in an Airtable table

operations.name: Upsert Records
operations.description: Update existing records or create new ones in an Airtable table, matching on the specified merge fields

operations.name: Delete Records
operations.description: Delete one or more records from an Airtable table by ID

triggers.name: Airtable Webhook
triggers.description: Trigger workflow from Airtable record changes like create, update, and delete events (requires Airtable credentials)

integrations.name: Airweave
integrations.description: Search your synced data collections
integrations.longDescription: Search across your synced data sources using Airweave. Supports semantic search with hybrid, neural, or keyword retrieval strategies. Optionally generate AI-powered answers from search results.

integrations.name: Algolia
integrations.description: Search and manage Algolia indices
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Algolia into your workflow. Search indices, manage records (add, update, delete, browse), configure index settings, and perform batch operations.

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Search an Algolia index

operations.name: Add Record
operations.description: Add or replace a record in an Algolia index

operations.name: Get Record
operations.description: Get a record by objectID from an Algolia index

operations.name: Get Records
operations.description: Retrieve multiple records by objectID from one or more Algolia indices

operations.name: Partial Update Record
operations.description: Partially update a record in an Algolia index without replacing it entirely

operations.name: Delete Record
operations.description: Delete a record by objectID from an Algolia index

operations.name: Browse Records
operations.description: Browse and iterate over all records in an Algolia index using cursor pagination

operations.name: Batch Operations
operations.description: Perform batch add, update, partial update, or delete operations on records in an Algolia index

operations.name: List Indices
operations.description: List all indices in an Algolia application

operations.name: Get Settings
operations.description: Retrieve the settings of an Algolia index

operations.name: Update Settings
operations.description: Update the settings of an Algolia index

operations.name: Delete Index
operations.description: Delete an entire Algolia index and all its records

operations.name: Copy/Move Index
operations.description: Copy or move an Algolia index to a new destination

operations.name: Clear Records
operations.description: Clear all records from an Algolia index while keeping settings, synonyms, and rules

operations.name: Delete By Filter
operations.description: Delete all records matching a filter from an Algolia index

operations.name: Get Task Status
operations.description: Check whether an Algolia indexing task has finished publishing

integrations.name: Amazon DynamoDB
integrations.description: Get, put, query, scan, update, and delete items in Amazon DynamoDB tables
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Amazon DynamoDB into workflows. Supports Get, Put, Query, Scan, Update, Delete, and Introspect operations on DynamoDB tables.

operations.name: Get Item
operations.description: Get an item from a DynamoDB table by primary key

operations.name: Put Item
operations.description: Put an item into a DynamoDB table

operations.name: Query
operations.description: Query items from a DynamoDB table using key conditions

operations.name: Scan
operations.description: Scan all items in a DynamoDB table

operations.name: Update Item
operations.description: Update an item in a DynamoDB table

operations.name: Delete Item
operations.description: Delete an item from a DynamoDB table

operations.name: Introspect
operations.description: Introspect DynamoDB to list tables or get detailed schema information for a specific table

integrations.name: Amazon RDS
integrations.description: Connect to Amazon RDS via Data API
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Amazon RDS Aurora Serverless into the workflow using the Data API. Can query, insert, update, delete, and execute raw SQL without managing database connections.

operations.name: Query (SELECT)
operations.description: Execute a SELECT query on Amazon RDS using the Data API

operations.name: Insert Data
operations.description: Insert data into an Amazon RDS table using the Data API

operations.name: Update Data
operations.description: Update data in an Amazon RDS table using the Data API

operations.name: Delete Data
operations.description: Delete data from an Amazon RDS table using the Data API

operations.name: Execute Raw SQL
operations.description: Execute raw SQL on Amazon RDS using the Data API

operations.name: Introspect Schema
operations.description: Introspect Amazon RDS Aurora database schema to retrieve table structures, columns, and relationships

integrations.name: Amazon SQS
integrations.description: Connect to Amazon SQS
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Amazon SQS into the workflow. Send and receive messages one at a time or in batches of ten, delete messages, extend visibility timeouts, manage queues along with their attributes and tags, and redrive messages out of a dead-letter queue.

operations.name: Send Message
operations.description: Send a message to an Amazon SQS queue

operations.name: Send Message Batch
operations.description: Send up to 10 messages to an Amazon SQS queue in a single request

operations.name: Receive Message
operations.description: Receive up to 10 messages from an Amazon SQS queue, with optional long polling

operations.name: Delete Message
operations.description: Delete a received message from an Amazon SQS queue using its receipt handle

operations.name: Delete Message Batch
operations.description: Delete up to 10 received messages from an Amazon SQS queue in a single request

operations.name: Change Message Visibility
operations.description: Change how long a received Amazon SQS message stays hidden from other consumers

operations.name: Change Message Visibility Batch
operations.description: Change the visibility timeout of up to 10 received Amazon SQS messages at once

operations.name: List Queues
operations.description: List Amazon SQS queue URLs in a region, optionally filtered by name prefix

operations.name: Get Queue URL
operations.description: Resolve an Amazon SQS queue name to its queue URL

operations.name: Get Queue Attributes
operations.description: Read configuration and message-count attributes of an Amazon SQS queue

operations.name: Set Queue Attributes
operations.description: Update configuration attributes of an existing Amazon SQS queue

operations.name: Create Queue
operations.description: Create a standard or FIFO Amazon SQS queue

operations.name: Delete Queue
operations.description: Delete an Amazon SQS queue and every message still in it

operations.name: Purge Queue

integrations.longDescription: Provision and revoke temporary access to AWS accounts via IAM Identity Center (SSO). Assign permission sets to users or groups, look up users by email, and list accounts and permission sets for access request workflows.

operations.name: List Instances
operations.description: List all AWS IAM Identity Center instances in your account

operations.name: List Accounts
operations.description: List all AWS accounts in your organization

operations.name: Describe Account
operations.description: Retrieve details about a specific AWS account by its ID

operations.name: List Permission Sets
operations.description: List all permission sets defined in an IAM Identity Center instance

operations.name: Get User
operations.description: Look up a user in the Identity Store by email address

operations.name: Describe User
operations.description: Resolve an Identity Store user ID to the user behind it. Use to turn the principalId on an account assignment into a name and email.

operations.name: Get Group
operations.description: Look up a group in the Identity Store by display name

operations.name: Describe Group
operations.description: Resolve an Identity Store group ID to the group behind it. Use to turn the principalId on an account assignment into a group name.

operations.name: List Groups
operations.description: List all groups in the Identity Store

operations.name: List Group Memberships
operations.description: List the users who belong to an Identity Store group

operations.name: Create Account Assignment
operations.description: Grant a user or group access to an AWS account via a permission set (temporary elevated access)

operations.name: Delete Account Assignment
operations.description: Revoke a user or group access to an AWS account by removing a permission set assignment

operations.name: Check Assignment Status
operations.description: Check the provisioning status of an account assignment creation request

operations.name: Check Assignment Deletion Status
operations.description: Check the deprovisioning status of an account assignment deletion request

operations.name: List Account Assignments For Principal
operations.description: List every account and permission set a specific user or group is assigned. Use List Assignments For Account to go the other way, from an account to its principals.

operations.name: List Assignments For Account
operations.description: List every principal assigned a specific permission set on a specific AWS account. Use for per-account access reviews.

integrations.name: AWS Secrets Manager
integrations.description: Connect to AWS Secrets Manager
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AWS Secrets Manager into the workflow. Can retrieve, create, update, list, delete, describe, tag, untag, restore, and rotate secrets.

operations.name: Get Secret
operations.description: Retrieve a secret value from AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: List Secrets
operations.description: List secrets stored in AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: Create Secret
operations.description: Create a new secret in AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: Update Secret
operations.description: Update the value of an existing secret in AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: Delete Secret
operations.description: Delete a secret from AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: Describe Secret
operations.description: Retrieve full metadata for a secret in AWS Secrets Manager, including rotation configuration and replication status, without exposing the secret value

operations.name: Tag Secret
operations.description: Attach tags to a secret in AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: Untag Secret
operations.description: Remove tags from a secret in AWS Secrets Manager

operations.name: Restore Secret
operations.description: Cancel a scheduled deletion for a secret in AWS Secrets Manager, restoring access to it

operations.name: Rotate Secret
operations.description: Start or reconfigure rotation for a secret in AWS Secrets Manager

integrations.name: AWS SES
integrations.description: Send emails and manage templates with AWS Simple Email Service
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AWS SES v2 into the workflow. Send simple, templated, and bulk emails. Manage email templates, identities, configuration sets, and the account suppression list, and retrieve account sending quota and verified identity information.

operations.name: Send Email
operations.description: Send an email via AWS SES using simple or HTML content

operations.name: Send Templated Email
operations.description: Send an email using an SES email template with dynamic template data

operations.name: Send Bulk Email
operations.description: Send emails to multiple recipients using an SES template with per-recipient data

operations.name: List Identities
operations.description: List all verified email identities (email addresses and domains) in your SES account

operations.name: Get Account
operations.description: Get SES account sending quota and status information

operations.name: Create Template
operations.description: Create a new SES email template for use with templated email sending

operations.name: Get Template
operations.description: Retrieve the content and details of an SES email template

operations.name: List Templates
operations.description: List all SES email templates in your account

operations.name: Delete Template
operations.description: Delete an existing SES email template

operations.name: Update Template
operations.description: Update the subject, HTML, and text content of an existing SES email template

operations.name: Send Custom Verification Email
operations.description: Send a branded custom verification email to an address using a custom verification email template

operations.name: Create Email Identity
operations.description: Start verification of a new SES email address or domain identity

operations.name: Get Email Identity
operations.description: Retrieve verification status, DKIM, Mail-From, and policy details for an SES identity

operations.name: Delete Email Identity
operations.description: Delete a verified SES email address or domain identity

operations.name: Put Suppressed Destination
operations.description: Add an email address to the account-level SES suppression list

operations.name: Get Suppressed Destination
operations.description: Retrieve details for a specific email address on the SES suppression list

operations.name: List Suppressed Destinations
operations.description: List email addresses on the account-level SES suppression list

operations.name: Delete Suppressed Destination
operations.description: Remove an email address from the account-level SES suppression list

operations.name: Create Configuration Set
operations.description: Create an SES configuration set to control tracking, delivery, reputation, sending, and suppression behavior for emails

integrations.name: AWS STS
integrations.description: Connect to AWS Security Token Service
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AWS STS into the workflow. Assume roles, get temporary credentials, verify caller identity, and look up access key information.

operations.name: Assume Role
operations.description: Assume an IAM role and receive temporary security credentials

operations.name: Assume Role With Web Identity
operations.description: Assume an IAM role using an OIDC/OAuth 2.0 web identity token (e.g. GitHub Actions OIDC, EKS IRSA, Google/Facebook federation) and receive temporary security credentials

operations.name: Assume Role With SAML
operations.description: Assume an IAM role using a SAML 2.0 authentication response from an enterprise identity provider and receive temporary security credentials

operations.name: Get Caller Identity
operations.description: Get details about the IAM user or role whose credentials are used to call the API

operations.name: Get Session Token
operations.description: Get temporary security credentials for an IAM user, optionally with MFA

operations.name: Get Access Key Info
operations.description: Get the AWS account ID associated with an access key

integrations.name: AWS Systems Manager
integrations.description: Run commands, manage parameters, and audit managed nodes
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AWS Systems Manager into your workflow. Run commands on managed nodes, read and write Parameter Store values, inspect node inventory and patch compliance, and drive Automation runbooks.

operations.name: Send Command
operations.description: Run an SSM document on managed nodes with AWS Systems Manager Run Command

operations.name: List Commands
operations.description: List Run Command executions in an AWS account

operations.name: List Command Invocations
operations.description: List the per-node invocations of Run Command executions

operations.name: Get Command Invocation
operations.description: Read the output and status of a Run Command execution on one managed node

operations.name: Cancel Command
operations.description: Cancel an in-flight Run Command execution

operations.name: Get Parameter
operations.description: Read one parameter from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

operations.name: Get Parameters
operations.description: Read up to ten parameters from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store by name

operations.name: Get Parameters By Path
operations.description: Read parameters under a Parameter Store hierarchy path

operations.name: Put Parameter
operations.description: Create or update a parameter in AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

operations.name: Delete Parameter
operations.description: Delete a parameter from AWS Systems Manager Parameter Store

operations.name: Describe Parameters
operations.description: List Parameter Store parameter metadata without reading any values

operations.name: Describe Instance Information
operations.description: List managed nodes registered with AWS Systems Manager and their agent status

operations.name: Describe Instance Patches
operations.description: List the patches reported for one managed node

operations.name: Describe Instance Patch States
operations.description: Read patch compliance summaries for a set of managed nodes

operations.name: List Compliance Items
operations.description: List individual compliance findings reported to AWS Systems Manager

operations.name: List Compliance Summaries
operations.description: Read compliant and non-compliant counts per compliance type

operations.name: Start Automation Execution
operations.description: Start an AWS Systems Manager Automation runbook execution

operations.name: Describe Automation Executions
operations.description: List Automation runbook executions in an AWS account

operations.name: Get Automation Execution
operations.description: Read the status, outputs, and step results of one Automation execution

operations.name: Stop Automation Execution
operations.description: Stop a running AWS Systems Manager Automation execution

operations.name: List Documents
operations.description: List SSM documents and runbooks available to an AWS account

operations.name: Get Document
operations.description: Read the content of an SSM document or Automation runbook

integrations.name: AWS Textract
integrations.description: Extract text, tables, and forms from documents
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AWS Textract into your workflow to extract text, tables, forms, and key-value pairs from documents. Single-page mode supports JPEG, PNG, and single-page PDF. Multi-page mode supports multi-page PDF and TIFF.

operations.name: Analyze Expense (Invoices & Receipts)
operations.description: Extract structured invoice and receipt fields using AWS Textract AnalyzeExpense

operations.name: Analyze Identity Document
operations.description: Extract identity document fields using AWS Textract AnalyzeID

integrations.name: Azure AD
integrations.description: Manage identities, licenses, roles, and access in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Azure Active Directory into your workflows. Create, update, and delete users and groups, manage group memberships, assign and remove licenses, reset passwords, revoke sign-in sessions, read sign-in and directory audit logs, grant and revoke app and directory roles, and read registered devices and conditional access policies. Device writes are not supported.

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: List users in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Get User
operations.description: Get a user by ID or user principal name from Azure AD

operations.name: Create User
operations.description: Create a new user in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Update User
operations.description: Update user properties in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Delete User
operations.description: Delete a user from Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID). The user is moved to a temporary container and can be restored within 30 days.

operations.name: List Groups
operations.description: List groups in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Get Group
operations.description: Get a group by ID from Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Create Group
operations.description: Create a new group in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Update Group
operations.description: Update group properties in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Delete Group
operations.description: Delete a group from Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID). Microsoft 365 and security groups can be restored within 30 days.

operations.name: List Group Members
operations.description: List members of a group in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Add Group Member
operations.description: Add a member to a group in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Remove Group Member
operations.description: Remove a member from a group in Azure AD (Microsoft Entra ID)

operations.name: Assign License
operations.description: Add or remove subscription licenses (SKUs) on a user in Microsoft Entra ID. Removing a license immediately revokes the access it granted to the associated services.

operations.name: List User Licenses
operations.description: List the subscription licenses assigned to a user in Microsoft Entra ID

operations.name: List Subscribed SKUs
operations.description: List the subscription SKUs the tenant owns, including how many license units are prepaid and how many are consumed

operations.name: Revoke Sign-In Sessions
operations.description: Invalidate every refresh token and session cookie issued to a user, forcing them to sign in again on all applications and devices. Revocation can take a few minutes to take effect and does not apply to external users.

operations.name: Set Password
operations.description: Set a specific password on a user by updating their password profile. Cannot be used for federated users. Requires an administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID.

operations.name: Reset Password
operations.description: Reset another user's password through their password authentication method. Leave the new password empty to have Microsoft generate one and return it. The user is prompted to change the password at their next sign-in. Cannot be run against your own account.

operations.name: List Authentication Methods
operations.description: List the authentication methods a user has registered, such as passwords, phone numbers, FIDO2 keys, and authenticator apps

operations.name: List Sign-Ins
operations.description: List sign-in events from the Microsoft Entra ID sign-in logs, newest first. Requires a Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2 license. Apply a date filter to keep large queries from timing out.

operations.name: List Directory Audits
operations.description: List directory audit records showing who changed what in Microsoft Entra ID, such as user creation, group membership changes, and role assignments

operations.name: List User App Role Assignments
operations.description: List the application role assignments granted to a user, including assignments the user inherits from groups they are a direct member of

operations.name: Grant App Role To User
operations.description: Grant a user an application role on a service principal, giving them access to that application

operations.name: Revoke App Role From User
operations.description: Revoke an application role assignment from a user, removing their access to that application. Takes the assignment's own ID, not the app role ID.

operations.name: List Service Principals
operations.description: List the enterprise applications and service principals in the tenant, including the app roles each one exposes

operations.name: List Application Assignments
operations.description: List every user, group, and service principal assigned to an application, by reading the app role assignments on its service principal. Recently granted or removed assignments can take time to appear.

operations.name: List Directory Roles
operations.description: List the administrator roles that are activated in the tenant, such as Global Administrator and User Administrator. Roles that have never been activated are not returned.

operations.name: List Directory Role Members
operations.description: List the principals holding an administrator role. Returns up to 1000 members; this endpoint does not support paging.

operations.name: Add Directory Role Member
operations.description: Grant a user an administrator role in Microsoft Entra ID. This is a privileged change that expands what the user can do across the tenant.

operations.name: Remove Directory Role Member
operations.description: Revoke an administrator role from a user in Microsoft Entra ID. Removes only the role membership; the user account itself is not deleted.

operations.name: List Devices
operations.description: List the devices registered in Microsoft Entra ID

operations.name: Get Device
operations.description: Get a registered device by its object ID from Microsoft Entra ID

operations.name: List User Devices
operations.description: List the devices a user has registered or owns. Devices the caller cannot read are returned with only their ID and the remaining fields null.

operations.name: List Conditional Access Policies
operations.description: List the conditional access policies configured in the tenant, including their state and the conditions and controls they enforce. Read-only.

operations.name: Get Conditional Access Policy
operations.description: Get a single conditional access policy by ID, including the conditions it matches and the controls it enforces. Read-only.

integrations.name: Azure Data Explorer
integrations.description: Query and manage Azure Data Explorer (Kusto) clusters with KQL
integrations.longDescription: Run Kusto Query Language queries against Azure Data Explorer and Fabric Eventhouse clusters, discover databases, tables, and schemas, push small batches of rows inline, and run management commands. Authenticates with a Microsoft Entra service principal using client credentials, so no interactive sign-in is needed.

operations.name: Run Query
operations.description: Run a Kusto Query Language (KQL) query against an Azure Data Explorer database and return the primary result table.

operations.name: List Databases
operations.description: List the databases on an Azure Data Explorer cluster that the service principal can access.

operations.name: List Tables
operations.description: List the tables in an Azure Data Explorer database, with their folder and docstring.

operations.name: Show Table Schema
operations.description: Read the column schema of an Azure Data Explorer table in CSL form (e.g., "Timestamp:datetime,Level:string"). Use this before writing a KQL query against an unfamiliar table.

operations.name: Show Database Schema
operations.description: Read the full schema of an Azure Data Explorer database as a flat list of every table and column, so an agent can discover the data model in one call.

operations.name: Show Table Details
operations.description: Read size, row count, hot-cache footprint, and effective policies for a table — or for every table in the database when no table is given. Use it to see how much data a table actually holds before querying it.

operations.name: List Functions
operations.description: List the stored functions in an Azure Data Explorer database, with their parameters and bodies, so an agent can reuse existing logic instead of rewriting it.

operations.name: Ingest Rows Inline
operations.description: Push rows directly into an Azure Data Explorer table with .ingest inline. Data is parsed as CSV against the table schema unless an ingestion property says otherwise. Intended for small batches — use queued or streaming ingestion for production volumes.

operations.name: Ingest From Query
operations.description: Materialize the result of a KQL query into a table with .set, .append, .set-or-append, or .set-or-replace. Use this to build rollup or summary tables instead of pushing rows from a workflow. Kusto matches the query result to the target table by column type and position, NOT by column name, so project the columns in exactly the table's order or the data lands in the wrong columns.

operations.name: Create Table
operations.description: Create a table in an Azure Data Explorer database from a CSL column schema. Succeeds without changing anything if a table of the same name already exists.

operations.name: Drop Table
operations.description: Drop a table from an Azure Data Explorer database. This permanently deletes the table and its data, and returns the tables that remain.

operations.name: Show Ingestion Failures
operations.description: List ingestion failures recorded for a database, with the failing table, error code, root cause detail, and whether the failure is permanent or transient. Failures are retained for 14 days.

operations.name: Show Operations
operations.description: Check the state of administrative operations on a cluster, such as an async ingestion. Given an operation ID it returns that operation latest update; with no ID it returns the operations from the last two weeks.

operations.name: Management Command (advanced)
operations.description: Run an Azure Data Explorer management command (a control command starting with ".") such as .show, .create, .alter, or .drop. Write commands change cluster state permanently; use the Query operation for reads.

integrations.name: Azure DevOps
integrations.description: Interact with Azure DevOps pipelines, builds, and work items
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Azure DevOps into your workflow. List and inspect pipelines and builds, query and manage work items, and add or read comments.

operations.name: List Pipelines
operations.description: List all pipelines in an Azure DevOps project. Returns pipeline ID, name, folder, revision, and URL.

operations.name: Get Pipeline
operations.description: Get details for a specific pipeline in an Azure DevOps project, including configuration and repository info.

operations.name: List Pipeline Runs
operations.description: List runs for a specific pipeline in an Azure DevOps project. Returns run ID, name, state, result, and timestamps.

operations.name: Get Pipeline Run
operations.description: Get details for a specific pipeline run in an Azure DevOps project. Returns run state, result, timestamps, and the pipeline reference.

operations.name: List Builds
operations.description: List builds in an Azure DevOps project. Optionally filter by pipeline definition, status, result, or branch.

operations.name: List Build Logs
operations.description: List all log entries for a specific build in Azure DevOps. Returns log IDs, types, and line counts — use the log ID with the Get Build Log tool to fetch actual log text.

operations.name: Get Build Log
operations.description: Fetch the text content of a specific build log in Azure DevOps. Use List Build Logs first to get the log ID. Optionally retrieve only a line range with startLine/endLine.

operations.name: Get Build Timeline
operations.description: Get the execution timeline for an Azure DevOps build — every stage, job, and task with its result and log ID. Use this to identify which steps failed before fetching their logs with Get Build Log.

operations.name: Get Work Items Between Builds
operations.description: Get work item references associated with commits between two builds in Azure DevOps. Returns work item IDs and URLs — use Get Work Items Batch for full field details.

operations.name: Query Work Items
operations.description: Execute a WIQL query to search for work items in Azure DevOps and return full field details. Use TOP N in your query to limit results (Azure enforces a 200-item maximum per batch fetch).

operations.name: Get Work Item
operations.description: Fetch full details of a single work item by ID from Azure DevOps, including title, state, type, assignee, and area path.

operations.name: Get Work Items Batch
operations.description: Fetch full details for multiple work items by ID from Azure DevOps. Pass comma-separated IDs (e.g. "123,456,789"). Requests with more than 200 IDs are automatically split into chunks.

operations.name: Create Work Item
operations.description: Create a new Basic-process work item (Issue, Task, or Epic) in Azure DevOps. Returns the created work item with its assigned ID.

operations.name: Update Work Item
operations.description: Update one or more fields on an existing work item in Azure DevOps. Provide only the fields you want to change.

operations.name: Add Comment
operations.description: Add a comment to a work item in Azure DevOps.

operations.name: Get Comments
operations.description: List comments for an Azure DevOps work item.

triggers.name: Azure DevOps Build Failed
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an Azure DevOps build fails, is canceled, or partially succeeds

triggers.name: Azure DevOps Work Item Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a work item is created in Azure DevOps

triggers.name: Azure DevOps Webhook (All Service Hook Events)
triggers.description: Trigger on whichever service hook event types you configure in Azure DevOps. Sim does not filter deliveries for this trigger.

integrations.name: Bitbucket
integrations.description: Work with Bitbucket Cloud repositories, pull requests, and pipelines
integrations.longDescription: Connect Bitbucket Cloud to inspect repositories and source, collaborate on pull requests, diagnose or control pipelines, and start workflows from repository and pull request events. OAuth is used for actions and automatic webhook management.

operations.name: List Workspaces
operations.description: List Bitbucket Cloud workspaces available to the authenticated account

operations.name: List Repositories
operations.description: List repositories in a Bitbucket Cloud workspace

operations.name: Get Repository
operations.description: Get a Bitbucket Cloud repository

operations.name: List Branches
operations.description: List branches in a Bitbucket Cloud repository

operations.name: Create Branch
operations.description: Create a branch at a commit hash or existing ref

operations.name: Delete Branch
operations.description: Delete a branch from a Bitbucket Cloud repository

operations.name: List Commits
operations.description: List repository commits in reverse chronological order

operations.name: Get Commit
operations.description: Get a repository commit by its full SHA-1

operations.name: List Directory
operations.description: List one shallow repository directory at a full commit SHA-1

operations.name: Get File Metadata
operations.description: Inspect file size and attributes at a full repository commit SHA-1

operations.name: Get File
operations.description: Read bounded UTF-8 text from a file at a full repository commit SHA-1

operations.name: List Pull Requests
operations.description: List pull requests in a Bitbucket Cloud repository

operations.name: Get Pull Request
operations.description: Get a pull request by repository-scoped ID

operations.name: Create Pull Request
operations.description: Create a pull request between repository branches

operations.name: Merge Pull Request
operations.description: Start an asynchronous pull request merge and return a task to poll when needed

operations.name: Get Pull Request Merge Task Status
operations.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous pull request merge task

operations.name: Decline Pull Request
operations.description: Decline an open pull request

operations.name: Approve Pull Request
operations.description: Approve a pull request as the authenticated account

operations.name: Request Pull Request Changes
operations.description: Request changes on a pull request as the authenticated account

operations.name: Get Pull Request Diff
operations.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 unified diff for one pull request file

operations.name: Get Pull Request Diffstat
operations.description: List per-file change statistics for a pull request

operations.name: List Pull Request Comments
operations.description: List global, inline, and reply comments on a pull request

operations.name: Create Pull Request Comment
operations.description: Create a global comment or reply on a pull request

operations.name: List Pull Request Commit Statuses
operations.description: List commit statuses associated with a pull request

operations.name: List Pipelines
operations.description: List pipelines for a Bitbucket Cloud repository

operations.name: Get Pipeline
operations.description: Get a pipeline by UUID

operations.name: Trigger Pipeline
operations.description: Run the repository pipeline selected by a branch or ref target

operations.name: Stop Pipeline
operations.description: Stop a running pipeline

operations.name: List Pipeline Steps
operations.description: List the steps in a pipeline

operations.name: Get Pipeline Step Log
operations.description: Read a bounded UTF-8 tail of a pipeline step log

triggers.name: Bitbucket Push
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when commits are pushed to a Bitbucket repository

triggers.name: Bitbucket Repository Forked
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket repository is forked

triggers.name: Bitbucket Repository Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket repository is updated

triggers.name: Bitbucket Commit Comment Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a comment is created on a Bitbucket commit

triggers.name: Bitbucket Build Status Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a build status is created for a Bitbucket commit

triggers.name: Bitbucket Build Status Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a build status is updated for a Bitbucket commit

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket pull request is created

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket pull request is updated

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Approved
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket pull request is approved

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Approval Removed
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when approval is removed from a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Changes Requested
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when changes are requested on a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Changes Request Removed
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a changes request is removed from a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Merged
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket pull request is merged

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Declined
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Bitbucket pull request is declined

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Comment Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a comment is created on a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Comment Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a comment is updated on a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Comment Deleted
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a comment is deleted from a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Comment Resolved
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a comment is resolved on a Bitbucket pull request

triggers.name: Bitbucket Pull Request Comment Reopened
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a resolved comment is reopened on a Bitbucket pull request

integrations.name: Box
integrations.description: Manage files, folders, and e-signatures with Box
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Box into your workflow to manage files, folders, and e-signatures. Upload and download files, search content, create folders, send documents for e-signature, track signing status, and more.

operations.name: Upload File
operations.description: Upload a file to a Box folder

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from Box

operations.name: Get File Info
operations.description: Get detailed information about a file in Box

operations.name: List Folder Items
operations.description: List files and folders in a Box folder

operations.name: Create Folder
operations.description: Create a new folder in Box

operations.name: Delete File
operations.description: Delete a file from Box

operations.name: Delete Folder
operations.description: Delete a folder from Box

operations.name: Copy File
operations.description: Copy a file to another folder in Box

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Search for files and folders in Box

operations.name: Update File
operations.description: Update file info in Box (rename, move, change description, add tags)

operations.name: Create Sign Request
operations.description: Create a new Box Sign request to send documents for e-signature

operations.name: Get Sign Request
operations.description: Get the details and status of a Box Sign request

operations.name: List Sign Requests
operations.description: List all Box Sign requests

operations.name: Cancel Sign Request
operations.description: Cancel a pending Box Sign request

operations.name: Resend Sign Request
operations.description: Resend a Box Sign request to signers who have not yet signed

integrations.name: Brandfetch
integrations.description: Look up brand assets, logos, colors, and company info
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Brandfetch into your workflow. Retrieve brand logos, colors, fonts, and company data by domain, ticker, or name search.

operations.name: Get Brand
operations.description: Retrieve brand assets including logos, colors, fonts, and company info by domain, ticker, ISIN, or crypto symbol

operations.name: Search Brands
operations.description: Search for brands by name and find their domains and logos

integrations.name: Brex
integrations.description: Manage expenses, receipts, transactions, and team data in Brex
integrations.longDescription: Integrates Brex into the workflow. List and update expenses, upload and match receipts, view card and cash transactions, accounts, budgets, spend limits, vendors, transfers, and team data.

operations.name: List Expenses
operations.description: List expenses in the Brex account with optional filters for user, status, payment status, and purchase date range

operations.name: Get Expense
operations.description: Get a single Brex expense by its ID, including merchant, user, and receipt details

operations.name: Update Expense Memo
operations.description: Update the memo of a Brex card expense

operations.name: Upload Receipt
operations.description: Upload a receipt file and attach it to a specific Brex card expense

operations.name: Match Receipt
operations.description: Upload a receipt file and let Brex automatically match it with existing expenses

operations.name: List Card Transactions
operations.description: List settled card transactions for all Brex card accounts

operations.name: List Cash Transactions
operations.description: List transactions for a Brex cash account

operations.name: List Card Accounts

integrations.name: Bright Data
integrations.description: Scrape websites, search engines, and extract structured data
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Bright Data into the workflow. Scrape any URL with Web Unlocker, search Google and other engines with SERP API, discover web content ranked by intent, or trigger pre-built scrapers for structured data extraction.

operations.name: Scrape URL
operations.description: Fetch content from any URL using Bright Data Web Unlocker. Bypasses anti-bot protections, CAPTCHAs, and IP blocks automatically.

operations.name: SERP Search
operations.description: Search Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, or Yandex and get structured search results using Bright Data SERP API.

operations.name: Discover
operations.description: AI-powered web discovery that finds and ranks results by intent. Returns up to 20 results with optional cleaned page content for RAG and verification.

operations.name: Sync Scrape
operations.description: Scrape URLs synchronously using a Bright Data pre-built scraper and get structured results directly. Supports up to 20 URLs with a 1-minute timeout.

operations.name: Scrape Dataset
operations.description: Trigger a Bright Data pre-built scraper to extract structured data from URLs. Supports 660+ scrapers for platforms like Amazon, LinkedIn, Instagram, and more.

operations.name: Snapshot Status
operations.description: Check the progress of an async Bright Data scraping job. Returns status: starting, running, ready, or failed.

operations.name: Download Snapshot
operations.description: Download the results of a completed Bright Data scraping job using its snapshot ID. The snapshot must have ready status.

operations.name: Cancel Snapshot
operations.description: Cancel an active Bright Data scraping job using its snapshot ID. Terminates data collection in progress.

integrations.name: Browser Use
integrations.description: Run browser automation tasks
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Browser Use into the workflow. Can navigate the web and perform actions as if a real user was interacting with the browser.

integrations.name: Buffer
integrations.description: Schedule and publish social media posts across connected channels
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Buffer into your workflow. Create, schedule, edit, and delete posts across connected social channels (Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Facebook, TikTok, and more), attach images or videos, browse channels, and capture content ideas using the Buffer API.

operations.name: Create Post
operations.description: Create a post in Buffer for a channel — add it to the queue, share it immediately, schedule it for a specific time, or save it as a draft, optionally with an image or video attachment

operations.name: Edit Post
operations.description: Edit an existing Buffer post — update its text, schedule, or media. Attaching new media replaces the existing attachments

operations.name: Get Posts
operations.description: List posts in a Buffer organization, optionally filtered by channel and status (draft, needs_approval, scheduled, sending, sent, error)

operations.name: Get Post
operations.description: Get a single Buffer post by ID, including its status, schedule, and media

operations.name: Delete Post
operations.description: Delete a Buffer post by ID

operations.name: Get Channels
operations.description: List the social media channels connected to a Buffer organization, including their channel IDs (needed to create posts)

operations.name: Create Idea
operations.description: Save a content idea to a Buffer organization for later drafting and scheduling

operations.name: Get Ideas
operations.description: List content ideas saved in a Buffer organization

operations.name: Get Idea Groups
operations.description: List idea groups (board columns) in a Buffer organization, including the group IDs used when creating ideas

operations.name: Get Account
operations.description: Get the authenticated Buffer account, including its organizations and their IDs (needed for channel and post operations)

integrations.name: Cal.com
integrations.description: Manage Cal.com bookings, event types, schedules, and availability
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Cal.com into your workflow. Create and manage bookings, event types, schedules, and check availability slots. Supports creating, listing, rescheduling, and canceling bookings, as well as managing event types and schedules. Can also trigger workflows based on Cal.com webhook events (booking created, cancelled, rescheduled). Connect your Cal.com account via OAuth.

operations.name: Cancel Booking

operations.name: Reschedule Booking

operations.name: Decline Booking

operations.name: List Event Types

operations.name: Update Event Type

operations.name: Delete Event Type

operations.name: Get Schedule

operations.name: List Schedules

operations.name: Delete Schedule

integrations.name: Calendly

integrations.longDescription: Integrate Calendly into your workflow. Manage event types, scheduled events, invitees, and webhooks. Can also trigger workflows based on Calendly webhook events (invitee scheduled, invitee canceled, routing form submitted). Requires Personal Access Token.
