integrations.name: CB Insights
integrations.description: Research private markets — firmographics, funding, and predictive scores
integrations.longDescription: Integrates the CB Insights API v2 into the workflow. Resolve companies to CB Insights IDs for free, search firmographics across markets and geographies, pull funding rounds, cap tables, investments, and exits, map business relationships, read leadership and board history, and retrieve the proprietary Mosaic Score, Commercial Maturity, and Exit Probability outlooks. Generate AI Scouting Reports, or ask ChatCBI directly. Which datasets answer depends on your CB Insights license.

operations.name: Look Up Organizations
operations.description: Resolve company names or websites to CB Insights organization IDs. This endpoint never charges credits, so use it to match your own records before spending credits on the data endpoints.

operations.name: Search Firmographics
operations.description: Search profiles of private companies, public companies, and investors by market, industry, geography, headcount, funding, and valuation. Each field is ANDed together; values within a field are ORed.

operations.name: Get Organization Fundings
operations.description: Retrieve the funding rounds one organization has received, its cap table history, and AI-generated insights extracting the key themes of each deal.

operations.name: Get Organization Investments
operations.description: Retrieve the rounds in which one organization invested in another, with AI-generated insights extracting the key themes of each deal.

operations.name: Get Organization Portfolio Exits
operations.description: Retrieve exit rounds for companies this organization invested in before the exit, with AI-generated insights on each deal.

operations.name: Get Organization Business Relationships
operations.description: Retrieve one organization's partnerships, client/vendor relationships, and licensing activity, with AI-generated insights on each.

operations.name: Get Organization Management and Board
operations.description: Retrieve an organization's leadership team and board members with their education, work history, and board seats, plus the Management factor of its Mosaic Score.

operations.name: Get Organization Outlook
operations.description: Retrieve an organization's current Mosaic Score, Commercial Maturity level, and two-year IPO and M&A exit probabilities, with the signals driving each.

operations.name: Get Organization Funding Window
operations.description: Retrieve the estimated window in which an organization is likely to raise its next round, with the cohort it was compared against.

operations.name: Get Organization Revenue
operations.description: Retrieve reported and estimated revenue by calendar year for one organization, with the sources behind each figure.

operations.name: Get Mosaic History
operations.description: Retrieve an organization's historical Mosaic Scores — overall plus the management, market, momentum, and money factors — so a trend can be read rather than a single snapshot.

operations.name: Get Commercial Maturity History
operations.description: Retrieve an organization's historical Commercial Maturity levels, tracking how its ability to compete for customers or serve as a partner has moved over time.

operations.name: Get Exit Probability History
operations.description: Retrieve an organization's historical two-year IPO and M&A exit probabilities, each alongside the mean for comparable companies.

operations.name: Get Strategy Map
operations.description: Retrieve the companies related to an organization, grouped into industry categories, with the relationships, investments, and acquisitions that connect them.

operations.name: Get Scouting Report
operations.description: Generate an AI-written Scouting Report on a private company covering its business model, market position, strengths, and opportunities. Only active companies are eligible, and generation can take several minutes.

operations.name: List Fundings
operations.description: Retrieve funding rounds and cap table history for up to 100 organizations at once, with AI-generated insights extracting the key themes of each deal.

operations.name: List Investments
operations.description: Retrieve the rounds up to 100 organizations participated in as investors, with AI-generated insights extracting the key themes of each deal.

operations.name: List Portfolio Exits
operations.description: Retrieve exit rounds for companies up to 100 organizations invested in before the exit, with AI-generated insights on each deal.

operations.name: List Business Relationships
operations.description: Retrieve partnerships, client/vendor relationships, and licensing activity for up to 100 organizations at once, with AI-generated insights on each.

operations.name: List Management and Board
operations.description: Retrieve leadership teams, board members, and the Management factor of the Mosaic Score for up to 100 organizations at once.

operations.name: List Outlook
operations.description: Retrieve Mosaic Score, Commercial Maturity, and Exit Probability for up to 100 organizations at once.

operations.name: List Funding Windows
operations.description: Retrieve the estimated next-round funding window for up to 100 organizations at once, with the cohort each was compared against.

operations.name: List Revenue
operations.description: Retrieve reported and estimated revenue by calendar year for up to 100 organizations at once.

operations.name: Ask ChatCBI
operations.description: Ask ChatCBI a question in natural language and get an answer grounded in CB Insights data, with its sources and suggested follow-ups. Uses generative AI and can be wrong — verify anything that matters.

operations.name: Retrieve Context
operations.description: Retrieve the raw structured CB Insights data relevant to a question, for feeding your own model rather than reading a written answer. Uses generative AI and can be wrong — verify anything that matters.

integrations.name: Circleback
integrations.description: AI-powered meeting notes, action items, and transcripts
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Circleback into your workflow to read meetings, notes, transcripts, and insights, search across meetings, manage action items and tags, and browse the people and companies you meet with. Circleback can also trigger workflows when meetings are processed.

operations.name: List Meetings
operations.description: Lists meetings from Circleback with optional ownership, status, tag, and attendee filters.

operations.name: Get Meeting
operations.description: Gets a Circleback meeting by ID, including notes, attendees, action items, insights, and recording details.

operations.name: Search Meetings
operations.description: Searches Circleback meetings by name and content, with optional filters for specific meetings, tags, and people.

operations.name: Get Transcript
operations.description: Gets the full transcript for a Circleback meeting.

operations.name: Update Meeting
operations.description: Updates the name, notes, or private notes of a Circleback meeting. The API returns only the fields that were updated.

operations.name: Delete Meeting
operations.description: Deletes a Circleback meeting. Only the owner of the meeting can delete it. Returns the deleted meeting.

operations.name: List Action Items
operations.description: Lists action items across the authenticated user meetings, filtered by assignee, status, tags, and attendees. Defaults to incomplete action items assigned to the API key owner.

operations.name: Update Action Item
operations.description: Updates the title, description, status, or assignee of a Circleback action item. Returns the updated action item.

operations.name: Delete Action Item
operations.description: Deletes a Circleback action item. Returns the deleted action item.

operations.name: List Calendar Events
operations.description: Lists upcoming calendar events from the authenticated user connected calendars, with pagination and a configurable time window.

operations.name: List Companies
operations.description: Lists the companies whose people attend the authenticated user meetings, with optional tag filters.

operations.name: Get Company
operations.description: Gets a company by its domain from Circleback, including its people and external links.

operations.name: List People
operations.description: Lists the people who attend the authenticated user meetings, ordered by most recent meeting, with optional company and tag filters.

operations.name: Get Person
operations.description: Gets a person by their profile ID from Circleback, including their profile details and external links.

operations.name: List Tags
operations.description: Lists every tag available to the authenticated Circleback user.

operations.name: Create Tag
operations.description: Creates a new tag in Circleback. If a tag with the same name already exists, a conflict error is returned.

operations.name: Update Tag
operations.description: Updates the name or description of a Circleback tag.

operations.name: Delete Tag
operations.description: Permanently deletes a Circleback tag and removes it from every meeting it was applied to.

operations.name: Add Tag to Meetings
operations.description: Applies an existing Circleback tag to one or more meetings and returns the updated meetings.

operations.name: Remove Tag from Meetings
operations.description: Removes a Circleback tag from one or more meetings and returns the updated meetings.

triggers.name: Circleback Meeting Completed
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a meeting is processed and ready in Circleback

triggers.name: Circleback Meeting Notes Ready
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when meeting notes and action items are ready

triggers.name: Circleback Webhook
triggers.description: Generic webhook trigger for all Circleback events

integrations.name: Claude Managed Agents
integrations.description: Run a Claude Platform Managed Agent
integrations.longDescription: Invoke a Claude Platform Managed Agent from a workflow. Select a Claude Platform account, pick an agent and environment from that workspace, optionally attach vaults, a memory store, and files, and add metadata tags. Returns the assistant's final text.

operations.name: Run session (create, send, wait for reply)
operations.description: Open a Claude Platform Managed Agent session and return the assistant response as text.

operations.name: Create session
operations.description: Create a Claude Platform Managed Agent session and return its id without waiting for a reply.

operations.name: Send message
operations.description: Send a user message to an existing Claude Platform Managed Agent session.

operations.name: Get session
operations.description: Read a Managed Agent session: status, stop reason, token usage, metadata, and any tool calls awaiting approval.

operations.name: List events
operations.description: Read a Managed Agent session's event history and the agent's reply text.

operations.name: Update session
operations.description: Update a Managed Agent session's title or metadata.

operations.name: Interrupt session
operations.description: Stop a running Managed Agent session; it stays usable afterwards.

operations.name: Respond to tool confirmation
operations.description: Allow or deny the tool calls a Managed Agent session is waiting on before it can continue.

operations.name: Respond to custom tool
operations.description: Return the result of a custom tool a Managed Agent session is waiting on so it can continue.

operations.name: Archive session
operations.description: Archive a Managed Agent session, preserving its history. Not reversible.

operations.name: Delete session
operations.description: Permanently delete a Managed Agent session, its events, and its sandbox. Not reversible.

integrations.name: Cloudflare
integrations.description: Manage DNS, WAF, Zero Trust access, and edge infrastructure
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Cloudflare into the workflow. Manage zones (domains), DNS records, SSL/TLS certificates, zone settings, DNS analytics, and cache purging. Configure WAF rulesets, managed rule overrides, and rate limiting rules through the current Rulesets engine. Administer Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) applications, policies, groups, identity providers, and service tokens, and inspect R2 buckets, Workers scripts and routes, and Cloudflare Tunnels.

operations.name: List Zones
operations.description: Lists all zones (domains) in the Cloudflare account.

operations.name: Get Zone Details
operations.description: Gets details for a specific zone (domain) by its ID.

operations.name: Create Zone
operations.description: Adds a new zone (domain) to the Cloudflare account.

operations.name: Delete Zone
operations.description: Deletes a zone (domain) from the Cloudflare account.

operations.name: List DNS Records
operations.description: Lists DNS records for a specific zone.

operations.name: Create DNS Record
operations.description: Creates a new DNS record for a zone.

operations.name: Update DNS Record
operations.description: Updates an existing DNS record for a zone.

operations.name: Delete DNS Record
operations.description: Deletes a DNS record from a zone.

operations.name: List Certificates
operations.description: Lists SSL/TLS certificate packs for a zone.

operations.name: Get Zone Settings
operations.description: Reads zone settings such as SSL mode, minimum TLS version, security level, and caching level. Cloudflare retired the endpoint that read every setting in one request, so each setting is read individually — name the ones you need to keep the read small. Defaults to ${DEFAULT_ZONE_SETTING_IDS.join(', ')}.

operations.name: Update Zone Setting
operations.description: Updates a specific zone setting such as SSL mode, security level, cache level, or other configuration.

operations.name: DNS Analytics
operations.description: Gets DNS analytics report for a zone including query counts and trends.

operations.name: Purge Cache
operations.description: Purges cached content for a zone. Can purge everything or specific files/tags/hosts/prefixes.

operations.name: List Rulesets
operations.description: Lists every ruleset defined on a zone across all phases (WAF custom rules, managed rules, rate limiting, transform rules, and more). The list response deliberately omits the rules inside each ruleset — use "Get Ruleset" to read them. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Read (or another matching ruleset Read permission).

operations.name: Get Ruleset
operations.description: Reads a single zone ruleset including every rule it contains, in evaluation order. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Read (or another matching ruleset Read permission).

operations.name: Get Phase Entry Point Ruleset
operations.description: Reads the entry point ruleset for a phase on a zone, including all of its rules. This is how you find the ruleset ID you need before adding, updating, or deleting a rule — for example http_request_firewall_custom for WAF custom rules, http_request_firewall_managed for managed-ruleset deployments and overrides, or http_ratelimit for rate limiting rules. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Read (or another matching ruleset Read permission).

operations.name: Create Ruleset Rule
operations.description: Adds a rule to a zone ruleset. Use "Get Phase Entry Point Ruleset" first to find the ruleset ID for the phase you want (for example http_request_firewall_custom for a WAF custom rule, or http_request_firewall_managed with action "execute" to deploy a managed ruleset). The rule is appended to the end of the ruleset unless a position is given. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Edit (or another matching ruleset Write permission).

operations.name: Update Ruleset Rule
operations.description: Updates a rule in a zone ruleset. Cloudflare replaces the rule definition rather than merging it, so you must send every field you want the rule to keep — any field you omit is reset to its default. Read the current rule with "Get Ruleset" first. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Edit (or another matching ruleset Write permission).

operations.name: Delete Ruleset Rule
operations.description: Permanently deletes a rule from a zone ruleset. This takes effect immediately on live traffic and cannot be undone — deleting a WAF custom rule, a managed-ruleset deployment, or a rate limiting rule removes that protection from the zone. Also use this to delete rate limiting rules, which live in the http_ratelimit phase ruleset. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Edit (or another matching ruleset Write permission).

operations.name: List Managed Ruleset Overrides
operations.description: Lists the WAF managed rulesets deployed on a zone together with the overrides applied to each one. Cloudflare has no dedicated overrides endpoint — overrides live on the "execute" rules of the http_request_firewall_managed phase entry point ruleset, which this reads. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Read.

operations.name: List Rate Limiting Rules
operations.description: Lists the rate limiting rules on a zone by reading the http_ratelimit phase entry point ruleset. This uses the current Rulesets-based rate limiting API; the legacy rate_limits endpoint is no longer available. The returned ruleset ID is what "Create Rate Limiting Rule", "Update Rate Limiting Rule", and "Delete Ruleset Rule" need. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Read.

operations.name: Create Rate Limiting Rule
operations.description: Creates a rate limiting rule in the http_ratelimit phase entry point ruleset of a zone, using the current Rulesets-based rate limiting API (the legacy rate_limits endpoint is no longer available). Run "List Rate Limiting Rules" first to get the ruleset ID. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Edit.

operations.name: Update Rate Limiting Rule
operations.description: Updates a rate limiting rule in the http_ratelimit phase entry point ruleset of a zone, using the current Rulesets-based rate limiting API. Cloudflare replaces the rule definition rather than merging it, so send the complete rule — every field you omit is reset. Run "List Rate Limiting Rules" first to read the current definition and get the ruleset ID. Requires an API token with Zone WAF Edit.

operations.name: List Access Applications
operations.description: Lists the Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) applications protecting an account. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Read.

operations.name: Get Access Application
operations.description: Reads a single Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) application, including its attached policies. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Read.

operations.name: Create Access Application
operations.description: Creates a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) application that puts an identity check in front of a hostname. Until at least one policy is attached the application denies everyone, so pair this with "Create Access Policy". Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Edit.

operations.name: Update Access Application
operations.description: Updates a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) application. Cloudflare does not document merge behavior for this PUT, so treat it as a replace: send every field the application should keep, because an omitted field may revert to its default and widen or break access. Read the current configuration with "Get Access Application" first. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Edit.

operations.name: Delete Access Application
operations.description: Permanently deletes a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) application and every policy attached to it. The hostname it protected is immediately left without an Access identity check, so anyone who can reach it can reach the origin. This cannot be undone. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Edit.

operations.name: List Access Policies
operations.description: Lists the Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) policies attached to an application, in precedence order. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Read.

operations.name: Create Access Policy
operations.description: Creates a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) policy on an application, deciding who may reach it. A policy takes effect on live traffic as soon as it is created — an allow policy with a broad include rule grants access immediately. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Edit.

operations.name: Update Access Policy
operations.description: Updates a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) policy on an application. Cloudflare does not document merge behavior for this PUT, so treat it as a replace: send every rule the policy should keep, because an omitted exclude or require rule may be dropped and widen who gets in. The change applies to live traffic immediately. Read the current policy with "List Access Policies" first. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Edit.

operations.name: Delete Access Policy
operations.description: Permanently deletes a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) policy from an application. This changes who can reach the application the moment it runs: removing an allow policy locks out everyone it covered, and removing a deny or require policy drops that restriction. This cannot be undone. Requires an API token with Account Access: Apps and Policies Edit.

operations.name: List Access Groups
operations.description: Lists the reusable Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) groups in an account. Groups bundle identity rules that policies can reference by ID. Requires an API token with Account Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Read.

operations.name: List Access Identity Providers
operations.description: Lists the identity providers configured for Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) in an account, such as Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace, or a one-time PIN. Use the returned IDs to restrict an application with allowed_idps. Requires an API token with Account Access: Organizations, Identity Providers, and Groups Read.

operations.name: List Access Service Tokens
operations.description: Lists the Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) service tokens in an account, which let machines authenticate to Access-protected applications. Client secrets are never returned by this endpoint — only on creation. Requires an API token with Account Access: Service Tokens Read.

operations.name: Create Access Service Token
operations.description: Creates a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) service token so a machine can authenticate to Access-protected applications. This is the only response that ever contains the client secret — Cloudflare will not return it again, so capture it in the same run. Requires an API token with Account Access: Service Tokens Edit.

operations.name: Revoke Access Service Token
operations.description: Permanently deletes a Cloudflare Access (Zero Trust) service token, revoking it. Every machine or integration still presenting that client ID and secret is locked out of the Access-protected applications immediately, and the secret cannot be recovered. This cannot be undone. Requires an API token with Account Access: Service Tokens Edit.

operations.name: List R2 Buckets
operations.description: Lists the R2 object storage buckets in an account. Requires an API token with Account Workers R2 Storage Read.

operations.name: Get R2 Bucket
operations.description: Reads the metadata of a single R2 object storage bucket. Requires an API token with Account Workers R2 Storage Read.

operations.name: Create R2 Bucket
operations.description: Creates an R2 object storage bucket in an account. The location hint and jurisdiction are fixed at creation and cannot be changed later. Requires an API token with Account Workers R2 Storage Edit.

operations.name: Delete R2 Bucket
operations.description: Permanently deletes an R2 object storage bucket. Cloudflare only deletes an empty bucket, and the deletion cannot be undone. Requires an API token with Account Workers R2 Storage Edit.

operations.name: List Worker Scripts
operations.description: Lists the Workers scripts deployed in an account. Requires an API token with Account Workers Scripts Read.

operations.name: Get Worker Script Settings
operations.description: Reads the deployment settings of a single Workers script — bindings, compatibility date and flags, limits, observability, placement, and tail consumers. The plain "get script" endpoint in the Cloudflare API returns raw JavaScript source rather than JSON, so this settings endpoint is the structured way to inspect one script. Requires an API token with Account Workers Scripts Read.

operations.name: List Worker Routes
operations.description: Lists the Workers routes on a zone, showing which URL patterns are handled by which Worker script. Unlike the Workers script endpoints, routes are zone-scoped. Requires an API token with Zone Workers Routes Read.

operations.name: List Tunnels
operations.description: Lists the Cloudflare Tunnels (cloudflared) in an account, with their health status and active connections. Requires an API token with Account Cloudflare Tunnel Read.

operations.name: Get Tunnel
operations.description: Reads a single Cloudflare Tunnel (cloudflared), including its health status and active connector connections. Requires an API token with Account Cloudflare Tunnel Read.

operations.name: Get Tunnel Configuration
operations.description: Reads the configuration of a remotely-managed Cloudflare Tunnel — its ingress rules, origin request settings, and WARP routing. Only tunnels whose configuration source is "cloudflare" have a remote configuration; locally-managed tunnels keep it in their own config file. Requires an API token with Account Cloudflare Tunnel Read.

operations.name: Drift Detection Status
operations.description: Check the status of a stack drift detection operation

operations.description: Retrieve the template body for a CloudFormation stack

operations.name: Get Template Summary
operations.description: Get a summary of a template or deployed stack: resource types, required capabilities, and parameters, without full validation

operations.name: Validate Template
operations.description: Validate a CloudFormation template for syntax and structural correctness

integrations.name: CloudTrail
integrations.description: Audit who did what in AWS with CloudTrail event history and Lake queries
integrations.longDescription: Integrate AWS CloudTrail into workflows. Look up the last 90 days of management and Insights events by user, event name, resource, or access key; inspect trail configuration, logging status, and event selectors; and run SQL queries against CloudTrail Lake event data stores. This block never changes trail or event data store configuration, and never starts or stops logging. Starting and cancelling a Lake query are the only actions that are not reads, and AWS bills Lake queries on the data they scan. Requires AWS access key and secret access key.

operations.name: Describe Trails

operations.name: Get Trail

operations.name: Get Event Selectors

operations.name: Get Insight Selectors

operations.name: Start Lake Query
operations.description: Start a CloudTrail Lake SQL query over an event data store

operations.name: Describe Lake Query
operations.description: Check the status, run time, and scan statistics of a CloudTrail Lake query

operations.name: Get Lake Query Results

operations.name: Cancel Lake Query

operations.description: List the CloudTrail Lake event data stores in the account for the current Region

operations.name: Get Event Data Store
operations.description: Retrieve the configuration of a single CloudTrail Lake event data store

operations.name: List Tags

operations.name: List Pipelines

operations.name: List Action Executions

integrations.name: Context.dev
integrations.description: Scrape, crawl, search, extract, and enrich web and brand data
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Context.dev into the workflow. Scrape pages to markdown or HTML, capture screenshots, list images, crawl entire sites, map sitemaps, search the web, extract structured data and products, pull design systems, classify industries, and retrieve brand assets by domain, name, email, ticker, or transaction — all from one API.

operations.name: Scrape Markdown
operations.description: Scrape any URL and return clean, LLM-ready markdown content.

operations.name: Scrape HTML
operations.description: Scrape any URL and return the raw HTML content of the page.

operations.name: Scrape Images
operations.description: Discover every image asset on a page, with optional dimension and type enrichment.

operations.name: Screenshot
operations.description: Capture a screenshot of any web page and store it as a downloadable image file.

operations.name: Crawl Website
operations.description: Crawl an entire website and return each discovered page as clean markdown.

operations.name: Map Sitemap
operations.description: Build a sitemap of a domain and return every discovered page URL.

operations.name: Web Search
operations.description: Search the web with natural language and optionally scrape results to markdown.

operations.name: Extract Structured Data
operations.description: Crawl a website and extract structured data matching a provided JSON schema.

operations.name: Extract Product
operations.description: Detect and extract structured product details from a single product page URL.

operations.name: Extract Products
operations.description: Extract the product catalog from a brand's website by domain (beta).

operations.name: Scrape Fonts
operations.description: Extract the font families, usage stats, and font files used by a domain.

operations.name: Scrape Styleguide
operations.description: Extract a domain's design system: colors, typography, spacing, shadows, and UI components.

operations.name: Classify NAICS
operations.description: Classify a brand into NAICS industry codes from its domain or company name.

operations.name: Classify SIC
operations.description: Classify a brand into SIC industry codes from its domain or company name.

operations.name: Get Brand by Domain
operations.description: Retrieve brand data for a domain: logos, colors, backdrops, socials, address, and industry.

operations.name: Get Brand by Name
operations.description: Retrieve brand data by company name: logos, colors, socials, address, and industry.

operations.name: Get Brand by Email
operations.description: Retrieve brand data from a work email address. Free/disposable emails are rejected (422).

operations.name: Get Brand by Ticker
operations.description: Retrieve brand data for a public company by its stock ticker symbol.

operations.name: Identify Transaction
operations.description: Identify the brand behind a raw bank/card transaction descriptor and return its brand data.

integrations.name: Convex
integrations.description: Use Convex database
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Convex into the workflow. Run query, mutation, and action functions on your deployment, list tables with their schemas, and export documents with snapshot pagination and change deltas.

operations.name: Run Query
operations.description: Run a Convex query function and return its result

operations.name: Run Mutation
operations.description: Run a Convex mutation function to write data and return its result

operations.name: Run Action
operations.description: Run a Convex action function and return its result

operations.name: Run Function
operations.description: Run any Convex function (query, mutation, or action) by path without specifying its type

operations.name: List Tables
operations.description: List all tables in a Convex deployment along with their JSON schemas. Requires streaming export, available on Convex paid plans.

operations.name: List Documents
operations.description: List documents from a Convex table via a paginated snapshot. Pass the returned snapshot and page cursor back in to fetch the next page. Requires streaming export, available on Convex paid plans.

operations.name: Document Deltas
operations.description: List documents that changed after a snapshot or previous delta cursor. Deleted documents are returned with a _deleted flag. Requires streaming export, available on Convex paid plans.

integrations.name: CrowdStrike
integrations.description: Investigate and respond to CrowdStrike Falcon alerts, hosts, IOCs, and vulnerabilities
integrations.longDescription: Integrate CrowdStrike Falcon into workflows to triage alerts, contain hosts, manage host groups and custom indicators of compromise, review Spotlight vulnerabilities, run read-only Real Time Response commands, read Case Management cases, and query Identity Protection sensors.

operations.name: Query Alerts
operations.description: Search CrowdStrike Falcon alerts with a Falcon Query Language filter and return their composite IDs. Uses the current Alerts API (GET /alerts/queries/alerts/v2), which replaced the Detects API decommissioned on September 30, 2025. Requires the "Alerts: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Get Alert Details
operations.description: Get full CrowdStrike Falcon alert records for one or more composite alert IDs (POST /alerts/entities/alerts/v2). Requires the "Alerts: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Update Alerts
operations.description: Update CrowdStrike Falcon alerts by composite ID: change status, assign or unassign an analyst, add or remove tags, append a comment, or toggle visibility (PATCH /alerts/entities/alerts/v3). This modifies live alerts in the Falcon console. Requires the "Alerts: Write" API scope.

operations.name: Perform Host Action
operations.description: Act on CrowdStrike Falcon hosts (POST /devices/entities/devices-actions/v2). Actions: contain, lift_containment, hide_host, unhide_host, detection_suppress, detection_unsuppress. contain network-isolates the host so it can only reach the Falcon cloud; hide_host removes the host record from the console. Both are immediately disruptive. Up to 100 host IDs per call. Requires the "Hosts: Write" API scope.

operations.name: Query Host Groups
operations.description: Search CrowdStrike Falcon host groups with a Falcon Query Language filter and return their IDs (GET /devices/queries/host-groups/v1). Requires the "Host groups: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Get Host Group Details
operations.description: Get CrowdStrike Falcon host group records for one or more group IDs (GET /devices/entities/host-groups/v1). Requires the "Host groups: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Perform Host Group Action
operations.description: Add hosts to or remove hosts from a CrowdStrike Falcon static host group (POST /devices/entities/host-group-actions/v1). Group membership drives policy assignment, so changing it changes which policies apply to those hosts. Requires the "Host groups: Write" API scope.

operations.name: Query Indicators
operations.description: Search custom CrowdStrike Falcon indicators of compromise (IOCs) with a Falcon Query Language filter and return their IDs (GET /iocs/queries/indicators/v1). Requires the "IOC Management: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Get Indicator Details
operations.description: Get custom CrowdStrike Falcon indicator of compromise (IOC) records for one or more IOC IDs (GET /iocs/entities/indicators/v1). Requires the "IOC Management: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Create Indicators
operations.description: Create custom CrowdStrike Falcon indicators of compromise (POST /iocs/entities/indicators/v1). Each indicator can allow, detect, or block activity across the fleet, so a wrong value can suppress detections or break legitimate software. Requires the "IOC Management: Write" API scope.

operations.name: Update Indicators
operations.description: Update custom CrowdStrike Falcon indicators of compromise by ID (PATCH /iocs/entities/indicators/v1). DESTRUCTIVE: omitted fields may be cleared, so read each indicator with crowdstrike_get_indicator_details first and resend its full field set with your edits applied. Changing action or scope changes prevention behavior fleet-wide. type and value are immutable. Requires the "IOC Management: Write" API scope.

operations.name: Delete Indicators
operations.description: Permanently delete custom CrowdStrike Falcon indicators of compromise (DELETE /iocs/entities/indicators/v1). Cannot be undone; deleting a blocking indicator removes that protection from every host, and a broad filter can delete far more than intended. Supply an ID list or a filter, never both -- CrowdStrike lets a filter silently override the IDs, so this tool rejects that instead. Requires the "IOC Management: Write" API scope.

operations.name: Query Vulnerabilities
operations.description: Search CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight vulnerabilities with a required Falcon Query Language filter and return their IDs (GET /spotlight/queries/vulnerabilities/v1). Requires the spotlight-vulnerabilities:read API scope, shown as "Vulnerabilities: Read" in the Falcon API client UI.

operations.name: Get Vulnerability Details
operations.description: Get CrowdStrike Falcon Spotlight vulnerability records for one or more vulnerability IDs, including CVE, affected host, application, and remediation details (GET /spotlight/entities/vulnerabilities/v2). Requires the spotlight-vulnerabilities:read API scope, shown as "Vulnerabilities: Read" in the Falcon API client UI.

operations.name: Init RTR Session
operations.description: Open a CrowdStrike Falcon Real Time Response session against a host so read-only commands can be run on it (POST /real-time-response/entities/sessions/v1). This connects a live remote shell to the endpoint. Requires the "Real time response: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Execute RTR Command
operations.description: Run a read-only Real Time Response command in an open CrowdStrike Falcon session (POST /real-time-response/entities/command/v1). baseCommand names the family only (cat, cd, clear, csrutil, env, eventlog, filehash, getsid, help, history, ifconfig, ipconfig, ls, mount, netstat, ps, reg, users); subcommands go in commandString. Host-modifying commands need the Active Responder or Admin endpoints. Requires the "Real time response: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Get RTR Command Status
operations.description: Get the status and output of a Real Time Response command by cloud request ID (GET /real-time-response/entities/command/v1). Long output is chunked across sequences, so increment the sequence ID to read the next chunk. Requires the "Real time response: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Delete RTR Session
operations.description: Close an open CrowdStrike Falcon Real Time Response session (DELETE /real-time-response/entities/sessions/v1). Requires the "Real time response: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Query Cases
operations.description: Search CrowdStrike Falcon Case Management cases with a Falcon Query Language filter and return their IDs (GET /cases/queries/cases/v1). Case Management supersedes the CrowdScore Incidents API, which CrowdStrike has removed from its published API spec. Requires the "Cases: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Get Case Details
operations.description: Get CrowdStrike Falcon Case Management case records for one or more case IDs (POST /cases/entities/cases/v2). Requires the "Cases: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Query Sensors
operations.description: Search CrowdStrike Identity Protection sensors -- the domain controllers Falcon Identity Protection monitors, not Falcon endpoint sensors -- and return their device IDs (GET /identity-protection/queries/devices/v1). Sort uses the dot form, for example status.desc. Requires the "Identity Protection Entities: Read" API scope, a separate entitlement from Hosts and Alerts.

operations.name: Get Sensor Details
operations.description: Get CrowdStrike Identity Protection sensor details for one or more device IDs (POST /identity-protection/entities/devices/GET/v1). These are the domain controllers Falcon Identity Protection monitors, not Falcon endpoint sensors. Requires the "Identity Protection Entities: Read" API scope.

operations.name: Get Sensor Aggregates
operations.description: Aggregate CrowdStrike Identity Protection sensors from a JSON aggregate query body (POST /identity-protection/aggregates/devices/GET/v1). These are the domain controllers Falcon Identity Protection monitors, not Falcon endpoint sensors. Requires the "Identity Protection Entities: Read" API scope.

integrations.name: Crunchbase
integrations.description: Search and look up companies, people, funding rounds, and acquisitions
integrations.longDescription: Integrates the Crunchbase Data API into the workflow. Search organizations, people, funding rounds, and acquisitions with filter predicates, reach the other 39 collections through the generic search and lookup operations, page a single related-entity card past its 100-item cap, autocomplete names into identifiers, follow the deleted-entity feed, and list the fields each collection publishes. Which collections and fields resolve depends on your Crunchbase license.

operations.name: Search Organizations
operations.description: Search Crunchbase companies, investors, and schools with filter predicates on funding, headcount, location, category, and rank.

operations.name: Get Organization
operations.description: Look up a single Crunchbase organization by permalink or UUID, returning the requested fields and related cards.

operations.name: Search People
operations.description: Search Crunchbase people — founders, executives, and investors — with filter predicates on job title, organization, location, and rank.

operations.name: Get Person
operations.description: Look up a single Crunchbase person by permalink or UUID, returning the requested fields and related cards.

operations.name: Search Funding Rounds
operations.description: Search Crunchbase funding rounds with filter predicates on announced date, investment type, amount raised, and investors.

operations.name: Get Funding Round
operations.description: Look up a single Crunchbase funding round by permalink or UUID, returning the requested fields and related cards.

operations.name: Search Acquisitions
operations.description: Search Crunchbase acquisitions with filter predicates on announced date, price, acquisition type, and the companies involved.

operations.name: Get Acquisition
operations.description: Look up a single Crunchbase acquisition by permalink or UUID, returning the requested fields and related cards.

operations.name: Search Any Collection
operations.description: Search any Crunchbase collection — events, jobs, ipos, funds, investments, press references, layoffs, insights, predictions, and more — with filter predicates.

operations.name: Get Any Entity
operations.description: Look up a single entity in any Crunchbase collection — events, jobs, ipos, funds, investments, press references, insights, predictions, and more — by permalink or UUID.

operations.name: Get Entity Card
operations.description: Page through one related-entity card of a Crunchbase entity — an investor's investments, a company's founders, a round's investors — past the 100-item cap an inline card request returns.

operations.name: Autocomplete
operations.description: Suggest Crunchbase entities matching a typed query, returning the permalinks and UUIDs the lookup and search operations take.

operations.name: List Deleted Entities
operations.description: List entities Crunchbase has deleted, so a mirrored copy can be pruned in step with the source.

operations.name: Get Fields Metadata
operations.description: List the field ids, types, and descriptions each Crunchbase collection publishes, which is how the field_ids and query predicates of the other operations are discovered.

integrations.name: Cursor
integrations.description: Launch and manage Cursor cloud agents to work on GitHub repositories
integrations.longDescription: Interact with Cursor Cloud Agents API to launch AI agents that can work on your GitHub repositories. Supports launching agents, adding follow-up instructions, checking status, viewing conversations, and managing agent lifecycle.

operations.name: Launch Agent
operations.description: Start a new cloud agent to work on a GitHub repository with the given instructions.

operations.name: Add Follow-up
operations.description: Add a follow-up instruction to an existing cloud agent.

operations.name: Get Agent Status
operations.description: Retrieve the current status and results of a cloud agent.

operations.name: Get Conversation
operations.description: Retrieve the conversation history of a cloud agent, including all user prompts and assistant responses.

operations.name: List Agents
operations.description: List all cloud agents for the authenticated user with optional pagination.

operations.name: Stop Agent
operations.description: Stop a running cloud agent. This pauses the agent without deleting it.

operations.name: Delete Agent
operations.description: Permanently delete a cloud agent. This action cannot be undone.

operations.name: List Artifacts
operations.description: List generated artifact files for a cloud agent.

operations.name: Download Artifact
operations.description: Download a generated artifact file from a cloud agent.

operations.name: List Models
operations.description: List the models available for launching cloud agents.

operations.name: List Repositories
operations.description: List the GitHub repositories accessible to the authenticated user.

operations.name: Get API Key Info
operations.description: Retrieve details about the API key currently in use.

integrations.name: Dagster
integrations.description: Orchestrate data pipelines and manage job runs with Dagster
integrations.longDescription: Connect to a Dagster instance to launch job runs, monitor run status, list available jobs across repositories, terminate or delete runs, reexecute failed runs, fetch run logs, and manage schedules and sensors. API token only required for Dagster+.

operations.name: Launch Run
operations.description: Launch a job run on a Dagster instance.

operations.name: Get Run
operations.description: Get the status and details of a Dagster run by its ID.

operations.name: Get Run Logs
operations.description: Fetch execution event logs for a Dagster run.

operations.name: List Runs
operations.description: List Dagster runs with optional filters by job name, status, and creation-time range, plus cursor pagination.

operations.name: List Jobs
operations.description: List all jobs across repositories in a Dagster instance.

operations.name: Reexecute Run
operations.description: Reexecute an existing Dagster run, optionally resuming only from failed steps.

operations.name: Terminate Run
operations.description: Terminate an in-progress Dagster run.

operations.name: Delete Run
operations.description: Permanently delete a Dagster run record.

operations.name: List Schedules
operations.description: List all schedules in a Dagster repository, optionally filtered by status.

operations.name: Start Schedule
operations.description: Enable (start) a schedule in a Dagster repository.

operations.name: Stop Schedule
operations.description: Disable (stop) a running schedule in Dagster.

operations.name: List Sensors
operations.description: List all sensors in a Dagster repository, optionally filtered by status.

operations.name: Start Sensor
operations.description: Enable (start) a sensor in a Dagster repository.

operations.name: Stop Sensor
operations.description: Disable (stop) a running sensor in Dagster.

operations.name: List Assets
operations.description: List assets tracked by a Dagster instance, optionally filtered by key prefix.

operations.name: Get Asset
operations.description: Get an asset definition and its latest materialization by asset key.

operations.name: Materialize Assets
operations.description: Materialize selected assets by launching their asset job with an asset selection.

operations.name: Report Asset Materialization
operations.description: Report an external (runless) materialization or observation for an asset.

operations.name: Wipe Asset
operations.description: DESTRUCTIVE: permanently wipes ALL materialization history (every partition) for an asset. This cannot be undone.

integrations.name: Databricks
integrations.description: Run SQL queries and manage jobs on Databricks
integrations.longDescription: Connect to Databricks to execute SQL queries against SQL warehouses, trigger and monitor job runs, manage clusters, and retrieve run outputs. Requires a Personal Access Token and workspace host URL.

operations.name: Execute SQL
operations.description: Execute a SQL statement against a Databricks SQL warehouse and return results inline. Supports parameterized queries and Unity Catalog.

operations.name: Get Statement
operations.description: Poll a SQL statement by its ID to retrieve status and results. Use this after Execute SQL when a query runs longer than the wait timeout.

operations.name: List Warehouses
operations.description: List all SQL warehouses in a Databricks workspace including their size, state, and type. Use this to discover the warehouse ID needed for Execute SQL.

operations.name: List Jobs
operations.description: List all jobs in a Databricks workspace with optional filtering by name.

operations.name: Get Job
operations.description: Get the full definition and settings of a single Databricks job by its job ID.

operations.name: Run Job
operations.description: Trigger an existing Databricks job to run immediately with optional job-level or notebook parameters.

operations.name: Get Run
operations.description: Get the status, timing, and details of a Databricks job run by its run ID.

operations.name: List Runs
operations.description: List job runs in a Databricks workspace with optional filtering by job, status, and time range.

operations.name: Cancel Run
operations.description: Cancel a running or pending Databricks job run. Cancellation is asynchronous; poll the run status to confirm termination.

operations.name: Get Run Output
operations.description: Get the output of a completed Databricks job run, including notebook results, error messages, and logs. For multi-task jobs, use the task run ID (not the parent run ID).

operations.name: List Clusters
operations.description: List all clusters in a Databricks workspace including their state, configuration, and resource details.

operations.name: Get Cluster
operations.description: Get the state, configuration, and resource details of a single Databricks cluster by its cluster ID.

integrations.name: Datadog
integrations.description: Monitor infrastructure, applications, and logs with Datadog
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Datadog monitoring into workflows. Submit metrics, manage monitors, query logs, create events, handle downtimes, and more.

operations.name: Submit Metrics
operations.description: Submit custom metrics to Datadog. Use for tracking application performance, business metrics, or custom monitoring data.

operations.name: Query Timeseries
operations.description: Query metric timeseries data from Datadog. Use for analyzing trends, creating reports, or retrieving metric values.

operations.name: Create Event
operations.description: Post an event to the Datadog event stream. Use for deployment notifications, alerts, or any significant occurrences.

operations.name: Create Monitor
operations.description: Create a new monitor/alert in Datadog. Monitors can track metrics, service checks, events, and more.

operations.name: Get Monitor
operations.description: Retrieve details of a specific monitor by ID.

operations.name: List Monitors
operations.description: List all monitors in Datadog with optional filtering by name, tags, or state.

operations.name: Mute Monitor
operations.description: Mute a monitor to temporarily suppress its notifications. Use Unmute Monitor to reverse it, or schedule a downtime instead when you want a planned, auditable maintenance window.

operations.name: Unmute Monitor
operations.description: Unmute a monitor so it resumes sending notifications. Reverses Mute Monitor, either for one scope or for every scope at once.

operations.name: Query Logs
operations.description: Search and retrieve logs from Datadog. Use for troubleshooting, analysis, or monitoring.

operations.name: Send Logs
operations.description: Send log entries to Datadog for centralized logging and analysis.

operations.name: Create Downtime
operations.description: Schedule a downtime to suppress monitor notifications during maintenance windows.

operations.name: List Downtimes
operations.description: List all scheduled downtimes in Datadog.

operations.name: Cancel Downtime
operations.description: Cancel a scheduled downtime.

operations.name: List Incidents
operations.description: List incidents for the organization. Requires the Incident Management `incident_read` permission; the Incidents API is in public beta.

operations.name: Get Incident
operations.description: Get the details of a single incident by ID. Requires the Incident Management `incident_read` permission; the Incidents API is in public beta.

operations.name: Create Incident
operations.description: Declare a new incident. Requires the Incident Management `incident_write` permission; the Incidents API is in public beta.

operations.name: Update Incident
operations.description: Partially update an existing incident. Requires the Incident Management `incident_write` permission; the Incidents API is in public beta.

operations.name: Add Incident Todo
operations.description: Add a follow-up task (todo) to an incident. Requires the Incident Management `incident_write` permission; the Incidents API is in public beta.

operations.name: List SLOs
operations.description: List service level objectives, optionally filtered by IDs, name, tags, or underlying metrics query.

operations.name: Get SLO
operations.description: Get the configuration of a single service level objective by ID.

operations.name: Create SLO
operations.description: Create a service level objective from a metric query, monitors, or a time-slice condition.

operations.name: Update SLO
operations.description: Update a service level objective. Reads the current SLO first and applies only the fields you supply, so anything left blank keeps its stored value.

operations.name: Delete SLO
operations.description: Permanently delete a service level objective. Datadog returns a conflict when the SLO is still referenced by a dashboard.

operations.name: Get SLO History
operations.description: Get an SLO’s history over a time window, including the overall SLI value and remaining error budget.

operations.name: List Dashboards
operations.description: List custom created or cloned dashboards. Datadog preset dashboards are not returned.

operations.name: Get Dashboard
operations.description: Get the full definition of a dashboard, including its widgets.

operations.name: Create Dashboard
operations.description: Create a dashboard from a title, layout type, and widget definitions.

operations.name: Delete Dashboard
operations.description: Delete a dashboard by ID.

operations.name: List Synthetic Tests
operations.description: List all Synthetic tests (API, browser, and mobile) with their current status.

operations.name: Get Synthetic Test
operations.description: Get the configuration of a Synthetic test by public ID. Browser test steps are not included by this type-agnostic endpoint.

operations.name: Get Synthetic Test Results
operations.description: Get the latest result summaries (up to the last 150 runs) for a Synthetic API test.

operations.name: Get Browser Synthetic Test Results
operations.description: Get the latest result summaries (up to the last 150 runs) for a Synthetic browser test, including step counts and errors.

operations.name: Trigger Synthetic Tests
operations.description: Trigger an immediate run of one or more Synthetic tests by public ID.

operations.name: Pause Or Start Synthetic Test
operations.description: Pause or resume a Synthetic test by setting its status to "paused" or "live".

operations.name: List Security Signals
operations.description: Search Cloud SIEM security signals by query and time range. Requires the `security_monitoring_signals_read` permission.

operations.name: Get Security Signal
operations.description: Get the details of a single Cloud SIEM security signal. Requires the `security_monitoring_signals_read` permission.

operations.name: Update Security Signal State
operations.description: Change the triage state of a Cloud SIEM security signal to open, under_review, or archived. Requires the `security_monitoring_signals_write` permission.

operations.name: Assign Security Signal
operations.description: Assign a Cloud SIEM security signal to a Datadog user by UUID. Requires the `security_monitoring_signals_write` permission.

operations.name: List Security Rules
operations.description: List Cloud SIEM detection rules. Requires the `security_monitoring_rules_read` permission.

operations.name: Search Spans
operations.description: Search indexed APM spans using the span query syntax, with cursor pagination.

operations.name: List Services
operations.description: List service definitions from the Datadog Service Catalog. Requires the `apm_service_catalog_read` permission.

integrations.name: Datagma
integrations.description: Find verified B2B emails, mobile phones, and enrich person or company profiles
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Datagma to find verified work emails from a name and company, enrich person profiles via email or LinkedIn URL, enrich company data from a domain or name, look up mobile phone numbers from LinkedIn, and check your credit balance.

operations.name: Find Email
operations.description: Find a verified work email from a person's full name and company. Uses 1 credit when a verified email is found.

operations.name: Enrich Person
operations.description: Enrich a person's profile using their email, LinkedIn URL, or full name and company. Returns job title, company, location, and social data. Uses 2 credits per match; add 30 credits when a phone number is found.

operations.name: Enrich Company
operations.description: Enrich a company profile using a domain, company name, or SIREN number (France). Returns size, industry, revenue, and description. Uses 2 credits per match.

operations.name: Find Phone
operations.description: Find a mobile phone number from a person's LinkedIn URL. Optionally supply an email to improve match accuracy. Uses 30 credits when a number is found.

operations.name: Get Remaining Credits
operations.description: Check remaining credit balance on a Datagma account. Free — no credits consumed.

integrations.name: Daytona
integrations.description: Run code and commands in secure cloud sandboxes
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Daytona into your workflow to run AI-generated code in secure, isolated sandboxes. Create and manage sandboxes, execute shell commands, run Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript code, transfer files, and clone Git repositories.

operations.name: Create Sandbox
operations.description: Create a new Daytona sandbox for running AI-generated code in isolation

operations.name: Run Code
operations.description: Run Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript code inside a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Execute Command
operations.description: Execute a shell command inside a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Upload File
operations.description: Upload a file to a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: List Files
operations.description: List files in a directory of a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Git Clone
operations.description: Clone a Git repository into a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: List Sandboxes
operations.description: List Daytona sandboxes in the organization

operations.name: Get Sandbox
operations.description: Get details of a Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Start Sandbox
operations.description: Start a stopped Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Stop Sandbox
operations.description: Stop a running Daytona sandbox

operations.name: Delete Sandbox
operations.description: Delete a Daytona sandbox

integrations.name: Devin
integrations.description: Autonomous AI software engineer
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Devin into your workflow. Create sessions to assign coding tasks, send messages to guide active sessions, and retrieve session status and results. Devin autonomously writes, runs, and tests code.

operations.name: Create Session
operations.description: Create a new Devin session with a prompt. Devin will autonomously work on the task described in the prompt.

operations.name: Get Session
operations.description: Retrieve details of an existing Devin session including status, tags, pull requests, and structured output.

operations.name: List Sessions
operations.description: List Devin sessions in the organization. Returns up to 100 sessions by default.

operations.name: Send Message
operations.description: Send a message to a Devin session. If the session is suspended, it will be automatically resumed. Returns the updated session state.

operations.name: List Session Messages
operations.description: List the messages exchanged in a Devin session, including messages from both the user and Devin.

operations.name: List Session Attachments
operations.description: List the files uploaded to or produced by a Devin session.

operations.name: Get Session Tags
operations.description: Retrieve the tags currently applied to a Devin session.

operations.name: Append Session Tags
operations.description: Add tags to a Devin session without removing existing tags (max 50 tags total).

operations.name: Replace Session Tags
operations.description: Replace all tags on a Devin session with a new set of tags (max 50 tags).

operations.name: Archive Session
operations.description: Archive a Devin session. Archived sessions can still be viewed but cannot be modified or resumed.

operations.name: Terminate Session
operations.description: Terminate a Devin session. Optionally archive the session instead of permanently terminating it.

integrations.name: Discord
integrations.description: Interact with Discord
integrations.longDescription: Comprehensive Discord integration: messages, threads, channels, roles, members, invites, and webhooks.

operations.name: Send Message

operations.name: Get Channel Messages

operations.name: Get Server Information

operations.name: Get User Information

operations.name: Edit Message

operations.name: Delete Message

operations.name: Add Reaction

operations.name: Pin Message
