operations.name: Unpin Message
operations.description: Unpin a message in a Discord channel

operations.name: Get Pinned Messages
operations.description: Retrieve all pinned messages in a Discord channel

operations.name: Create Thread
operations.description: Create a thread in a Discord channel

operations.name: Join Thread
operations.description: Join a thread in Discord

operations.name: Leave Thread
operations.description: Leave a thread in Discord

operations.name: Archive Thread
operations.description: Archive or unarchive a thread in Discord

operations.name: Create Channel
operations.description: Create a new channel in a Discord server

operations.name: Update Channel
operations.description: Update a Discord channel

operations.name: Delete Channel
operations.description: Delete a Discord channel

operations.name: Get Channel
operations.description: Get information about a Discord channel

operations.name: List Channels
operations.description: List all channels in a Discord server

operations.name: Create Role
operations.description: Create a new role in a Discord server

operations.name: Update Role
operations.description: Update a role in a Discord server

operations.name: Delete Role
operations.description: Delete a role from a Discord server

operations.name: Assign Role
operations.description: Assign a role to a member in a Discord server

operations.name: Remove Role
operations.description: Remove a role from a member in a Discord server

operations.name: List Roles
operations.description: List all roles in a Discord server

operations.name: Kick Member
operations.description: Kick a member from a Discord server

operations.name: Ban Member
operations.description: Ban a member from a Discord server

operations.name: Unban Member
operations.description: Unban a member from a Discord server

operations.name: Get Member
operations.description: Get information about a member in a Discord server

operations.name: Update Member
operations.description: Update a member in a Discord server (e.g., change nickname)

operations.name: Create Invite
operations.description: Create an invite link for a Discord channel

operations.name: Get Invite
operations.description: Get information about a Discord invite

operations.name: Delete Invite
operations.description: Delete a Discord invite

operations.name: Create Webhook
operations.description: Create a webhook in a Discord channel

operations.name: Execute Webhook
operations.description: Execute a Discord webhook to send a message

operations.name: Get Webhook
operations.description: Get information about a Discord webhook

operations.name: Delete Webhook
operations.description: Delete a Discord webhook

integrations.name: DocuSign
integrations.description: Send documents for e-signature via DocuSign
integrations.longDescription: Create and send envelopes for e-signature, use templates, check signing status, download signed documents, and manage recipients with DocuSign.

operations.name: Send Envelope
operations.description: Create and send a DocuSign envelope with a document for e-signature

operations.name: Send from Template
operations.description: Create and send a DocuSign envelope using a pre-built template

operations.name: Get Envelope
operations.description: Get the details and status of a DocuSign envelope

operations.name: List Envelopes
operations.description: List envelopes from your DocuSign account with optional filters

operations.name: Void Envelope
operations.description: Void (cancel) a sent DocuSign envelope that has not yet been completed

operations.name: Download Document
operations.description: Download a signed document from a completed DocuSign envelope

operations.name: List Templates
operations.description: List available templates in your DocuSign account

operations.name: List Recipients
operations.description: Get the recipient status details for a DocuSign envelope

integrations.name: Downdetector
integrations.description: Monitor outages and service status with Downdetector
integrations.longDescription: Track real-time service outages with the Downdetector Enterprise API. Search monitored companies, read their current status and report trends, inspect problem indicators, and pull incident timelines to power outage alerts and dashboards. Requires a Downdetector Enterprise API plan.

operations.name: Search Companies
operations.description: Search Downdetector for monitored companies by name, slug, country, or category. Returns matching companies with their ids and slugs, which you can use with the other Downdetector operations.

operations.name: Get Company
operations.description: Get details for a Downdetector company by id, including its current status, 24h report statistics, baseline, and available problem indicators.

operations.name: Get Company Status
operations.description: Get the current detected status for a Downdetector company. Returns "success" (no problems), "warning", or "danger" (likely outage).

operations.name: Get Company Baseline
operations.description: Get the current baseline report value for a Downdetector company. This is the expected average number of reports for the current period, used to judge whether current reports are abnormal.

operations.name: Get Company Last 15 Minutes
operations.description: Get the number of outage reports for a Downdetector company over the last 15 minutes. A convenient near-real-time signal for threshold-based alerting.

operations.name: Get Company Indicators
operations.description: Get the problem indicators (e.g. "App crashing", "Login", "Server connection") reported for a Downdetector company over a time period, with the report counts and percentages for each.

operations.name: Get Reports
operations.description: Get the number of outage reports over time for one or more company slugs, bucketed by interval. Useful for plotting report trends or detecting spikes. Defaults to the last 24 hours.

operations.name: Get Company Incidents
operations.description: Get the list of incidents (outages) for a Downdetector company. Defaults to the last 24 hours unless a date range is provided.

operations.name: Get Company Attribution
operations.description: Get the incident attribution for a Downdetector company while it is in an outage state — whether the issue is internal (isolated) or external (a dependency), the estimated user impact, and the related incident. Requires Incident Attribution access.

operations.name: Get Company Events
operations.description: Get the published events (such as detected outages) for a Downdetector company, including the measured vs expected report volume for each event.

operations.name: Get Site Companies
operations.description: List the companies monitored on a Downdetector site, including each company’s current status. Useful for discovering the companies available on a regional status page.

operations.name: Get Provider
operations.description: Get details for a Downdetector provider (ISP or network operator) by id, such as its name and Downdetector id.

operations.name: List Incidents
operations.description: List all incidents (outages) across every company that were active in the chosen time period, or in the last 24 hours if no date range is provided.

operations.name: List Categories
operations.description: List all Downdetector categories (e.g. "Telecom", "Gaming", "Social Media"). Use the returned category id to filter company searches.

operations.name: List Sites
operations.description: List all available Downdetector sites (regional status-page domains). Each site groups the companies monitored for a given country/region.

integrations.name: Dropbox
integrations.description: Upload, download, share, and manage files in Dropbox
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Dropbox into your workflow for file management, sharing, and collaboration. Upload files, download content, create folders, manage shared links, and more.

operations.name: Upload File
operations.description: Upload a file to Dropbox

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from Dropbox with metadata and content

operations.name: List Folder
operations.description: List the contents of a folder in Dropbox

operations.name: Create Folder
operations.description: Create a new folder in Dropbox

operations.name: Delete File/Folder
operations.description: Delete a file or folder in Dropbox (moves to trash)

operations.name: Copy File/Folder
operations.description: Copy a file or folder in Dropbox

operations.name: Move File/Folder
operations.description: Move or rename a file or folder in Dropbox

operations.name: Get Metadata
operations.description: Get metadata for a file or folder in Dropbox

operations.name: Create Shared Link
operations.description: Create a shareable link for a file or folder in Dropbox

operations.name: List Shared Links
operations.description: List shared links for a path, or for the entire account if no path is given

operations.name: Search Files
operations.description: Search for files and folders in Dropbox

operations.name: List Revisions
operations.description: List the revision history for a file in Dropbox (files only, not folders)

operations.name: Restore File
operations.description: Restore a specific revision of a file to the given path

integrations.name: Dropcontact
integrations.description: Enrich B2B contacts with verified email, phone, and company data
integrations.longDescription: Use Dropcontact to verify and enrich B2B contacts. Submit a contact with their name, company, website, or LinkedIn URL and receive a verified professional email, phone number, company firmographics, and LinkedIn profile. Enrichment is async: Dropcontact processes the request, then Sim polls until the result is ready. Credits are only charged when a verified email is returned.

operations.name: Enrich Contact
operations.description: Enrich a contact with verified B2B email, phone, company data, and LinkedIn info via Dropcontact. Submits an async enrichment request, then polls until the result is ready (up to 2 minutes). Charges 1 credit only when a verified email is returned. Provide at least one of: email, first_name+last_name+company, full_name+company, or linkedin URL.

integrations.name: DSPy
integrations.description: Run predictions using self-hosted DSPy programs
integrations.longDescription: Integrate with your self-hosted DSPy programs for LLM-powered predictions. Supports Predict, Chain of Thought, and ReAct agents. DSPy is the framework for programming—not prompting—language models.

operations.name: Predict
operations.description: Run a prediction using a self-hosted DSPy program endpoint

operations.name: Chain of Thought
operations.description: Run a Chain of Thought prediction using a self-hosted DSPy ChainOfThought program endpoint

operations.name: ReAct Agent
operations.description: Run a ReAct agent using a self-hosted DSPy ReAct program endpoint for multi-step reasoning and action

integrations.name: Dub
integrations.description: Link management with Dub
integrations.longDescription: Create, manage, and track short links with Dub. Supports custom domains, UTM parameters, link analytics, and more.

operations.name: Create Link
operations.description: Create a new short link with Dub. Supports custom domains, slugs, UTM parameters, and more.

operations.name: Upsert Link
operations.description: Create or update a short link by its URL. If a link with the same URL already exists, update it. Otherwise, create a new link.

operations.name: Get Link
operations.description: Retrieve information about a short link by its link ID, external ID, or domain + key combination.

operations.name: Update Link
operations.description: Update an existing short link. You can modify the destination URL, slug, metadata, UTM parameters, and more.

operations.name: Delete Link
operations.description: Delete a short link by its link ID or external ID (prefixed with ext_).

operations.name: List Links
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of short links for the authenticated workspace. Supports filtering by domain, search query, tags, and sorting.

operations.name: Count Links
operations.description: Retrieve the number of short links for the authenticated workspace, optionally filtered and grouped by domain, tag, user, or folder.

operations.name: Bulk Create Links
operations.description: Create up to 100 short links in a single request. Returns the created links alongside any per-link errors.

operations.name: Bulk Update Links
operations.description: Apply the same set of field updates to up to 100 links at once, selected by link IDs or external IDs.

operations.name: Bulk Delete Links
operations.description: Delete up to 100 short links in a single request by their link IDs. Non-existing IDs are ignored.

operations.name: Get Analytics
operations.description: Retrieve analytics for links including clicks, leads, and sales. Supports filtering by link, time range, and grouping by various dimensions.

operations.name: List Events
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated stream of individual click, lead, and sale events for links, with filtering by link, time range, and location.

operations.name: Get QR Code
operations.description: Generate a customizable QR code (PNG) for a short link, with control over size, error correction, colors, and margin.

operations.name: List Domains
operations.description: Retrieve the custom domains registered in the workspace, so links can be created against the right domain.

operations.name: List Tags
operations.description: Retrieve the tags defined in the workspace, so the right tag IDs can be assigned to links.

operations.name: Create Tag
operations.description: Create a new tag in the workspace for organizing and filtering short links.

operations.name: List Folders
operations.description: Retrieve the folders defined in the workspace, so the right folder ID can be used to organize links.

integrations.name: DuckDuckGo
integrations.description: Search with DuckDuckGo
integrations.longDescription: Search the web using DuckDuckGo Instant Answers API. Returns instant answers, abstracts, related topics, and more. Free to use without an API key.

integrations.name: Dynatrace
integrations.description: Manage Dynatrace problems, metrics, entities, logs, SLOs, settings, and security
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Dynatrace into workflows. Investigate and close Davis problems, query metrics and monitored entities, search and ingest logs, push deployment events, manage SLOs and their burn rates, triage and mute Application Security vulnerabilities, review runtime attacks, tag entities, manage settings objects such as maintenance windows and alerting profiles, run synthetic monitors on demand, and read the audit log.

operations.name: List Problems
operations.description: List Davis-detected problems in a Dynatrace environment, filtered by timeframe, problem selector, or entity selector.

operations.name: Get Problem
operations.description: Get the full details of a single Dynatrace problem, including root cause, affected entities, and optionally its evidence and impact analysis.

operations.name: Close Problem
operations.description: Close a Dynatrace problem and record the closing comment.

operations.name: List Problem Comments
operations.description: List the comments recorded on a Dynatrace problem.

operations.name: Add Problem Comment
operations.description: Add a comment to a Dynatrace problem.

operations.name: Query Metrics
operations.description: Read metric data points from Dynatrace using a metric selector, with optional entity and management-zone scoping.

operations.name: List Metrics
operations.description: Discover the metrics available in a Dynatrace environment, filtered by metric selector, free text, or metadata.

operations.name: Get Metric Descriptor
operations.description: Get the descriptor of a single Dynatrace metric — its unit, dimensions, supported aggregations, and transformations.

operations.name: Ingest Metrics
operations.description: Push custom metric data points into Dynatrace using the metric line protocol, one data point per line.

operations.name: List Entities
operations.description: List monitored entities — hosts, services, applications, Kubernetes workloads — matching an entity selector.

operations.name: Get Entity
operations.description: Get the properties, tags, management zones, and relationships of a single monitored entity.

operations.name: List Entity Types
operations.description: List the monitored entity types available in the environment, with the properties and relationships each supports. Use it to build valid entity selectors.

operations.name: List Events
operations.description: List events — deployments, availability changes, alerts, custom annotations — in a Dynatrace environment.

operations.name: Get Event
operations.description: Get the full details of a single Dynatrace event.

operations.name: Ingest Event
operations.description: Push an event into Dynatrace — a deployment marker, custom annotation, or custom alert — attached to the entities matched by an entity selector.

operations.name: Search Logs
operations.description: Search log records in Dynatrace by query and timeframe, for troubleshooting and incident analysis.

operations.name: Ingest Logs
operations.description: Push log events into Dynatrace. Accepts a single log event object or an array of them.

operations.name: List SLOs
operations.description: List service-level objectives with their current attainment, error budget, and burn rate.

operations.name: Get SLO
operations.description: Get a single service-level objective with its evaluated attainment, error budget, and burn rate.

operations.name: List Security Problems
operations.description: List vulnerabilities detected by Dynatrace Application Security, filtered by risk level, status, CVE, or technology.

operations.name: Get Security Problem
operations.description: Get a single vulnerability with its description, remediation guidance, affected entities, and risk assessment.

operations.name: Mute Security Problem
operations.description: Mute a single Dynatrace vulnerability with a reason, for triaging false positives or accepted risk.

operations.name: Unmute Security Problem
operations.description: Unmute a single Dynatrace vulnerability, returning it to the active triage queue.

operations.name: Mute Security Problems (Bulk)
operations.description: Mute several Dynatrace vulnerabilities at once with a shared reason, for bulk triage.

operations.name: Unmute Security Problems (Bulk)
operations.description: Unmute several Dynatrace vulnerabilities at once, returning them to active triage.

operations.name: List Remediation Items
operations.description: List the remediation items of a third-party vulnerability — the components to upgrade, their affected entities, and their mute state.

operations.name: List Attacks
operations.description: List runtime attacks Dynatrace Application Protection detected — injection attempts, their source, and whether they were blocked.

operations.name: Get Attack
operations.description: Get a single attack with its entry point, payload, attacker, and the vulnerability it exploited.

operations.name: List Tags
operations.description: List the custom tags applied to the monitored entities an entity selector matches.

operations.name: Add Tags
operations.description: Add custom tags to every monitored entity an entity selector matches. Tags drive selectors, management zones, and alerting.

operations.name: Delete Tag
operations.description: Remove a custom tag from every monitored entity an entity selector matches. Deletes one key-value pair, or every tag with the key.

operations.name: List Settings Schemas
operations.description: List the settings schemas available in the environment. Use it to find the schema ID for a configuration type such as builtin:alerting.profile.

operations.name: List Settings Objects
operations.description: List settings objects — the configuration behind maintenance windows, alerting profiles, management zones, and anomaly detection.

operations.name: Get Settings Object
operations.description: Get a single settings object with its value and its update token. Read it before updating so the token can guard against a concurrent change.

operations.name: Create Settings Object
operations.description: Create a settings object — a maintenance window, alerting profile, management zone, or any other schema-backed configuration.

operations.name: Update Settings Object
operations.description: Update an existing settings object. Pass the update token from Get Settings Object to fail rather than overwrite a concurrent change.

operations.name: Delete Settings Object
operations.description: Delete a settings object. Dynatrace cannot undo this.

operations.name: List Synthetic Monitors
operations.description: List synthetic monitors and their IDs. Use it to find the monitor IDs to feed into an on-demand execution.

operations.name: Execute Synthetic Monitors
operations.description: Trigger an on-demand batch execution of synthetic monitors, for gating a deploy on a smoke test. Returns a batch ID to poll.

operations.name: Get Synthetic Batch
operations.description: Get the status and failures of an on-demand synthetic batch execution. Poll it after triggering to gate a deploy on the result.

operations.name: Get Problem Comment
operations.description: Get a single comment on a Dynatrace problem.

operations.name: Update Problem Comment
operations.description: Replace the text of an existing comment on a Dynatrace problem.

operations.name: Delete Problem Comment
operations.description: Delete a comment from a Dynatrace problem.

operations.name: Create SLO
operations.description: Create a service-level objective from a metric expression, target, and evaluation timeframe.

operations.name: Update SLO
operations.description: Update an existing service-level objective. Every field is replaced, so send the complete definition.

operations.name: Delete SLO
operations.description: Delete a service-level objective.

operations.name: Get Audit Logs
operations.description: Read the Dynatrace audit log — who changed which configuration, when, and whether it succeeded.

integrations.name: Elasticsearch
integrations.description: Search, index, and manage data in Elasticsearch
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Elasticsearch into workflows for powerful search, indexing, and data management. Supports document CRUD operations, advanced search queries, bulk operations, index management, and cluster monitoring. Works with both self-hosted and Elastic Cloud deployments.

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Search documents in Elasticsearch using Query DSL. Returns matching documents with scores and metadata.

operations.name: Index Document
operations.description: Index (create or update) a document in Elasticsearch.

operations.name: Get Document
operations.description: Retrieve a document by ID from Elasticsearch.

operations.name: Update Document
operations.description: Partially update a document in Elasticsearch using doc merge.

operations.name: Delete Document
operations.description: Delete a document from Elasticsearch by ID.

operations.name: Bulk Operations
operations.description: Perform multiple index, create, delete, or update operations in a single request for high performance.

operations.name: Count Documents
operations.description: Count documents matching a query in Elasticsearch.

operations.name: Create Index
operations.description: Create a new index with optional settings and mappings.

operations.name: Delete Index
operations.description: Delete an index and all its documents. This operation is irreversible.

operations.name: Get Index Info
operations.description: Retrieve index information including settings, mappings, and aliases.

operations.name: List Indices
operations.description: List all indices in the Elasticsearch cluster with their health, status, and statistics.

operations.name: Cluster Health
operations.description: Get the health status of the Elasticsearch cluster.

operations.name: Cluster Stats
operations.description: Get comprehensive statistics about the Elasticsearch cluster.

integrations.name: ElevenLabs
integrations.description: Generate and transform audio with ElevenLabs
integrations.longDescription: Integrate ElevenLabs into the workflow. Convert text to speech, generate sound effects, transform voices, isolate audio, and manage voices, models, and account settings.

operations.name: Text to Speech
operations.description: Convert text to speech using ElevenLabs voices

operations.name: Sound Effects
operations.description: Generate a sound effect from a text prompt using ElevenLabs

operations.name: Speech to Speech
operations.description: Convert audio into a chosen ElevenLabs voice while preserving content and emotion

operations.name: Audio Isolation
operations.description: Remove background noise from an audio file, isolating the speech using ElevenLabs

operations.name: List Voices
operations.description: List the voices available in your ElevenLabs account

operations.name: Get Voice
operations.description: Get metadata and settings for a specific ElevenLabs voice

operations.name: Get Voice Settings
operations.description: Get the configured settings for a specific ElevenLabs voice

operations.name: Edit Voice Settings
operations.description: Update the settings for a specific ElevenLabs voice

operations.name: List Models
operations.description: List the models available in ElevenLabs

operations.name: Get User Info
operations.description: Get account and subscription information for the ElevenLabs user

integrations.name: Email Bison
integrations.description: Manage Email Bison leads, campaigns, replies, and tags
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Email Bison into workflows. Create and update leads, manage campaigns, attach leads to campaigns, list replies, and organize leads with tags.

operations.name: List Leads
operations.description: Retrieves leads from Email Bison with optional search and tag filters.

operations.name: Get Lead
operations.description: Retrieves a lead by Email Bison lead ID or email address.

operations.name: Create Lead
operations.description: Creates a single lead in Email Bison.

operations.name: Update Lead
operations.description: Updates an existing Email Bison lead. Fields omitted from a PUT update may be cleared by Email Bison.

operations.name: List Campaigns
operations.description: Retrieves Email Bison campaigns.

operations.name: Create Campaign
operations.description: Creates a new Email Bison campaign.

operations.name: Update Campaign
operations.description: Updates Email Bison campaign settings.

operations.name: Update Campaign Status

operations.name: Attach Leads to Campaign

operations.name: List Replies
operations.description: Retrieves Email Bison replies with optional status, folder, campaign, sender, lead, and tag filters.

operations.name: List Tags
operations.description: Retrieves all Email Bison tags for the authenticated workspace.

operations.name: Create Tag
operations.description: Creates a new Email Bison tag.

operations.name: Attach Tags to Leads
operations.description: Attaches Email Bison tags to one or more leads.

triggers.name: Email Bison Email Sent
triggers.description: Trigger when a campaign email is sent in Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Contact First Emailed
triggers.description: Trigger when a contact receives their first campaign email in Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Contact Replied
triggers.description: Trigger when a campaign lead replies in Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Contact Interested
triggers.description: Trigger when a reply is marked interested in Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Contact Unsubscribed
triggers.description: Trigger when a contact unsubscribes in Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Untracked Reply Received
triggers.description: Trigger when Email Bison receives a reply not tied to a scheduled campaign email

triggers.name: Email Bison Email Opened
triggers.description: Trigger when an Email Bison campaign email is opened

triggers.name: Email Bison Email Bounced
triggers.description: Trigger when an Email Bison campaign email bounces

triggers.name: Email Bison Email Account Added
triggers.description: Trigger when a sender email account is added to Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Email Account Removed
triggers.description: Trigger when a sender email account is removed from Email Bison

triggers.name: Email Bison Email Account Disconnected

operations.description: Insert an image into a specific slide in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Get Thumbnail
operations.description: Generate a thumbnail image of a specific slide in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Get Page
operations.description: Get detailed information about a specific slide/page in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Delete Object
operations.description: Delete a page element (shape, image, table, etc.) or an entire slide from a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Duplicate Object
operations.description: Duplicate an object (slide, shape, image, table, etc.) in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Reorder Slides
operations.description: Move one or more slides to a new position in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Create Table
operations.description: Create a new table on a slide in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Create Shape
operations.description: Create a shape (rectangle, ellipse, text box, arrow, etc.) on a slide in a Google Slides presentation

operations.name: Create Line
operations.description: Create a line or connector on a slide.

operations.name: Insert Text
operations.description: Insert text into a shape or table cell in a Google Slides presentation. Use this to add text to text boxes, shapes, or table cells.

operations.name: Delete Text
operations.description: Delete text from a shape or table cell. Use range type ALL to clear all text, or FIXED_RANGE / FROM_START_INDEX to delete a specific span.

operations.name: Update Text Style
operations.description: Update the styling of text in a shape or table cell (bold, italic, font family, font size, foreground/background color, link, etc.). Only the fields you set are applied.

operations.name: Update Paragraph Style
operations.description: Update paragraph styling — alignment, line spacing, indents, space above/below — for text in a shape or table cell.

operations.name: Create Paragraph Bullets
operations.description: Convert paragraphs in a shape or table cell into a bulleted or numbered list using a Google Slides bullet preset.

operations.name: Delete Paragraph Bullets
operations.description: Remove bullets/numbering from paragraphs in a shape or table cell.

operations.name: Update Shape Properties
operations.description: Update a shape's appearance — background fill color, outline, link, content alignment, autofit. Pass only the properties you want to change.

operations.name: Update Page Properties
operations.description: Update slide/page background — solid color or stretched picture — and other page properties.

operations.name: Update Slide Properties
operations.description: Update slide-specific properties such as whether the slide is skipped during presentation.

operations.name: Update Alt Text
operations.description: Set the accessibility title and/or description (alt text) of a page element such as an image, shape, or group.

operations.name: Update Element Transform
operations.description: Move, resize, scale, or shear a page element. Translate is specified in points; applyMode controls whether the transform is absolute (default) or relative (multiplied with the current transform).

operations.name: Update Z-Order
operations.description: Bring elements to front, send to back, or step them one layer forward/backward.

operations.name: Group Objects
operations.description: Group two or more page elements on the same slide into a single object group.

operations.name: Ungroup Objects
operations.description: Ungroup one or more object groups, releasing their children back to the slide.

operations.name: Update Line Properties
operations.description: Update line appearance — color, weight, dash style, arrows, link.

operations.name: Update Line Category
operations.description: Change a connector line's category (STRAIGHT, BENT, or CURVED).

operations.name: Reroute Line
operations.description: Reroute a connector line so it efficiently connects its endpoint shapes — useful after moving the shapes the line connects.

operations.name: Insert Table Rows
operations.description: Insert one or more rows into a table, above or below a reference cell.

operations.name: Insert Table Columns
operations.description: Insert one or more columns into a table, left or right of a reference cell.

operations.name: Delete Table Row
operations.description: Delete the row containing the reference cell from a table.

operations.name: Delete Table Column
operations.description: Delete the column containing the reference cell from a table.

operations.name: Merge Table Cells
operations.description: Merge a rectangular range of table cells into a single cell. The range starts at (rowIndex, columnIndex) and covers rowSpan × columnSpan cells.

operations.name: Unmerge Table Cells
operations.description: Unmerge any merged cells within the given table range.

operations.name: Update Table Cell Properties
operations.description: Update background fill and content alignment for a range of table cells.

operations.name: Update Table Border Properties
operations.description: Update border color, weight, and dash style for a position (e.g. ALL, INNER, OUTER) in a table range.

operations.name: Update Table Column Properties
operations.description: Update column widths and other column-level table properties.

operations.name: Update Table Row Properties
operations.description: Update minimum row heights and other row-level table properties.

operations.name: Embed Sheets Chart
operations.description: Embed a chart from a Google Sheets spreadsheet onto a slide. LINKED charts can be refreshed; NOT_LINKED_IMAGE inserts a static image of the chart.

operations.name: Refresh Sheets Chart
operations.description: Refresh an embedded linked Sheets chart so it reflects the latest spreadsheet data.

operations.name: Replace All Shapes With Sheets Chart
operations.description: Find every shape matching a text token (e.g. {{revenue-chart}}) and replace each with the same embedded Sheets chart, preserving the shape's position and bounds.

operations.name: Embed Video
operations.description: Embed a YouTube or Google Drive video on a slide.

operations.name: Update Video Properties
operations.description: Update video playback options (autoPlay, mute, start/end) and outline.

integrations.name: Google Tasks
integrations.description: Manage Google Tasks
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Google Tasks into your workflow. Create, read, update, delete, and list tasks and task lists.

operations.name: Create Task
operations.description: Create a new task in a Google Tasks list

operations.name: List Tasks
operations.description: List all tasks in a Google Tasks list

operations.name: Get Task
operations.description: Retrieve a specific task by ID from a Google Tasks list

operations.name: Update Task
operations.description: Update an existing task in a Google Tasks list

operations.name: Delete Task
operations.description: Delete a task from a Google Tasks list

operations.name: List Task Lists
operations.description: Retrieve all task lists for the authenticated user

integrations.name: Google Translate
integrations.description: Translate text using Google Cloud Translation
integrations.longDescription: Translate and detect languages using the Google Cloud Translation API. Supports auto-detection of the source language.

operations.name: Translate Text
operations.description: Translate text between languages using the Google Cloud Translation API. Supports auto-detection of the source language.

operations.name: Detect Language
operations.description: Detect the language of text using the Google Cloud Translation API.

integrations.name: Google Vault
integrations.description: Search, export, and manage matters, holds, exports, and saved queries in Vault
integrations.longDescription: Connect Google Vault to manage the full matter lifecycle, create and manage holds and exports, and save reusable search queries for eDiscovery and compliance.

operations.name: Create Export
operations.description: Create an export in a matter

operations.name: List Exports
operations.description: List exports for a matter

operations.name: Delete Export
operations.description: Delete an export from a matter

operations.name: Download Export File
operations.description: Download a single file from a Google Vault export (GCS object)

operations.name: Create Hold
operations.description: Create a hold in a matter

operations.name: List Holds
operations.description: List holds for a matter

operations.name: Update Hold
operations.description: Replace the name, query, and scope of an existing hold. This is a full-resource update: fetch the current hold first (Vault List Holds) and resupply every field you want to keep — any field left blank is cleared, not left unchanged.

operations.name: Delete Hold
operations.description: Delete a hold and release its covered accounts

operations.name: Add Held Accounts
operations.description: Add accounts to an existing hold

operations.name: Remove Held Accounts
operations.description: Remove accounts from an existing hold

operations.name: Create Matter
operations.description: Create a new matter in Google Vault

operations.name: List Matters
operations.description: List matters, or get a specific matter if matterId is provided

operations.name: Update Matter
operations.description: Update the name and/or description of a matter

operations.name: Close Matter
operations.description: Close a matter

operations.name: Reopen Matter
operations.description: Reopen a closed matter

operations.name: Delete Matter
operations.description: Permanently delete a matter (must be closed first)

operations.name: Undelete Matter
operations.description: Restore a deleted matter

operations.name: Add Matter Collaborator
operations.description: Add a collaborator (or transfer ownership) to a matter

operations.name: Remove Matter Collaborator
operations.description: Remove a collaborator from a matter

operations.name: Create Saved Query
operations.description: Save a reusable search query in a matter

operations.name: List Saved Queries
operations.description: List saved queries in a matter, or get a specific one if savedQueryId is provided

operations.name: Delete Saved Query
operations.description: Delete a saved query from a matter

integrations.name: Grafana
integrations.description: Interact with Grafana dashboards, alerts, and annotations
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Grafana into workflows. Manage dashboards, alerts, annotations, data sources, folders, and monitor health status.

operations.name: List Dashboards
operations.description: Search and list all dashboards

operations.name: Get Dashboard
operations.description: Get a dashboard by its UID

operations.name: Create Dashboard
operations.description: Create a new dashboard

operations.name: Update Dashboard
operations.description: Update an existing dashboard. Fetches the current dashboard and merges your changes.

operations.name: Delete Dashboard
operations.description: Delete a dashboard by its UID

operations.name: List Alert Rules
operations.description: List all alert rules in the Grafana instance

operations.name: Get Alert Rule
operations.description: Get a specific alert rule by its UID

operations.name: Get Alert Rule Group
operations.description: Read an alert rule group: its evaluation interval and every rule in it. The interval is the group-level knob that decides how often those rules are evaluated, which the individual alert rule operations do not expose.

operations.name: Create Alert Rule
operations.description: Create a new alert rule

operations.name: Update Alert Rule
operations.description: Update an existing alert rule. Fetches the current rule and merges your changes.

operations.name: Delete Alert Rule
operations.description: Delete an alert rule by its UID

operations.name: List Contact Points
operations.description: List all alert notification contact points

operations.name: Create Contact Point
operations.description: Create a notification contact point (e.g., Slack, email, PagerDuty)

operations.name: Update Contact Point
operations.description: Replace a contact point by its UID. Grafana has no partial update for contact points, so every field is rewritten — resend the name, type, and full settings, or the omitted ones are reset.

operations.name: Delete Contact Point
operations.description: Permanently delete a contact point by its UID. Grafana refuses the delete while the contact point is still referenced by the notification policy tree or by an alert rule.

operations.name: Create Annotation
operations.description: Create an annotation on a dashboard or as a global annotation

operations.name: List Annotations
operations.description: Query annotations by time range, dashboard, or tags

operations.name: Update Annotation
operations.description: Update an existing annotation

operations.name: Delete Annotation
operations.description: Delete an annotation by its ID

operations.name: List Data Sources
operations.description: List all data sources configured in Grafana

operations.name: Get Data Source
operations.description: Get a data source by its ID or UID

operations.name: Query Data Source
operations.description: Run one or more queries against a Grafana data source that has a backend implementation, and read the values back. This is how you get actual metric numbers out of Grafana rather than dashboard or alert configuration.

operations.name: Check Data Source Health
operations.description: Test connectivity to a data source by its UID

operations.name: List Folders
operations.description: List all folders in Grafana

operations.name: Create Folder
operations.description: Create a new folder in Grafana

operations.name: Get Folder
operations.description: Get a folder by its UID

operations.name: Update Folder
operations.description: Update (rename) a folder. Fetches the current folder and merges your changes.

operations.name: Delete Folder
operations.description: Delete a folder by its UID

operations.name: Move Folder
operations.description: Move a folder under a different parent folder, or to the root by leaving the parent empty. Returns the folder with its new ancestry.

operations.name: Get Health
operations.description: Check the health of the Grafana instance (version, database status)

integrations.name: Grain
integrations.description: Access meeting recordings, transcripts, and AI summaries
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Grain into your workflow. Access meeting recordings, transcripts, highlights, and AI-generated summaries. Can also trigger workflows based on Grain webhook events.

operations.name: List Recordings
operations.description: List recordings from Grain with optional filters and pagination

operations.name: Get Recording
operations.description: Get details of a single recording by ID

operations.name: Get Transcript
operations.description: Get the full transcript of a recording

operations.name: List Views
operations.description: List available Grain views for webhook subscriptions

operations.name: List Teams
operations.description: List all teams in the workspace

operations.name: List Meeting Types
operations.description: List all meeting types in the workspace

operations.description: List all webhooks for the account

triggers.name: Grain Highlight Updated
triggers.description: Trigger when a highlight/clip is updated in Grain

triggers.name: Grain Highlight Deleted
triggers.description: Trigger when a highlight/clip is deleted in Grain

triggers.name: Grain Story Added
triggers.description: Trigger when a new story is created in Grain

triggers.name: Grain Story Updated
triggers.description: Trigger when a story is updated in Grain

triggers.name: Grain Story Deleted
triggers.description: Trigger when a story is deleted in Grain

triggers.name: Grain Upload Status
triggers.description: Trigger on progress updates for recordings uploaded to Grain

triggers.name: Grain All Events
triggers.description: Trigger on every Grain event (recordings, highlights, stories, uploads)

integrations.name: Granola
integrations.description: Access meeting notes, transcripts, and audit events from Granola
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Granola into your workflow to retrieve meeting notes, summaries, attendees, and transcripts, review workspace audit events, and manage webhook endpoints. Granola can also trigger workflows when notes are generated, edited, or shared with you.

operations.name: List Notes
operations.description: Lists meeting notes from Granola with optional date filters and pagination.

operations.name: Get Note
operations.description: Retrieves a specific meeting note from Granola by ID, including summary, attendees, calendar event details, and optionally the transcript.

operations.name: Get Transcript
operations.description: Retrieves a meeting transcript from Granola one page at a time, including when Get Note reports the transcript is too large to return inline.

operations.name: List Folders
operations.description: Lists folders from Granola, sorted alphabetically, with pagination.

operations.name: List Audit Events
operations.description: Lists workspace audit events from Granola, with optional action and date filters. Events are returned in collection order and retained for one year.

operations.name: Create Webhook Endpoint
operations.description: Registers an HTTPS URL in Granola to receive note event deliveries. The signing secret is returned only by this operation and cannot be retrieved later.

operations.name: List Webhook Endpoints
operations.description: Lists the Granola webhook endpoints the API key can manage. A personal key sees the endpoints it created; a workspace admin sees every endpoint in the workspace. Signing secrets are never included.

operations.name: Update Webhook Endpoint
operations.description: Updates a Granola webhook endpoint. Each supplied field replaces its current value; omitted fields are left unchanged. Use enabled to pause or resume deliveries.

operations.name: Delete Webhook Endpoint
operations.description: Deletes a Granola webhook endpoint by ID, stopping its event deliveries immediately.

triggers.name: Granola Note Generated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when the first AI summary for a Granola note is generated

triggers.name: Granola Note Edited
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Granola note summary is edited or regenerated

triggers.name: Granola Note Access Granted
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Granola note is shared with you, directly or via a folder

triggers.name: Granola Events
triggers.description: Trigger workflow on any Granola note event

integrations.name: Greenhouse
integrations.description: Manage candidates, jobs, and applications in Greenhouse
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Greenhouse into the workflow. List and retrieve candidates, jobs, applications, users, departments, offices, and job stages from your Greenhouse ATS account.

operations.name: List Candidates
operations.description: Lists candidates from Greenhouse with optional filtering by date, job, or email

operations.name: Get Candidate
operations.description: Retrieves a specific candidate by ID with full details including contact info, education, and employment history

operations.name: List Jobs
operations.description: Lists jobs from Greenhouse with optional filtering by status, department, or office

operations.name: Get Job
operations.description: Retrieves a specific job by ID with full details including hiring team, openings, and custom fields

operations.name: List Applications
operations.description: Lists applications from Greenhouse with optional filtering by job, status, or date

operations.name: Get Application
operations.description: Retrieves a specific application by ID with full details including source, stage, answers, and attachments

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: Lists Greenhouse users (recruiters, hiring managers, admins) with optional filtering

operations.name: Get User
operations.description: Retrieves a specific Greenhouse user by ID

operations.name: List Departments
operations.description: Lists all departments configured in Greenhouse

operations.name: List Offices
operations.description: Lists all offices configured in Greenhouse

operations.name: List Job Stages
operations.description: Lists all interview stages for a specific job in Greenhouse

triggers.name: Greenhouse Candidate Hired
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a candidate is hired

triggers.name: Greenhouse New Application
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new application is submitted

triggers.name: Greenhouse Candidate Stage Change
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a candidate changes interview stages

triggers.name: Greenhouse Candidate Rejected
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a candidate is rejected

triggers.name: Greenhouse Offer Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new offer is created

triggers.name: Greenhouse Job Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new job is created

triggers.name: Greenhouse Job Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a job is updated

triggers.name: Greenhouse Webhook (Endpoint Events)
triggers.description: Trigger on whichever event types you select for this URL in Greenhouse. Sim does not filter deliveries for this trigger.

integrations.name: Greptile
integrations.description: AI-powered codebase search and Q&A
integrations.longDescription: Query and search codebases using natural language with Greptile. Get AI-generated answers about your code, find relevant files, and understand complex codebases.

operations.name: Query
operations.description: Query repositories in natural language and get answers with relevant code references. Greptile uses AI to understand your codebase and answer questions.

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Search repositories in natural language and get relevant code references without generating an answer. Useful for finding specific code locations.

operations.name: Index Repository
operations.description: Submit a repository to be indexed by Greptile. Indexing must complete before the repository can be queried. Small repos take 3-5 minutes, larger ones can take over an hour.

operations.name: Check Status
operations.description: Check the indexing status of a repository. Use this to verify if a repository is ready to be queried or to monitor indexing progress.

integrations.name: Harmonic
integrations.description: Search and enrich private-market contacts
integrations.longDescription: Connect a reusable Harmonic team API key, use Scout to find people with natural-language criteria, select team-visible people saved searches, and hydrate person identifiers into normalized contacts for downstream tables, CRM, scoring, and outreach workflows.

operations.name: Search People with Scout
operations.description: Ask Harmonic Scout to find people using natural language and return a stable, workflow-ready contacts table.

operations.name: Enrich Person
operations.description: Resolve a LinkedIn profile URL or email address into a normalized Harmonic contact, queueing enrichment when the person is not yet in Harmonic.

operations.name: Get Person
operations.description: Fetch one Harmonic person by numeric ID or URN, including any email resolved by a completed enrichment job.

operations.name: Batch Get People
operations.description: Fetch full Harmonic person profiles for up to 500 combined numeric IDs and person URNs.

operations.name: Get Company Employees
operations.description: List person URNs for a company, filtered by role group and employment status. Pair with Batch Get People to hydrate contacts.

operations.name: List People Saved Searches
operations.description: List the team-shared Harmonic saved searches that target people. Use a returned ID or URN to fetch results.

operations.name: Get People Saved Search Results
operations.description: Get one page of a Harmonic people saved search. Full records become contacts; URN-only rows are exposed for Batch Get People.

operations.name: Get People Saved Search Net-New Results
operations.description: Get only the people newly matching a subscribed Harmonic people saved search, so a monitor does not reprocess the whole result set.

operations.name: Clear People Saved Search Net-New Results
operations.description: Acknowledge net-new people on a saved search so the next poll returns only fresh matches. Clearing everything requires setting the scope explicitly.

operations.name: Submit Email Enrichment Job
operations.description: Queue bulk email enrichment for up to 5,000 people, given either person URNs or LinkedIn profile URLs.

operations.name: Get Email Enrichment Job
operations.description: Check a Harmonic bulk email enrichment job. Per-person results appear once the job is terminal; fetch the emails with Get Person or Batch Get People.

operations.name: Get Email Enrichment Usage
operations.description: Read the team monthly email-enrichment quota. Check this before a large batch to avoid a quota rejection.

operations.name: Get Enrichment Status
operations.description: Check enrichment jobs Harmonic queued for people it did not already have, and read the person URN each one produced.

integrations.name: Hex

operations.name: Get Run Status

operations.name: Cancel Run

operations.name: List Projects
operations.description: List all projects in your Hex workspace with optional filtering by status.

operations.name: Get Project
operations.description: Get metadata and details for a specific Hex project by its ID.

operations.name: Update Project
operations.description: Update a Hex project status label (e.g., endorsement or custom workspace statuses).

operations.name: Get Queried Tables
operations.description: Return the warehouse tables queried by a Hex project, including data connection and table names.

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: List all users in the Hex workspace with optional filtering and sorting.

operations.name: List Groups

operations.description: Retrieve details for a specific Hex group.

operations.description: Retrieve details for a specific Hex collection by its ID.

operations.description: Rename a Hex group or add/remove members from it.

operations.description: Deactivate a user in the Hex workspace.

operations.name: Update Company
operations.description: Update an existing company in HubSpot by ID or domain

operations.name: Search Companies
operations.description: Search for companies in HubSpot using filters, sorting, and queries

operations.name: Delete Company
operations.description: Archive a company in HubSpot by ID (moves it to the recycling bin)

operations.name: Get Deals

operations.name: Create Deal

operations.name: Update Deal

operations.name: Search Deals
operations.description: Search for deals in HubSpot using filters, sorting, and queries

operations.name: Delete Deal
operations.description: Archive a deal in HubSpot by ID (moves it to the recycling bin)

operations.name: Get Tickets
operations.description: Retrieve all tickets from HubSpot account with pagination support

operations.name: Create Ticket
operations.description: Create a new ticket in HubSpot. Requires subject and hs_pipeline_stage properties

operations.name: Update Ticket
operations.description: Update an existing ticket in HubSpot by ID

operations.name: Search Tickets

operations.name: Delete Ticket
operations.description: Archive a ticket in HubSpot by ID (moves it to the recycling bin)

operations.name: Get Notes
operations.description: Retrieve all notes from HubSpot account with pagination support

operations.name: Create Note
operations.description: Log a note in HubSpot and optionally associate it with contacts, companies, or deals. Requires hs_timestamp and hs_note_body properties

operations.name: Search Notes
operations.description: Search for notes in HubSpot using filters, sorting, and queries

operations.description: Search for quotes in HubSpot using filters, sorting, and queries

operations.description: Retrieve all appointments from HubSpot account with pagination support

operations.description: Create a new appointment in HubSpot

operations.description: Update an existing appointment in HubSpot by ID

operations.description: Retrieve all carts from HubSpot account with pagination support

operations.name: List Owners
operations.description: Retrieve all owners from HubSpot account with pagination support

operations.name: Get Marketing Events
operations.description: Retrieve all marketing events from HubSpot account with pagination support

operations.name: Get Lists

integrations.name: Jotform
integrations.description: Read submissions, manage forms, and wire up webhooks in Jotform
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Jotform into your workflow to list and read form submissions with their answers resolved to question labels, build and edit forms and their questions, create shareable reports, register submission webhooks, and check account usage.

operations.name: List Forms
operations.description: List the forms on a Jotform account with their titles, status, and submission counts.

operations.name: Get Form
operations.description: Get the details of a single Jotform form, including its status, URL, and submission counts.

operations.name: Create Form
operations.description: Create a new Jotform form from a list of questions, plus optional form properties and notification emails.

operations.name: Clone Form

operations.name: Delete Form
operations.description: Delete a Jotform form. The API returns the form with status DELETED.

operations.description: Get the settings of a form: layout, limits, redirect behavior, notification emails, and validation strings. Supply a property key to read just one.

operations.name: List Form Files

operations.name: List Questions
operations.description: List every question on a form with its question ID, label, and field type. Question IDs are what submissions are keyed by.

operations.name: Get Report

operations.name: Delete Report

operations.name: Delete Webhook

operations.name: Create Label

operations.name: Update Label

operations.name: Delete Label

operations.name: Add Label Resources

operations.name: Remove Label Resources

operations.name: Update Settings

operations.name: Get History

triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Jotform form receives a new submission

integrations.name: LaTeX
integrations.description: Compile LaTeX documents into PDFs
integrations.longDescription: Integrates LaTeX into the workflow. Compiles LaTeX source into a PDF file with pdflatex, xelatex, lualatex, platex, uplatex, or context, and supports additional resources such as images, included .tex files, and bibliographies. Can also look up the TeX Live packages and system fonts available to the compiler. Does not require OAuth or an API key. Compilation runs on the public LaTeX-on-HTTP service (latex.ytotech.com), so document source and resources are sent to that third-party service.

integrations.name: Logfire
integrations.description: Query traces, logs, and metrics in Pydantic Logfire
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Pydantic Logfire into workflows. Run SQL over your observability data, search spans and logs with structured filters, pull an entire trace by ID, and confirm which project a read token targets.

operations.name: Search Records
operations.description: Search Logfire spans and logs using structured filters for message text, service, span name, severity, environment, and exceptions. Returns the most recent matches first without writing SQL.

operations.name: Run SQL Query
operations.description: Run a read-only SQL query against Logfire traces, logs, and metrics. Reads the records and metrics tables using PostgreSQL-compatible syntax.

operations.name: Get Trace
operations.description: Fetch every span and log belonging to a Logfire trace, ordered from earliest to latest, so a single request can be reconstructed end to end.

operations.name: Get Token Info
operations.description: Resolve which Logfire organization and project a read token belongs to. Useful for confirming a credential targets the expected project before querying it.

integrations.name: LogRocket
integrations.description: Summarize sessions, manage users, and tag releases in LogRocket
integrations.longDescription: Integrate LogRocket into your workflow to request AI session highlights for a user, poll for the result, list exported session files, read the audit log, create or update user profiles, and register releases so source maps decode their stack traces.

operations.name: Request Highlights
operations.description: Start a Galileo session highlights job for a user. Returns a request ID to poll with LogRocket's Get Highlights operation.

operations.name: Get Highlights
operations.description: Retrieve the result of a Galileo session highlights request. Status is PENDING until generation finishes, then READY or FAILED.

operations.name: List Exported Sessions
operations.description: List exported session files from the LogRocket Data Export API. Returns download URLs for JSON Lines exports, oldest first, plus a cursor for the next page.

operations.name: Get Audit Logs
operations.description: Export audit log entries from LogRocket, recording who viewed sessions and what actions were taken. Paginated with a cursor.

operations.name: Identify User
operations.description: Create or update a LogRocket user profile with demographic, financial, and engagement traits.

operations.name: Create Release
operations.description: Register a release version in LogRocket so uploaded source maps can decode stack traces for it. Fails with a conflict if the version already exists.

integrations.name: Loops
integrations.description: Manage contacts and send emails with Loops
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Loops into the workflow. Create and manage contacts, send transactional emails, and trigger event-based automations.

operations.name: Create Contact
operations.description: Create a new contact in your Loops audience with an email address and optional properties like name, user group, and mailing list subscriptions.

operations.name: Update Contact
operations.description: Update an existing contact in Loops by email or userId. Creates a new contact if no match is found (upsert). Can update name, subscription status, user group, mailing lists, and custom properties.

operations.name: Find Contact
operations.description: Find a contact in Loops by email address or userId. Returns an array of matching contacts with all their properties including name, subscription status, user group, and mailing lists.

operations.name: Delete Contact
operations.description: Delete a contact from Loops by email address or userId. At least one identifier must be provided.

operations.name: Send Transactional Email
operations.description: Send a transactional email to a recipient using a Loops template. Supports dynamic data variables for personalization and optionally adds the recipient to your audience.

operations.name: Send Event
operations.description: Send an event to Loops to trigger automated email sequences for a contact. Identify the contact by email or userId and include optional event properties and mailing list changes.

operations.name: List Mailing Lists
operations.description: Retrieve all mailing lists from your Loops account. Returns each list with its ID, name, description, and public/private status.

operations.name: List Transactional Emails
operations.description: Retrieve a list of published transactional email templates from your Loops account. Returns each template with its ID, name, created/updated timestamps, and data variables.

operations.name: Create Contact Property
operations.description: Create a new custom contact property in your Loops account. The property name must be in camelCase format.

operations.name: List Contact Properties
operations.description: Retrieve a list of contact properties from your Loops account. Returns each property with its key, label, and data type. Can filter to show all properties or only custom ones.

operations.name: Check Contact Suppression
operations.description: Check whether a Loops contact is on the suppression list (bounced, complained, or unsubscribed) by email address or userId.

operations.name: Remove Contact Suppression
operations.description: Remove a Loops contact from the suppression list by email address or userId, allowing them to receive emails again. Subject to a team removal quota.

operations.name: Get Transactional Email
operations.description: Retrieve a single transactional email template from your Loops account by its ID, including its data variables and draft/published message IDs.

operations.name: Create Event

operations.name: Update Event

operations.name: Lookup Event
operations.description: Look up an event by its public URL or event ID to resolve its canonical ID, API ID, and approval status.

operations.name: Cancel Event
operations.description: Cancel a Luma event. This is irreversible and notifies all registered guests. Requires a cancellation token obtained from the Request Event Cancellation endpoint.

operations.name: Get Guests
operations.description: Retrieve the guest list for a Luma event with optional filtering by approval status, sorting, and pagination.

operations.name: Get Guest
operations.description: Retrieve a single guest's details on a Luma event, including approval status, registration timestamps, and contact info.

operations.name: Add Guests
operations.description: Add guests to a Luma event by email. Guests are added with Going (approved) status and receive one ticket of the default ticket type.

operations.name: Send Invites
operations.description: Send email invitations to guests for a Luma event. Unlike Add Guests (which registers guests directly), this emails an invite that recipients can accept.

operations.name: Update Guest Status
operations.description: Update a guest's approval status on a Luma event — approve, decline, waitlist, or set to pending. Identify the guest by email or guest ID.

operations.description: Query and list records from a Microsoft Dataverse table. Supports OData query options for filtering, selecting columns, ordering, and pagination.

operations.name: Get Record
operations.description: Retrieve a single record from a Microsoft Dataverse table by its ID. Supports $select and $expand OData query options.

operations.name: Create Record
operations.description: Create a new record in a Microsoft Dataverse table. Requires the entity set name (plural table name) and record data as a JSON object.

operations.name: Update Record
operations.description: Update an existing record in a Microsoft Dataverse table. Only send the columns you want to change.

operations.name: Upsert Record
operations.description: Create or update a record in a Microsoft Dataverse table. If a record with the given ID exists, it is updated; otherwise, a new record is created.

operations.name: Delete Record
operations.description: Delete a record from a Microsoft Dataverse table by its ID.

operations.name: Create Multiple
operations.description: Create multiple records of the same table type in a single request. Each record in the Targets array must include an @odata.type annotation. Recommended batch size: 100-1000 records for standard tables.

operations.name: Update Multiple
operations.description: Update multiple records of the same table type in a single request. Each record must include its primary key. Only include columns that need to be changed. Recommended batch size: 100-1000 records.

operations.name: FetchXML Query
operations.description: Execute a FetchXML query against a Microsoft Dataverse table. FetchXML supports aggregation, grouping, linked-entity joins, and complex filtering beyond OData capabilities.

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Perform a full-text relevance search across Microsoft Dataverse tables. Requires Dataverse Search to be enabled on the environment. Supports simple and Lucene query syntax.

operations.name: Execute Action
operations.description: Execute a bound or unbound Dataverse action. Actions perform operations with side effects (e.g., Merge, GrantAccess, SendEmail, QualifyLead). For bound actions, provide the entity set name and record ID.

operations.name: Execute Function
operations.description: Execute a bound or unbound Dataverse function. Functions are read-only operations (e.g., RetrievePrincipalAccess, RetrieveTotalRecordCount, InitializeFrom). For bound functions, provide the entity set name and record ID.

operations.name: Upload File
operations.description: Upload a file to a file or image column on a Dataverse record. Supports single-request upload for files up to 128 MB. Provide the file through the File input; its bytes are read from storage and sent as the raw request body.

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from a file or image column on a Dataverse record. Stores the file in execution storage and returns a file reference, plus the base64 content and metadata directly.

operations.name: Associate Records
operations.description: Associate two records in Microsoft Dataverse via a navigation property. Creates a relationship between a source record and a target record. Supports both collection-valued (POST) and single-valued (PUT) navigation properties.

operations.name: Disassociate Records
operations.description: Remove an association between two records in Microsoft Dataverse. For collection-valued navigation properties, provide the target record ID. For single-valued navigation properties, only the navigation property name is needed.

operations.name: Get Table Metadata
operations.description: Retrieve table (entity) and column (attribute) definitions for a Microsoft Dataverse table by its singular logical name. Use this to look up the correct entity set name and column logical names before building record data for other operations.

operations.name: WhoAmI
operations.description: Retrieve the current authenticated user information from Microsoft Dataverse. Useful for testing connectivity and getting the user ID, business unit ID, and organization ID.

integrations.name: Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
integrations.description: Manage customers, sales pipelines, and support cases in Dynamics 365 CRM
integrations.longDescription: Manage standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM records through the Dataverse Web API. List, search, create, retrieve, and update accounts, contacts, leads, opportunities, and cases; assign records to users or teams; qualify leads; close opportunities; and resolve cases. Connect a separate Microsoft credential for each environment from this Dynamics integration page or from its workflow block; existing generic Dataverse credentials remain unchanged and are not automatically rebound. This version supports public-cloud Dynamics environments; national clouds require separate OAuth authorities. Dataverse Search must be enabled for search, and lifecycle actions require the corresponding Dynamics 365 app, security role, and record privileges.

operations.name: List Records
operations.description: Query supported standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM records. Supports OData filtering, column selection, ordering, and one bounded page at a time.

operations.name: Get Record

operations.name: Create Record
operations.description: Create a new supported standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM record using Dataverse logical column names.

operations.name: Update Record
operations.description: Update an existing supported standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM record. Only send the columns you want to change.

operations.name: Search Records
operations.description: Perform a full-text relevance search across Microsoft Dataverse tables. Requires Dataverse Search to be enabled on the environment. Supports simple and Lucene query syntax.

operations.name: List Owners
operations.description: Query supported standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM records. Supports OData filtering, column selection, ordering, and one bounded page at a time.

operations.name: Assign Record
operations.description: Update an existing supported standard Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM record. Only send the columns you want to change.

operations.name: Qualify Lead
operations.description: Qualify a Dynamics 365 Sales lead and optionally create linked account, contact, and opportunity records.

operations.name: Close Opportunity
operations.description: Close a Dynamics 365 Sales opportunity as won or lost.

operations.name: Close Case
operations.description: Resolve and close a Dynamics 365 Customer Service case.

integrations.name: Microsoft Word
integrations.description: Create, fill, read, edit, and export Word documents
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Microsoft Word into the workflow. Create .docx documents from text, fill a formatted template by substituting its placeholders, read a document back as text, replace or append content, find and replace text across the body plus headers and footers, list and search documents in OneDrive or SharePoint, and export a document as PDF.

operations.name: Read Document
operations.description: Read the text content of a Microsoft Word (.docx) document stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.

operations.name: Create Document
operations.description: Create a new Microsoft Word (.docx) document in OneDrive or SharePoint from text content. Supports Markdown headings (# ## ###), bullets (-), and inline **bold** / *italic*. An existing document with the same name is never overwritten — the new one is given a unique name instead.

operations.name: Create from Template
operations.description: Copy an existing Microsoft Word (.docx) template to a new document and fill its placeholders. The template keeps all of its formatting, styles, headers, and footers, and is never modified. An existing document with the same name is never overwritten — the new one is given a unique name instead.

operations.name: Replace Content
operations.description: Replace the entire contents of an existing Microsoft Word (.docx) document with new text. The previous content and its formatting are discarded — use Append to add to a document instead.

operations.name: Append Content
operations.description: Append plain-text paragraphs to the end of an existing Microsoft Word (.docx) document, leaving the existing content and formatting intact. Fails rather than overwriting if someone else changed the document while the edit was in flight.

operations.name: Find and Replace Text
operations.description: Find and replace text throughout a Microsoft Word (.docx) document, including its headers and footers. Use this to fill placeholders in a template document. Fails rather than overwriting if someone else changed the document while the edit was in flight.

operations.name: List Documents
operations.description: List or search Microsoft Word (.docx) documents in OneDrive or SharePoint. Non-Word items are filtered out of the results.

operations.name: Export as PDF
operations.description: Convert a Microsoft Word (.docx) document to PDF using Microsoft Graph and return it as a file.

operations.name: Get Remaining Credits
