integrations.name: Mintlify
integrations.description: Deploy, edit, search, and measure Mintlify documentation
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Mintlify into your workflow. Trigger production and preview deployments, run scheduled automations, launch documentation agent jobs, detect AI-sounding prose, search your docs and read page content, ask the docs assistant, and export feedback, conversation, search, view, and visitor analytics.

operations.name: Trigger Update
operations.description: Queue a deployment update for a Mintlify documentation project from its configured deployment branch. Returns a status ID for tracking progress.

operations.name: Get Update Status
operations.description: Get the status of a Mintlify deployment update from its status ID, including logs, commit details, and screenshots.

operations.name: Trigger Preview Deployment
operations.description: Create or update a Mintlify preview deployment for a Git branch. Redeploys when a preview already exists for the branch.

operations.name: Trigger Automation
operations.description: Run a scheduled Mintlify automation immediately instead of waiting for its next scheduled time. Only automations with a custom schedule can be triggered.

operations.name: Create Agent Job
operations.description: Create a background Mintlify agent job that edits your documentation from a prompt. Opens a pull request when the agent successfully edits files.

operations.name: Get Agent Job
operations.description: Retrieve the current status and details of a Mintlify agent job, including the pull request link once the agent opens one.

operations.name: Send Agent Message
operations.description: Send a follow-up instruction to an existing Mintlify agent job. The message is processed asynchronously.

operations.name: Detect AI-Sounding Prose
operations.description: Analyze a documentation page for AI-generated prose and return flagged passages with suggested human rewrites. Consumes one AI credit per checked page.

operations.name: Search Documentation
operations.description: Run a semantic and keyword search across a Mintlify documentation site, with optional version, language, tag, and group filters.

operations.name: Get Page Content
operations.description: Retrieve the full text content of a Mintlify documentation page by its path. Use it after a search to fetch the complete page.

operations.name: Ask Assistant
operations.description: Ask the Mintlify assistant, trained on your documentation, a question and get the assembled answer with its cited sources. Consumes the deployment's assistant credits.

operations.name: Get Feedback
operations.description: Export paginated user feedback from a Mintlify documentation project, with optional date-range, source, and status filters.

operations.name: Get Feedback By Page
operations.description: Export Mintlify feedback counts aggregated by documentation page path, broken down into thumbs up, thumbs down, and code snippet feedback.

operations.name: Get Assistant Conversations
operations.description: Export paginated Mintlify AI assistant conversation history, including the query, response, cited sources, and whether the question was answered.

operations.name: Get Assistant Caller Stats
operations.description: Get a breakdown of Mintlify assistant query counts by caller type — web, API, and other — for a date range.

operations.name: Get Search Queries
operations.description: Export Mintlify documentation search terms for a date range, ordered by hit count, with click-through rate and the most-clicked result path.

operations.name: Get Page Views
operations.description: Export Mintlify per-path and site-wide content view counts for a date range, split by human and AI bot traffic.

operations.name: Get Unique Visitors
operations.description: Export Mintlify per-path and site-wide approximate distinct visitor counts for a date range, split by human and AI bot traffic.

integrations.longDescription: Integrate Okta identity management into your workflow. Manage users, groups, and group rules. Run service desk actions like resetting MFA factors and clearing sessions. Review and change application assignments and admin roles. Query the System Log to audit sign-ins and admin changes.

operations.name: List Users

operations.name: Get User
operations.description: Get a specific user by ID or login from your Okta organization

operations.name: Create User
operations.description: Create a new user in your Okta organization

operations.name: Update User

operations.name: Deactivate User

operations.name: Suspend User

operations.name: Unsuspend User

operations.name: Reset Password
operations.description: Generate a one-time token to reset a user password. Can email the reset link to the user or return it directly. Transitions the user to RECOVERY status.

operations.name: Delete User

operations.name: List Groups

operations.name: Update Group
operations.description: Update a group profile in your Okta organization. Only groups of OKTA_GROUP type can be updated. Fields left blank keep their stored value.

operations.name: Delete Group
operations.description: Delete a group from your Okta organization. Groups of OKTA_GROUP or APP_GROUP type can be removed.

operations.name: Add User to Group
operations.description: Add a user to a group in your Okta organization

operations.name: Remove User from Group
operations.description: Remove a user from a group in your Okta organization

operations.name: List Group Members
operations.description: List all members of a specific group in your Okta organization

operations.name: List Group Rules
operations.description: List the group rules in your Okta organization. Each rule assigns users to groups automatically based on an expression over their profile, so this shows how group membership is being driven.

operations.name: Get Group Rule
operations.description: Retrieve a single Okta group rule by ID, including the expression that decides which users it matches and the groups those users are assigned to.

operations.name: Create Group Rule
operations.description: Create a group rule that automatically assigns users matching an Okta expression to one or more groups. New rules are created INACTIVE, so run Activate Group Rule afterwards to start applying it.

operations.name: Activate Group Rule
operations.description: Activate a group rule so Okta starts applying it, assigning every matching user to the target groups.

operations.name: Deactivate Group Rule
operations.description: Deactivate a group rule so Okta stops applying it. Existing memberships the rule created are left in place. A rule must be INACTIVE before it can be edited.

operations.name: Delete Group Rule
operations.description: Permanently delete a group rule. Destructive and irreversible. Optionally also removes the users that this rule had assigned from those groups, which revokes any access those groups grant.

operations.name: List Factors
operations.description: List the MFA factors a user has enrolled, with each factor type, provider, and enrollment status. Use this before resetting a factor to confirm which one to target.

operations.name: Get Factor
operations.description: Retrieve a single enrolled MFA factor for a user, including its type, provider, enrollment status, and factor-specific profile.

operations.name: Enroll Factor
operations.description: Enroll an MFA factor for a user. The profile fields required depend on the factor type: a phone number for sms and call, an email address for email, and a question and answer for question. Factors that enroll from the user device, such as webauthn and push, need no profile fields.

operations.name: Reset Factor
operations.description: Unenroll one specific MFA factor for a user so they can re-enroll it. Destructive and irreversible: the existing enrollment is removed. Unenrolling a push or signed_nonce factor also unenrolls the related Okta Verify factors. Factors cannot be unenrolled from a deactivated user.

operations.name: Reset All Factors
operations.description: Reset every MFA factor for a user, returning all enrollments to the unenrolled state. Destructive and irreversible: the user must re-enroll each factor before they can complete MFA again. The user status stays ACTIVE.

operations.name: Clear User Sessions
operations.description: Revoke every active Okta session for a user, signing them out of all devices immediately. Destructive and irreversible: the user must sign in again. Optionally also revokes their OAuth and OpenID Connect tokens, and clears remembered factors.

operations.name: Get Session
operations.description: Retrieve an Okta session by ID, including who it belongs to, when it expires, and which authentication methods were used to establish it.

operations.name: Revoke Session
operations.description: Revoke a single Okta session by ID, ending that sign-in immediately. Destructive and irreversible: the affected user must sign in again on that device.

operations.name: List Applications
operations.description: List the applications configured in your Okta organization, with optional name search, filtering, and cursor pagination.

operations.name: Get Application
operations.description: Retrieve a single Okta application by ID, including its sign-on mode, status, enabled provisioning features, and configuration objects.

operations.name: List Application Users
operations.description: List the users assigned to an Okta application, including how each assignment was made and its provisioning sync state. Use this to audit who has access to an app.

operations.name: Assign User to Application
operations.description: Assign a user to an Okta application, granting them access to it. Applications that require credentials also need the username the user signs in with.

operations.name: Remove User from Application
operations.description: Unassign a user from an Okta application, revoking their access. Destructive and irreversible: the app profile for that user is permanently removed, and if provisioning is enabled the downstream account is deactivated.

operations.name: List Application Groups
operations.description: List the groups assigned to an Okta application. Every member of an assigned group inherits access to the app, so this is the starting point for an app access review.

operations.name: Assign Group to Application
operations.description: Assign a group to an Okta application so every member of the group inherits access to it.

operations.name: Remove Group from Application
operations.description: Unassign a group from an Okta application. Destructive: every member who had access only through this group loses access to the app.

operations.name: List User Roles
operations.description: List the administrator roles assigned to a user. Returns both standard roles and custom role bindings, so you can review who holds privileged access.

operations.name: Assign User Role
operations.description: Grant a user an administrator role. Use a standard role type such as USER_ADMIN or HELP_DESK_ADMIN, or CUSTOM together with a custom role ID and a resource set ID. This grants privileged access, so confirm the role is the least privilege that fits.

operations.name: Remove User Role
operations.description: Revoke an administrator role from a user. Destructive: the user immediately loses the admin permissions that role granted. Takes the role assignment ID, not the role type, which List User Roles returns as the role id field.

operations.name: Get System Log Events
operations.description: Query the Okta System Log for sign-ins, admin changes, and security events. Supports a time window, SCIM filter expressions, keyword search, and cursor pagination for audit and investigation workflows.

integrations.name: OneDrive
integrations.description: Create, upload, download, search, move, copy, share, and delete files
integrations.longDescription: Integrate OneDrive into the workflow. Can create text and Excel files, upload files, download files, list and search files, move or rename files, copy files, create sharing links, and delete files or folders.

operations.name: Create Folder
operations.description: Create a new folder in OneDrive

operations.name: Create File
operations.description: Upload a file to OneDrive

operations.name: Upload File
operations.description: Upload a file to OneDrive

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from OneDrive

operations.name: List Files
operations.description: List files and folders in OneDrive

operations.name: Search Files
operations.description: Search for files and folders across OneDrive by name, metadata, or content (recursive)

operations.name: Get Item Info
operations.description: Get metadata for a specific OneDrive file or folder by ID, or the drive root

operations.name: Get Drive Info
operations.description: Get information about the OneDrive drive, including storage quota

operations.name: Move/Rename File
operations.description: Move a file or folder to a new parent folder, rename it, or both

operations.name: Copy File
operations.description: Copy a file or folder to another location within OneDrive

operations.name: Create Sharing Link
operations.description: Create a view or edit sharing link for a OneDrive file or folder

operations.name: Delete File
operations.description: Delete a file or folder from OneDrive

integrations.name: Oracle NetSuite
integrations.description: Manage NetSuite records, queries, datasets, batches, and async jobs
integrations.longDescription: Connect a reusable Oracle NetSuite service-account credential to SuiteTalk REST Web Services. Read and write account-specific records, execute SuiteQL and SuiteAnalytics datasets, run asynchronous record batches, inspect metadata, and monitor async jobs.

operations.name: List/Search Records
operations.description: List one page of a NetSuite record collection, optionally filtered with a q expression.

operations.name: Get Record
operations.description: Retrieve one NetSuite record by internal or external ID.

operations.name: Create Record
operations.description: Create a NetSuite record using the account-specific record metadata schema.

operations.name: Update Record
operations.description: Update fields on an existing NetSuite record with PATCH.

operations.name: Upsert Record
operations.description: Create or update a NetSuite record by external ID with PUT.

operations.name: Delete Record
operations.description: Delete one NetSuite record by internal or external ID.

operations.name: Get Subresource
operations.description: Retrieve a record sublist, subrecord, referenced record, or nested subresource.

operations.name: Get Record Form
operations.description: Return a prepopulated create form, or an edit form when a record ID is supplied.

operations.name: Get Select Options
operations.description: Retrieve valid select values for one or more fields on a new or existing record.

operations.name: Attach Record or File
operations.description: Attach a contact or file to another NetSuite record.

operations.name: Detach Record or File
operations.description: Detach a contact or file from another NetSuite record.

operations.name: Execute Record Action
operations.description: Execute a supported NetSuite record action such as approve, reject, or confirm.

operations.name: Transform Record
operations.description: Transform a supported source record into another NetSuite record type.

operations.name: Batch Get Records
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous request to retrieve up to 100 records of one type.

operations.name: Batch Create Records
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous batch that creates up to 100 records of one type.

operations.name: Batch Update Records
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous batch that updates up to 100 records of one type.

operations.name: Batch Upsert Records
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous batch that creates or updates up to 100 records by external ID.

operations.name: Batch Delete Records
operations.description: Submit an asynchronous request to delete up to 100 records of one type.

operations.name: Execute SuiteQL
operations.description: Execute one page of a SuiteQL query through SuiteTalk REST web services.

operations.name: List SuiteAnalytics Datasets
operations.description: List one page of SuiteAnalytics Workbook datasets available to the authenticated role.

operations.name: Execute SuiteAnalytics Dataset
operations.description: Execute one page of a standard or custom SuiteAnalytics Workbook dataset.

operations.name: List Record Types
operations.description: List record types exposed to the authenticated role by the REST metadata catalog.

operations.name: Get Record Metadata
operations.description: Retrieve account-specific metadata for one NetSuite record type.

operations.name: Get Async Status
operations.description: Retrieve job status, list job tasks, or retrieve one task status.

operations.name: Get Async Operation Result
operations.description: Retrieve the provider response for one task within a completed asynchronous job.

operations.name: Get Server Time
operations.description: Retrieve the current UTC time from the NetSuite server.

operations.name: Get Governance Limits
operations.description: Retrieve REST web-services concurrency limits for the NetSuite account and integration; NetSuite requires an Administrator role.

integrations.name: Outlook
integrations.description: Send, read, search, reply, organize, and manage Outlook email and calendar
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Outlook into the workflow. Can send, draft, read, search, reply, forward, move, copy, and delete email; manage mail folders and attachments; and set categories and flags on messages. Can also list, create, update, delete, and respond to calendar events. Can be used in trigger mode to trigger a workflow when a new email is received.

operations.name: Send Email

operations.name: Draft Email

operations.name: Read Email

operations.name: Reply to Email

operations.name: Reply All

operations.name: Forward Email

operations.name: Move Email

operations.name: Copy Email

operations.name: Mark as Read
operations.description: Mark an Outlook message as read

operations.name: Mark as Unread
operations.description: Mark an Outlook message as unread

operations.name: Set Categories & Flag
operations.description: Set the categories, follow-up flag, and importance on an Outlook message

operations.name: Delete Email
operations.description: Delete an Outlook message (move to Deleted Items)

operations.name: List Folders
operations.description: List mail folders in the root of the Outlook mailbox

operations.name: Create Folder
operations.description: Create a new mail folder in the root of the Outlook mailbox

operations.name: List Attachments
operations.description: List the attachments on an Outlook message (metadata only, without contents)

operations.name: Get Attachment
operations.description: Get a single attachment on an Outlook message, including its file contents

operations.name: List Calendar Events
operations.description: List Outlook calendar events within a start/end time window

operations.name: Get Calendar Event
operations.description: Get a single Outlook calendar event by ID

operations.name: Create Event
operations.description: Create a new Outlook calendar event

operations.name: Update Event
operations.description: Update an existing Outlook calendar event

operations.name: Delete Event
operations.description: Delete an Outlook calendar event by ID

operations.name: Respond to Invite
operations.description: Accept, tentatively accept, or decline an Outlook calendar event invitation

triggers.name: Outlook Email Trigger
triggers.description: Triggers when new emails are received in Outlook (requires Microsoft credentials)

integrations.name: PagerDuty
integrations.description: Manage incidents and on-call schedules with PagerDuty
integrations.longDescription: Integrate PagerDuty into your workflow to list, get, create, update, snooze, and merge incidents, add notes and list alerts, look up services and escalation policies, check on-call schedules, list users, and send monitoring events through the Events API v2.

operations.name: List Incidents
operations.description: List incidents from PagerDuty with optional filters.

operations.name: Get Incident
operations.description: Get a single incident from PagerDuty by ID.

operations.name: Create Incident
operations.description: Create a new incident in PagerDuty.

operations.name: Update Incident
operations.description: Update an incident in PagerDuty (acknowledge, resolve, change urgency, etc.).

operations.name: Snooze Incident
operations.description: Snooze a triggered PagerDuty incident for a number of seconds, after which it returns to triggered.

operations.name: Merge Incidents
operations.description: Merge one or more source incidents into a target incident. Source incidents are resolved and their alerts move to the target.

operations.name: Add Note
operations.description: Add a note to an existing PagerDuty incident.

operations.name: List Incident Alerts
operations.description: List the individual alerts attached to a PagerDuty incident.

operations.name: List Services
operations.description: List services from PagerDuty with optional name filter.

operations.name: Get Service
operations.description: Get a single service from PagerDuty by ID.

operations.name: List On-Calls
operations.description: List current on-call entries from PagerDuty.

operations.name: List Escalation Policies
operations.description: List escalation policies from PagerDuty with an optional name filter.

operations.name: List Schedules
operations.description: List on-call schedules from PagerDuty with an optional name filter.

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: List users from PagerDuty with an optional name/email filter.

operations.name: Send Event
operations.description: Send a trigger, acknowledge, or resolve event to PagerDuty Events API v2 using a service integration key. Used to page from monitoring/alerting sources without a PagerDuty user account.

triggers.name: PagerDuty Incident Triggered
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new incident is triggered in PagerDuty

triggers.name: PagerDuty Incident Acknowledged
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an incident is acknowledged in PagerDuty

triggers.name: PagerDuty Incident Resolved
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an incident is resolved in PagerDuty

triggers.name: PagerDuty Incident Escalated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an incident is escalated in PagerDuty

triggers.name: PagerDuty Incident Reassigned
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an incident is reassigned in PagerDuty

triggers.name: PagerDuty Incident Event
triggers.description: Trigger workflow from any PagerDuty incident event

integrations.name: Parallel AI
integrations.description: Web research with Parallel AI
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Parallel AI into the workflow. Can search the web, extract information from URLs, and conduct deep research.

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Search the web using Parallel AI. Provides comprehensive search results with intelligent processing and content extraction.

operations.name: Extract from URLs
operations.description: Extract targeted information from specific URLs using Parallel AI. Processes provided URLs to pull relevant content based on your objective.

operations.name: Deep Research
operations.description: Conduct comprehensive deep research across the web using Parallel AI. Synthesizes information from multiple sources with citations. Can take up to 45 minutes to complete.

integrations.name: People Data Labs
integrations.description: Enrich and search people and companies
integrations.longDescription: Enrich a single person or company with People Data Labs, or search the global person and company datasets with SQL or Elasticsearch DSL. Useful for sales enrichment, contact lookup, and CRM hygiene.

operations.name: Person Enrich
operations.description: Enrich a single person profile using People Data Labs. Match by email, phone, LinkedIn URL, or name + company/location. Returns work history, contact details, location, and skills.

operations.name: Person Identify
operations.description: Return up to 20 candidate person matches with confidence scores. Useful when you want to see all plausible matches rather than the single best one. Reference: https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/identify-api-quickstart

operations.name: Person Search
operations.description: Search the People Data Labs person dataset using SQL or Elasticsearch DSL. Returns up to 100 matching records per call.

operations.name: Bulk Person Enrich
operations.description: Enrich up to 100 person records in a single call. Provide a JSON array of request objects, each with a `params` object (and optional `metadata` echoed back). Reference: https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/bulk-person-enrichment-api

operations.name: Company Enrich
operations.description: Enrich a single company using People Data Labs. Match by name, website, LinkedIn URL, ticker, or PDL ID.

operations.name: Company Search
operations.description: Search the People Data Labs company dataset using SQL or Elasticsearch DSL. Returns up to 100 matching companies per call.

operations.name: Bulk Company Enrich
operations.description: Enrich up to 100 companies in a single call. Provide a JSON array of request objects, each with a `params` object. Reference: https://docs.peopledatalabs.com/docs/bulk-company-enrichment-api

operations.name: Company Cleaner
operations.description: Normalize a company string into a canonical company record. Provide at least one of name, website, or profile (LinkedIn URL).

operations.name: Location Cleaner
operations.description: Normalize a freeform location string into a structured locality/region/country record with coordinates.

operations.name: School Cleaner
operations.description: Normalize a school string into a canonical school record. Provide at least one of name, website, or profile (LinkedIn URL).

operations.name: Autocomplete
operations.description: Get autocomplete suggestions for a PDL field (title, skill, company, industry, location, school, major, role, sub_role).

integrations.name: Perplexity
integrations.description: Use Perplexity AI for chat and search
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Perplexity into the workflow. Can generate completions using Perplexity AI chat models or perform web searches with advanced filtering.

operations.name: Chat
operations.description: Generate completions using Perplexity AI chat models

operations.name: Search
operations.description: Get ranked search results from Perplexity's continuously refreshed index with advanced filtering and customization options

integrations.name: Persona
integrations.description: Verify identities with Persona
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Persona identity verification into the workflow. Manage the full inquiry lifecycle (create, update, approve, decline, review, resume, expire, redact), generate one-time verification links and PDF summaries, manage accounts including CSV bulk import, run watchlist and adverse media reports, review cases, retrieve verifications and documents, and discover inquiry templates.

operations.name: Create Inquiry
operations.description: Create a new identity verification inquiry from an inquiry template. Returns the created inquiry, which can then be completed by the individual via a one-time link.

operations.name: Get Inquiry
operations.description: Retrieve a single identity verification inquiry by ID, including its status, collected fields, and decision timestamps.

operations.name: List Inquiries
operations.description: List identity verification inquiries, optionally filtered by status, account ID, reference ID, or creation date range. Results are cursor-paginated.

operations.name: Update Inquiry
operations.description: Update an inquiry’s note, fields, tags, or redirect URI. Only the provided values are changed.

operations.name: Approve Inquiry
operations.description: Approve an identity verification inquiry. Approving prevents further progress on the inquiry and triggers any associated workflows and webhooks.

operations.name: Decline Inquiry
operations.description: Decline an identity verification inquiry. Declining prevents further progress on the inquiry and triggers any associated workflows and webhooks.

operations.name: Mark Inquiry for Review
operations.description: Mark an identity verification inquiry for manual review, moving it to the needs_review status.

operations.name: Resume Inquiry
operations.description: Resume a pending or expired inquiry, creating a new session so the individual can continue verification. Returns a session token.

operations.name: Expire Inquiry
operations.description: Expire an in-progress inquiry, invalidating its sessions and one-time links so the individual can no longer continue it.

operations.name: Generate Inquiry Link
operations.description: Generate a one-time link for an inquiry that the individual can open to complete their identity verification.

operations.name: Print Inquiry PDF
operations.description: Download a PDF summary of an inquiry, including its collected information and verification results.

operations.name: Redact Inquiry
operations.description: Permanently delete all personally identifiable information collected by an inquiry, for example to honor a data deletion request. This cannot be undone.

operations.name: Create Account
operations.description: Create an account that represents an individual in Persona. Accounts consolidate inquiries, verifications, and reports for the same person.

operations.name: Get Account
operations.description: Retrieve a single account by ID, including its reference ID, fields, tags, and status.

operations.name: List Accounts
operations.description: List accounts in your Persona organization, optionally filtered by reference ID. Results are cursor-paginated.

operations.name: Update Account
operations.description: Update an account’s reference ID, country code, fields, or tags. Only the provided values are changed.

operations.name: Import Accounts (CSV)
operations.description: Bulk-import accounts into Persona from a CSV file. Returns an importer whose status can be polled until processing completes.

operations.name: Redact Account
operations.description: Permanently delete all personally identifiable information stored on an account, for example to honor a data deletion request. This cannot be undone.

operations.name: List Cases
operations.description: List manual review cases, optionally filtered by status, account ID, or reference ID. Results are cursor-paginated.

operations.name: Get Case
operations.description: Retrieve a single manual review case by ID, including its status, resolution, and assignee.

operations.name: Create Report
operations.description: Run a screening report (watchlist, adverse media, or politically exposed person) against an individual by name or search term.

operations.name: Get Report
operations.description: Retrieve a single screening report by ID, including its status, match results, and full type-specific attributes.

operations.name: List Reports
operations.description: List screening reports, optionally filtered by account ID or reference ID. Results are cursor-paginated.

operations.name: Get Verification
operations.description: Retrieve a single verification by ID (government ID, selfie, document, database, and more), including its status and the checks that ran.

operations.name: Get Document
operations.description: Retrieve a single document by ID (government ID, generic document, and more), including its processing status and uploaded files.

operations.name: List Inquiry Templates
operations.description: List the inquiry templates in your Persona organization, to discover template IDs for creating inquiries. Results are cursor-paginated.

integrations.name: Pinecone

integrations.longDescription: Integrate Pinecone into the workflow. Generate embeddings, upsert and update text records, delete vectors, search with text or vectors, fetch and list vectors, inspect index statistics, and manage indexes.

operations.name: Fetch Vectors
operations.description: Fetch vectors by ID from a Pinecone index

operations.name: List Vector IDs
operations.description: List vector IDs in a Pinecone namespace by prefix (serverless indexes only)

operations.name: Describe Index Stats
operations.description: Get statistics about a Pinecone index, including per-namespace vector counts

operations.name: List Indexes
operations.description: List all Pinecone indexes in the project

operations.name: Describe Index
operations.description: Get the configuration and status of a Pinecone index by name

integrations.longDescription: Integrate Pipedrive into your workflow. Manage deals, contacts, sales pipeline, projects, activities, files, and communications with powerful CRM capabilities.

operations.description: Retrieve all deals in a specific pipeline

operations.description: Update an existing activity (task) in Pipedrive

operations.description: Retrieve all leads or a specific lead from Pipedrive

operations.name: Create Lead
operations.description: Create a new lead in Pipedrive

operations.name: Update Lead
operations.description: Update an existing lead in Pipedrive

operations.name: Delete Lead

integrations.name: PitchBook
integrations.description: Look up private market data on companies, deals, investors, funds, and people
integrations.longDescription: Integrates the PitchBook Public API into the workflow. Search and pull profiles across companies, deals, investors, people, funds, limited partners, and service providers, including financing history, valuations, cap tables, debt and lenders, fund performance and commitments, patents, and credit analysis news. Also reports API credit usage and the lookup-table codes the search filters expect. Every call consumes PitchBook API credits.

operations.name: Search All Entities
operations.description: Search across every PitchBook entity type at once by name, PitchBook ID, website, or ticker. Use this to resolve a company, investor, or fund to its PitchBook ID before calling a profile operation.

operations.name: Shared Search
operations.description: Extract the names and PitchBook IDs behind an Advanced Search shared from the PitchBook platform, using the search ID and hash from the shared link

operations.name: Get Entity People
operations.description: Retrieve the people at an entity: primary contact, current and former team, and current and former board members

operations.name: Get Entity Locations
operations.description: Retrieve the headquarters and every alternate office on record for an entity

operations.name: Get Entity Affiliates
operations.description: Retrieve the affiliated entities linked to an entity and how each is related

operations.name: Get Entity News
operations.description: Retrieve recent news articles PitchBook has associated with an entity

operations.name: Get Entity Updates
operations.description: Check which entity datasets changed in a window, so a sync only refetches what moved

operations.name: Search Companies
operations.description: Search PitchBook for companies by name, location, industry, funding, deal activity, and more

operations.name: Get Company Bio
operations.description: Retrieve the core profile of a company: names, description, HQ, status, headcount, total raised, and social links

operations.name: Get Company Industries
operations.description: Retrieve the industry classification, verticals, keywords, and emerging spaces assigned to a company

operations.name: Get Company Investors
operations.description: Retrieve every investor in a company, current and former, with the type of investor and when they invested

operations.name: Get Company Active Investors
operations.description: Retrieve only the investors currently holding a position in a company

operations.name: Get Company Deals
operations.description: Retrieve every deal a company has been involved in, in chronological order with its deal type

operations.name: Get Company Latest Financing
operations.description: Retrieve a company most recent financing round: date, size, type, and last known valuation

operations.name: Get Company Latest Debt Financing
operations.description: Retrieve a company most recent debt financing, including each debt instrument raised

operations.name: Get Company Latest Financials
operations.description: Retrieve the most recent reported financials for a private company: revenue, net income, EBITDA, assets, and debt

operations.name: Get Company Financials History
operations.description: Retrieve reported financials for a private company across every available fiscal period. Annual data is returned by default.

operations.name: Get Similar Companies
operations.description: Retrieve companies PitchBook scores as similar to a given company, flagging which are direct competitors

operations.name: Get VC Exit Predictions
operations.description: Retrieve PitchBook machine-learning exit predictions for a VC-backed company. Requires at least two funding rounds in the past six years.

operations.name: Get Company Social Analytics

integrations.name: RabbitMQ
integrations.description: Publish and read messages and manage queues in RabbitMQ
integrations.longDescription: Connect agents to a RabbitMQ broker through its Management HTTP API. Publish messages to exchanges, read messages off queues, declare queues, exchanges, bindings, and policies, and inspect broker health, queue depth, consumers, connections, and cluster nodes. Works with self-hosted brokers and managed offerings such as CloudAMQP as long as the management plugin is reachable.

operations.name: Publish Message
operations.description: Publish a message to a RabbitMQ exchange with a routing key. Reports whether the message was routed to at least one queue.

operations.name: Get Messages
operations.description: Retrieve messages from a RabbitMQ queue. Defaults to requeueing the messages so they stay available to real consumers.

operations.description: List queues in a RabbitMQ virtual host with their depth, consumer count, and configuration.

operations.name: Get Queue
operations.description: Read a single RabbitMQ queue, including its depth, consumer count, and declaration settings.

operations.name: Create Queue
operations.description: Declare a RabbitMQ queue. Declaring a queue that already exists with the same settings succeeds without changing it.

operations.name: Delete Queue
operations.description: Delete a RabbitMQ queue and every message still in it. Can be guarded so the delete only happens when the queue is unused or empty.

operations.name: Purge Queue
operations.description: Discard every ready message in a RabbitMQ queue while leaving the queue itself in place.

operations.name: List Exchanges
operations.description: List exchanges in a RabbitMQ virtual host with their type and declaration settings.

operations.name: Get Exchange
operations.description: Read a single RabbitMQ exchange and the settings it was declared with.

operations.name: Create Exchange
operations.description: Declare a RabbitMQ exchange. Declaring an exchange that already exists with the same settings succeeds without changing it.

operations.name: Delete Exchange
operations.description: Delete a RabbitMQ exchange and every binding attached to it. Publishers targeting it will fail afterwards.

operations.description: Bind a queue or another exchange to a RabbitMQ exchange so messages matching a routing key are routed to it.

operations.name: Delete Binding
operations.description: Remove a binding so an exchange stops routing its matching messages to that destination.

operations.name: Get Overview
operations.description: Read broker-wide RabbitMQ status: version, cluster name, object totals, queue depth totals, and message rates.

operations.name: Health Check
operations.description: Run one of the broker health checks and report whether it passed. A failing check is a normal result, not a tool error.

operations.name: List Nodes
operations.description: List the cluster nodes with memory, disk, file-descriptor, and alarm state. A fired alarm blocks publishers broker-wide.

operations.name: List Virtual Hosts
operations.description: List the virtual hosts on the broker with their message totals, so you can discover which scopes exist.

operations.name: List Connections
operations.description: List client connections to the broker with their user, state, and channel count. Connections are cluster-wide, not scoped to one virtual host.

operations.name: List Channels
operations.description: List open channels with their prefetch limit and unacknowledged message count, which is where stalled consumers show up. Channels are cluster-wide, not scoped to one virtual host.

operations.name: List Consumers
operations.description: List the consumers subscribed in a virtual host. An empty result for a queue with a backlog means nothing is processing it.

operations.description: List the policies in a virtual host. Policies are how dead-lettering, TTLs, and length limits get applied to matching queues and exchanges.

operations.name: Create Policy
operations.description: Create or replace a RabbitMQ policy, applying settings such as dead-lettering, TTLs, or length limits to every queue or exchange whose name matches a pattern.

operations.name: Delete Policy
operations.description: Delete a RabbitMQ policy. Every queue and exchange it matched immediately loses the settings it applied.

operations.description: Create an expense report (POST /expensereports/v4/users/{userId}/context/{contextType}/reports — supported contexts: TRAVELER, PROXY). Required body fields: name, policyId.

operations.description: Update an unsubmitted expense report (PATCH /expensereports/v4/users/{userId}/context/{contextType}/reports/{reportId} — supported contexts: TRAVELER, PROXY). The body must always include `reportSource` (EA, MOB, OTHER, SE, TR, or UI).

operations.name: Submit Expense Report

operations.description: Recall a submitted expense report (PATCH /expensereports/v4/users/{userId}/context/{contextType}/reports/{reportId}/recall — supported contexts: TRAVELER, PROXY). Takes no request body. This operation supports user-level access tokens: set grantType to "password" with username and password, since the default client_credentials grant yields a company-level token.

operations.name: Approve Expense Report
operations.description: Approve an expense report as a manager (PATCH /expensereports/v4/reports/{reportId}/approve). Optional body fields: comment, expenseRejectedComment (required if the report has rejected expenses), expectedStepCode, expectedStepSequence, statusId (default A_APPR).

operations.name: Send Back Expense Report
operations.description: Send back an expense report to the employee (PATCH /expensereports/v4/reports/{reportId}/sendBack). Required body field: comment.

operations.name: Update Expense
operations.description: Update an expense (PATCH /expensereports/v4/reports/{reportId}/expenses/{expenseId}). Only Company JWT authentication is allowed on this endpoint — the password grant is rejected. A submitted report cannot be updated once it has reached a Paid workflow status. Although the primary intent of this operation is for submitted report updates, it also works on unsubmitted reports, but with the same limited set of fields.
