operations.description: List exceptions on a report (GET /expensereports/v4/users/{userId}/context/{contextType}/reports/{reportId}/exceptions).

operations.name: Create Quick Expense
operations.description: Create a quick expense (POST /quickexpense/v4/users/{userId}/context/{contextType}/quickexpenses). TRAVELER is the only supported context type.

operations.name: Create Quick Expense (With Image)
operations.description: Create a quick expense with an attached image (POST /quickexpense/v4/users/{userId}/context/{contextType}/quickexpenses/image).

operations.name: List Receipts
operations.description: List receipts for a user (GET /receipts/v4/users/{userId}). Concur documents no query parameters for this endpoint, so page size and offset cannot be controlled; follow the "next" URL in the response to page forward.

operations.name: Get Receipt
operations.description: Get a single receipt by ID (GET /receipts/v4/{receiptId}).

operations.name: Get Receipt Status
operations.description: Get receipt processing status (GET /receipts/v4/status/{receiptId}).

operations.name: Upload Receipt Image
operations.description: Upload an image-only receipt (POST /receipts/v4/users/{userId}/image-only-receipts).

operations.name: List Travel Requests
operations.description: List travel requests (GET /travelrequest/v4/requests).

operations.name: Get Travel Request
operations.description: Get a single travel request (GET /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}).

operations.name: Create Travel Request
operations.description: Create a travel request (POST /travelrequest/v4/requests).

operations.name: Update Travel Request
operations.description: Update a travel request (PUT /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}).

operations.name: Delete Travel Request
operations.description: Delete a travel request (DELETE /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}).

operations.name: Move Travel Request (Workflow Action)
operations.description: Move a travel request through workflow (POST /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}/{action}). Valid actions: submit, recall, cancel, approve, sendback, close, reopen.

operations.name: List Travel Request Comments
operations.description: List comments on a travel request (GET /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}/comments).

operations.name: Get Request Cash Advance
operations.description: Get a single cash advance assigned to a travel request (GET /travelrequest/v4/cashadvances/{cashAdvanceUuid}). This endpoint exists for feature parity only and will be deprecated in the future — SAP recommends relying on the list of cash advances link available in the Request payload response instead.

operations.name: Create Expected Expense
operations.description: Create an expected expense on a travel request (POST /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}/expenses).

operations.name: List Expected Expenses
operations.description: List expected expenses on a travel request (GET /travelrequest/v4/requests/{requestUuid}/expenses).

operations.name: Get Expected Expense
operations.description: Get an expected expense (GET /travelrequest/v4/expenses/{expenseUuid}).

operations.name: Update Expected Expense
operations.description: Update an expected expense (PUT /travelrequest/v4/expenses/{expenseUuid}).

operations.name: Delete Expected Expense
operations.description: Delete an expected expense (DELETE /travelrequest/v4/expenses/{expenseUuid}).

operations.name: Create Cash Advance
operations.description: Create a cash advance (POST /cashadvance/v4.1/cashadvances).

operations.name: Get Cash Advance
operations.description: Get a cash advance (GET /cashadvance/v4.1/cashadvances/{cashAdvanceId}).

operations.name: Issue Cash Advance
operations.description: Issue a cash advance (POST /cashadvance/v4.1/cashadvances/{cashAdvanceId}/issue).

operations.name: List Itineraries (Trips)
operations.description: List travel trips/itineraries (GET /api/travel/trip/v1.1).

operations.name: Get Itinerary (Trip)
operations.description: Get a single trip/itinerary (GET /api/travel/trip/v1.1/{tripID}).

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: List Concur user identities (GET /profile/identity/v4.1/Users).

operations.name: Get User
operations.description: Get a single user by UUID (GET /profile/identity/v4.1/Users/{id}).

operations.name: Create User
operations.description: Create a new user identity (POST /profile/identity/v4.1/Users).

operations.name: Update User (PATCH)
operations.description: Patch a user identity (PATCH /profile/identity/v4.1/Users/{id}).

operations.name: Delete User
operations.description: Hard delete a user identity (DELETE /profile/identity/v4.1/Users/{id}). Not recommended: SAP restricts hard delete to users with no transaction history and governs it by the Concur Data Retention policy. To deactivate a user instead, use SAP Concur Update User with a PATCH replacing active with false.

operations.name: Search Users
operations.description: Search users via SCIM .search endpoint (POST /profile/identity/v4.1/Users/.search).

operations.name: List Lists
operations.description: List custom lists (GET /list/v4/lists).

operations.name: Get List
operations.description: Get a single custom list (GET /list/v4/lists/{listId}).

operations.name: List List Items
operations.description: List the top-level items (children) for a custom list (GET /list/v4/lists/{listId}/children).

operations.name: Get List Item
operations.description: Get a single list item (GET /list/v4/items/{itemId}).

operations.name: Create List Item
operations.description: Create a list item (POST /list/v4/items).

operations.name: Update List Item
operations.description: Update a list item (PUT /list/v4/items/{itemId}).

operations.name: Delete List Item
operations.description: Delete a list item from all lists that contain it (DELETE /list/v4/items/{itemId}). This is not scoped to a single list, and all children of that list item are also deleted.

operations.name: List Budgets
operations.description: List budget item headers (GET /budget/v4/budgetItemHeader).

operations.name: Get Budget
operations.description: Get a budget item header by ID (GET /budget/v4/budgetItemHeader/{id}).

operations.name: List Budget Categories
operations.description: List budget categories (GET /budget/v4/budgetCategory).

operations.name: Upload Exchange Rates
operations.description: Bulk upload up to 100 custom exchange rates (POST /exchangerate/v4/rates). Body contains a currency_sets array, each with from_crn_code, to_crn_code, start_date (YYYY-MM-DD), and rate.

operations.name: Create Purchase Request
operations.description: Create a purchase request (POST /purchaserequest/v4/purchaserequests).

operations.name: Get Purchase Request
operations.description: Get a purchase request by ID (GET /purchaserequest/v4/purchaserequests/{id}).

operations.name: Get Travel Profile
operations.description: Get a travel profile (GET /api/travelprofile/v2.0/profile). Returns the calling user by default; pass userid_type and userid_value to impersonate.

operations.name: List Travel Profiles Summary
operations.description: List travel profile summaries (GET /api/travelprofile/v2.0/summary). LastModifiedDate is required by Concur.

operations.name: Search Locations
operations.description: Search Concur location reference data (GET /localities/v5/locations).

integrations.name: SAP S4HANA
integrations.description: Read and write SAP S4HANA Cloud business data via OData
integrations.longDescription: Connect SAP S4HANA Cloud Public Edition, Cloud Private Edition, or an on-premise tenant using the deployment and authentication settings for that tenant. Read and manage business records through the listed OData operations.

operations.name: List Business Partners
operations.description: List business partners from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_BusinessPartner) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Business Partner
operations.description: Retrieve a single business partner by BusinessPartner key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_BusinessPartner).

operations.name: Create Business Partner
operations.description: Create a business partner in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_BusinessPartner). For Person category 1 provide FirstName and LastName. For Organization category 2 provide OrganizationBPName1.

operations.name: Update Business Partner
operations.description: Update fields on an A_BusinessPartner entity in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER). Uses HTTP MERGE (OData v2 partial update) — only the fields you provide are written; existing values are preserved. If-Match defaults to a wildcard (unconditional) — for safe concurrent updates pass the ETag from a prior GET to avoid lost updates. Deep updates on nested associations (e.g. to_BusinessPartnerAddress) are not supported by SAP (KBA 2833338) — use the dedicated child endpoints.

operations.name: List Customers
operations.description: List customers from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_Customer) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Customer
operations.description: Retrieve a single customer by Customer key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_Customer).

operations.name: List Suppliers
operations.description: List suppliers from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_Supplier) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Supplier
operations.description: Retrieve a single supplier by Supplier key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BUSINESS_PARTNER, A_Supplier).

operations.name: List Sales Orders
operations.description: List sales orders from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_SALES_ORDER_SRV, A_SalesOrder) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Sales Order
operations.description: Retrieve a single sales order by SalesOrder key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_SALES_ORDER_SRV, A_SalesOrder).

operations.name: Create Sales Order
operations.description: Create a sales order in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_SALES_ORDER_SRV, A_SalesOrder) with deep insert of sales order items via to_Item.

operations.name: Delete Sales Order
operations.description: Delete an A_SalesOrder entity in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_SALES_ORDER_SRV). Only orders without subsequent documents (deliveries, invoices) can be deleted; otherwise reject items via update instead.

operations.name: List Outbound Deliveries
operations.description: List outbound deliveries from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=0002, A_OutbDeliveryHeader) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Outbound Delivery
operations.description: Retrieve a single outbound delivery by DeliveryDocument key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_OUTBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=0002, A_OutbDeliveryHeader).

operations.name: List Inbound Deliveries
operations.description: List inbound deliveries from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=0002, A_InbDeliveryHeader) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Inbound Delivery
operations.description: Retrieve a single inbound delivery by DeliveryDocument key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_INBOUND_DELIVERY_SRV;v=0002, A_InbDeliveryHeader).

operations.name: List Billing Documents
operations.description: List billing documents (customer invoices) from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_SRV, A_BillingDocument) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Billing Document
operations.description: Retrieve a single billing document (customer invoice) by BillingDocument key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_BILLING_DOCUMENT_SRV, A_BillingDocument).

operations.name: List Products
operations.description: List products (materials) from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PRODUCT_SRV, A_Product) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Product
operations.description: Retrieve a single product (material) by Product key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PRODUCT_SRV, A_Product).

operations.name: List Material Stock
operations.description: List material stock quantities from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_MATERIAL_STOCK_SRV, A_MatlStkInAcctMod). The entity uses an 11-field composite key (Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, Supplier, Customer, WBSElementInternalID, SDDocument, SDDocumentItem, InventorySpecialStockType, InventoryStockType) — query with $filter on these fields instead of a direct key lookup.

operations.name: List Material Documents
operations.description: List material document headers (goods movements) from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV, A_MaterialDocumentHeader) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Material Document
operations.description: Retrieve a single material document header by composite key (MaterialDocument + MaterialDocumentYear) from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_MATERIAL_DOCUMENT_SRV, A_MaterialDocumentHeader).

operations.name: List Purchase Requisitions
operations.description: List purchase requisitions from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV, A_PurchaseRequisitionHeader) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand. Note: API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV is deprecated since S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2402; the successor is API_PURCHASEREQUISITION_2 (OData v4). This tool still works against tenants where the legacy service is enabled.

operations.name: Get Purchase Requisition
operations.description: Retrieve a single purchase requisition by PurchaseRequisition key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV, A_PurchaseRequisitionHeader). Note: API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV is deprecated since S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2402; the successor is API_PURCHASEREQUISITION_2 (OData v4). This tool still works against tenants where the legacy service is enabled.

operations.name: Create Purchase Requisition
operations.description: Create a purchase requisition in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV, A_PurchaseRequisitionHeader). PurchaseRequisition is auto-assigned by SAP from the document number range; provide line items via the to_PurchaseReqnItem deep-insert array. Note: API_PURCHASEREQ_PROCESS_SRV is deprecated since S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition 2402; the successor is API_PURCHASEREQUISITION_2 (OData v4). This tool still works against tenants where the legacy service is enabled.

operations.name: List Purchase Orders
operations.description: List purchase orders from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV, A_PurchaseOrder) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Purchase Order
operations.description: Retrieve a single purchase order by PurchaseOrder key from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV, A_PurchaseOrder).

operations.name: Create Purchase Order
operations.description: Create a purchase order in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV, A_PurchaseOrder). PurchaseOrder is auto-assigned by SAP from the document number range; provide line items via the body parameter.

operations.name: Update Purchase Order
operations.description: Update fields on an A_PurchaseOrder header in SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_PURCHASEORDER_PROCESS_SRV). Uses HTTP MERGE (OData v2 partial update) — only the fields you provide are written; existing values are preserved. Header-only — line-item changes are not supported via deep update on the header (SAP KBA 2833338); use the A_PurchaseOrderItem entity directly to modify items. If-Match defaults to a wildcard - for safe concurrent updates pass the ETag from a prior GET to avoid lost updates.

operations.name: List Supplier Invoices
operations.description: List supplier invoices from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_SUPPLIERINVOICE_PROCESS_SRV, A_SupplierInvoice) with optional OData $filter, $top, $skip, $orderby, $select, $expand.

operations.name: Get Supplier Invoice
operations.description: Retrieve a single supplier invoice by composite key (SupplierInvoice + FiscalYear) from SAP S/4HANA Cloud (API_SUPPLIERINVOICE_PROCESS_SRV, A_SupplierInvoice).

operations.name: OData Query (advanced)
operations.description: Make an arbitrary OData v2 call against any SAP S/4HANA Cloud whitelisted Communication Scenario. Use when no dedicated tool exists for the entity. The integration handles auth, CSRF, and OData unwrapping. For write operations (POST/PUT/PATCH/MERGE/DELETE), pass an If-Match ETag obtained from a prior GET to avoid lost updates; misuse will mutate production data.

integrations.name: Semrush
integrations.description: Research SEO and paid search data with Semrush
integrations.longDescription: Query the Semrush SEO API for domain, subdomain, and URL traffic overviews, organic and paid keywords, ad and product listing creatives, competitor sets, keyword research, and backlink profiles. Requires a Semrush subscription with API units.

operations.name: Domain Overview
operations.description: Get the Semrush rank plus organic and paid search totals for a domain in one regional database.

operations.name: Domain Overview (All Databases)
operations.description: Get organic and paid search totals for a domain across every regional Semrush database.

operations.name: Domain Overview History
operations.description: Get the historical trend of a domain rank plus its organic and paid search totals.

operations.name: Domain Organic Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords a domain ranks for in Google organic search, with position, volume, and traffic share.

operations.name: Domain Paid Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords a domain buys in Google Ads, with ad position, copy, and traffic share.

operations.name: Domain Ad Copies
operations.description: List the unique Google Ads creatives a domain runs, with title, description, and keyword count.

operations.name: Domain Ad History
operations.description: List a domain past Google Ads placements month by month, with the copy used each time.

operations.name: Organic Competitors
operations.description: List the domains competing with a target domain in Google organic search results.

operations.name: Paid Competitors
operations.description: List the domains competing with a target domain in Google paid search results.

operations.name: Domain PLA Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords that trigger a domain product listing ads, with the promoted product and price.

operations.name: Domain PLA Copies
operations.description: List the unique product listing ads a domain runs, with product title, price, and shop name.

operations.name: Domain vs. Domain
operations.description: Compare up to five domains on the keywords they rank for, returning each domain position side by side.

operations.name: Subdomain Overview
operations.description: Get the organic and paid search totals for a subdomain in one regional database.

operations.name: Subdomain Overview (All Databases)
operations.description: Get organic and paid search totals for a subdomain across every regional Semrush database.

operations.name: Subdomain Overview History
operations.description: Get the historical trend of a subdomain organic and paid search totals.

operations.name: Subdomain Organic Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords a subdomain ranks for in Google organic search.

operations.name: Subdomain Paid Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords a subdomain buys in Google Ads.

operations.name: Subdomain Ad Copies
operations.description: List the unique Google Ads creatives a subdomain runs.

operations.name: URL Overview
operations.description: Get the organic and paid search totals for a single URL in one regional database.

operations.name: URL Overview (All Databases)
operations.description: Get organic and paid search totals for a single URL across every regional Semrush database.

operations.name: URL Overview History
operations.description: Get the historical trend of a URL organic and paid search totals.

operations.name: URL Organic Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords a single URL ranks for in Google organic search.

operations.name: URL Paid Keywords
operations.description: List the keywords a single URL is advertised on in Google Ads, with the ad copy used.

operations.name: Keyword Overview
operations.description: Get search volume, CPC, competition, difficulty, and intent for a single keyword.

operations.name: Keyword Overview (All Databases)
operations.description: Get search volume, CPC, and competition for a keyword across every regional Semrush database.

operations.name: Batch Keyword Overview
operations.description: Get search volume, CPC, competition, difficulty, and intent for up to 100 keywords at once.

operations.name: Keyword Difficulty
operations.description: Get the Keyword Difficulty Index for up to 100 keywords at once.

operations.name: Related Keywords
operations.description: Find keywords semantically related to a seed keyword, with volume, difficulty, and relevance.

operations.name: Broad Match Keywords
operations.description: Find broad-match and phrase-match variations of a seed keyword, with volume and difficulty.

operations.name: Keyword Questions
operations.description: Find question-form keywords containing a seed keyword, with volume and difficulty.

operations.name: Organic Results
operations.description: List the domains and URLs ranking in Google organic search results for a keyword.

operations.name: Paid Results
operations.description: List the domains and URLs advertising on a keyword in Google paid search results.

operations.name: Keyword Ad History
operations.description: List which domains advertised on a keyword month by month, with the copy each one used.

operations.name: Winners and Losers
operations.description: List the domains that gained or lost the most organic and paid search visibility in a database.

operations.name: Top Domains
operations.description: List the highest-ranked domains in a regional database by Semrush rank.

operations.name: Backlinks Overview
operations.description: Get the Authority Score and backlink profile totals for a domain, subdomain, or URL.

operations.name: Backlinks
operations.description: List the backlinks pointing at a domain, subdomain, or URL, with source page, anchor, and authority.

operations.name: Referring Domains
operations.description: List the domains linking to a target, with Authority Score, backlink count, and country.

operations.name: Referring IPs
operations.description: List the IP addresses linking to a target, with the domain and backlink counts behind each one.

operations.name: Backlink TLD Distribution
operations.description: Break a target backlink profile down by the top-level domain of its referring domains.

operations.name: Backlink Country Distribution
operations.description: Break a target backlink profile down by the country of its referring domains.

operations.name: Backlink Anchors
operations.description: List the anchor texts used in backlinks to a target, with domain and backlink counts.

operations.name: Indexed Pages
operations.description: List the pages of a target that attract backlinks, with response code and link counts.

operations.name: Backlink Competitors
operations.description: List domains with a backlink profile similar to the target, ranked by shared referring domains.

integrations.name: Sendblue
integrations.description: Send and receive iMessage and SMS
integrations.longDescription: Send iMessages and SMS to individuals or groups, check whether a number supports iMessage, show typing indicators, and look up message status with Sendblue. Trigger workflows on inbound messages and delivery status updates.

operations.name: Send Message
operations.description: Send an iMessage or SMS to a single recipient via Sendblue.

operations.name: Send Group Message
operations.description: Send an iMessage or SMS to a group of recipients via Sendblue.

operations.name: Evaluate Service
operations.description: Check whether a phone number can receive iMessage or only SMS.

operations.name: Send Typing Indicator
operations.description: Display a typing indicator to a recipient (not supported in group chats).

operations.name: Get Message
operations.description: Retrieve a single message and its current status by message handle/ID.

triggers.name: Sendblue Message Received
triggers.description: Trigger when an inbound iMessage or SMS is received in Sendblue

triggers.name: Sendblue Message Status Updated
triggers.description: Trigger when an outbound message status changes (SENT, DELIVERED, ERROR) in Sendblue

integrations.name: SendGrid
integrations.description: Send emails and manage contacts, lists, and templates with SendGrid
integrations.longDescription: Integrate SendGrid into your workflow. Send transactional emails, manage marketing contacts and lists, and work with email templates. Supports dynamic templates, attachments, and comprehensive contact management.

operations.name: Send Mail
operations.description: Send an email using SendGrid API

operations.name: Add Contact
operations.description: Add a new contact to SendGrid

operations.name: Get Contact
operations.description: Get a specific contact by ID from SendGrid

operations.name: Search Contacts
operations.description: Search for contacts in SendGrid using a query

operations.name: Delete Contacts
operations.description: Delete one or more contacts from SendGrid

operations.name: Create List
operations.description: Create a new contact list in SendGrid

operations.name: Get List
operations.description: Get a specific list by ID from SendGrid

operations.name: List All Lists
operations.description: Get all contact lists from SendGrid

operations.name: Delete List
operations.description: Delete a contact list from SendGrid

operations.name: Add Contacts to List
operations.description: Add or update contacts and assign them to a list in SendGrid (uses PUT /v3/marketing/contacts)

operations.name: Remove Contacts from List
operations.description: Remove contacts from a specific list in SendGrid

operations.name: Create Template
operations.description: Create a new email template in SendGrid

operations.name: Get Template
operations.description: Get a specific template by ID from SendGrid

operations.name: List Templates
operations.description: Get all email templates from SendGrid

operations.name: Delete Template
operations.description: Delete an email template from SendGrid

operations.name: Create Template Version
operations.description: Create a new version of an email template in SendGrid

integrations.name: Sentry
integrations.description: Manage Sentry issues, projects, events, and releases
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Sentry into the workflow. Monitor issues, manage projects, track events, and coordinate releases across your applications.

operations.name: List Issues
operations.description: List issues from Sentry for a specific organization and optionally a specific project. Returns issue details including status, error counts, and last seen timestamps.

operations.name: Get Issue
operations.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Sentry issue by its ID. Returns complete issue details including metadata, tags, and statistics.

operations.name: Update Issue
operations.description: Update a Sentry issue by changing its status, assignment, bookmark state, or other properties. Returns the updated issue details.

operations.name: List Projects
operations.description: List all projects in a Sentry organization. Returns project details including name, platform, teams, and configuration.

operations.name: Get Project
operations.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Sentry project by its slug. Returns complete project details including teams, features, and configuration.

operations.name: Create Project
operations.description: Create a new Sentry project in an organization. Requires a team to associate the project with. Returns the created project details.

operations.name: Update Project
operations.description: Update a Sentry project by changing its name, slug, platform, or other settings. Returns the updated project details.

operations.name: List Teams
operations.description: List all teams in a Sentry organization. Useful for discovering the team slug required when creating a project. Returns team details including slug, name, member count, and associated projects.

operations.name: List Events
operations.description: List events from a Sentry project. Can be filtered by issue ID, query, or time period. Returns event details including context, tags, and user information.

operations.name: Get Event
operations.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Sentry event by its ID. Returns complete event details including stack traces, breadcrumbs, context, and user information.

operations.name: List Releases
operations.description: List releases for a Sentry organization or project. Returns release details including version, commits, deploy information, and associated projects.

operations.name: Create Release
operations.description: Create a new release in Sentry. A release is a version of your code deployed to an environment. Can include commit information and associated projects. Returns the created release details.

operations.name: Create Deploy
operations.description: Create a deploy record for a Sentry release in a specific environment. Deploys track when and where releases are deployed. Returns the created deploy details.

triggers.name: Sentry Issue Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new issue is created in Sentry

triggers.name: Sentry Issue Resolved
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an issue is resolved in Sentry

triggers.name: Sentry Error Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new error event is created in Sentry

triggers.name: Sentry Issue Alert
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Sentry issue alert rule fires

triggers.name: Sentry Metric Alert
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a Sentry metric alert changes state (critical, warning, resolved)

integrations.name: Serper
integrations.description: Search the web using Serper
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Serper into the workflow. Can search the web.

integrations.name: ServiceNow
integrations.description: Create, read, update, and delete ServiceNow records
integrations.longDescription: Integrate ServiceNow into your workflow. Create, read, update, and delete records in any ServiceNow table including incidents, tasks, change requests, users, and more.

operations.name: Create Incident
operations.description: Create an incident in ServiceNow. Reference fields (caller, assignment group, assigned to, configuration item) take sys_ids unless input display value is enabled.

operations.name: Get Incident
operations.description: Retrieve a single ServiceNow incident by number (e.g., INC0010001) or sys_id. Reference fields are returned with both their sys_id and their label by default.

operations.name: List Incidents
operations.description: Search ServiceNow incidents by state, priority, assignment, caller, or text. All filters are ANDed together.

operations.name: Update Incident
operations.description: Update fields on an existing ServiceNow incident. Only the fields you supply are changed. Reference fields take sys_ids unless input display value is enabled.

operations.name: Resolve Incident
operations.description: Move a ServiceNow incident to Resolved (state 6) with a resolution code and resolution notes.

operations.name: Close Incident
operations.description: Move a ServiceNow incident to Closed (state 7) with a resolution code and resolution notes. Which roles may close an incident is instance-configurable, so the credential may need elevated rights.

operations.name: Add Incident Comment
operations.description: Append an internal work note or a customer-visible additional comment to a ServiceNow incident. Both are journal fields, so the text is appended rather than replacing earlier entries.

operations.name: Create Change Request
operations.description: Create a change request in ServiceNow. Reference fields (assignment group, assigned to, requested by, configuration item) take sys_ids unless input display value is enabled.

operations.name: Get Change Request
operations.description: Retrieve a single ServiceNow change request by number (e.g., CHG0030001) or sys_id. Reference fields are returned with both their sys_id and their label by default.

operations.name: List Change Requests
operations.description: Search ServiceNow change requests by state, type, risk, assignment, or text. All filters are ANDed together.

operations.name: Update Change Request
operations.description: Update fields on an existing ServiceNow change request. Only the fields you supply are changed. Use Move ServiceNow Change State for state transitions.

operations.name: Move Change State
operations.description: Move a ServiceNow change request to another state. Base-system change model states are -5=New, -4=Assess, -3=Authorize, -2=Scheduled, -1=Implement, 0=Review, 3=Closed, 4=Canceled. The state machine rejects transitions whose conditions are not met.

operations.name: List Change Tasks
operations.description: List the change tasks belonging to a ServiceNow change request, via the Change Management API. Every field is returned as {value, display_value}, so a reference field carries both its sys_id and its label. This endpoint is not the Table API: the shape is fixed with no display-value option, and the results come back under `tasks` rather than the `records` the other list operations use.

operations.name: Get Change Next States
operations.description: Read the states a ServiceNow change request can actually move to next, with the instance's own state-to-label map and the conditions each transition still has to meet. Use this instead of assuming the base-system state codes, which a customized change model can change.

operations.name: List Catalog Items
operations.description: Browse or search the ServiceNow service catalog. Returns each item with its sys_id, name, description, type, category, and catalogs, which is what Order ServiceNow Catalog Item needs.

operations.name: Order Catalog Item
operations.description: Submit a service catalog request for a catalog item using the Service Catalog API order_now endpoint. Returns the generated request number and sys_id.

operations.name: List Requested Items
operations.description: List requested items (RITMs) from the ServiceNow Requested Item [sc_req_item] table, optionally scoped to a parent request or a catalog item. To scope by requester, pass an encoded query against the parent request, for example "request.requested_for=<sys_id>".

operations.name: Get Requested Item
operations.description: Retrieve a single ServiceNow requested item (RITM) by number (e.g., RITM0010001) or sys_id from the Requested Item [sc_req_item] table.

operations.name: List Approvals
operations.description: List approval records from the ServiceNow Approval [sysapproval_approver] table. Defaults to the "requested" state, which is what a user's pending approvals look like.

operations.name: Approve or Reject
operations.description: Approve or reject a ServiceNow approval record by setting its state on the Approval [sysapproval_approver] table.

operations.name: Search Configuration Items
operations.description: Search the ServiceNow CMDB for configuration items. Defaults to the base cmdb_ci table, which returns CIs of every class; pass a CI class to scope the search to a subclass such as cmdb_ci_linux_server.

operations.name: Get Configuration Item
operations.description: Retrieve a configuration item and its CMDB relationships through the CMDB Instance API. Returns the CI attributes plus its inbound and outbound relations, each carrying the related CI and the relationship type.

operations.name: List CI Relationships
operations.description: List rows from the CI Relationship [cmdb_rel_ci] table for a configuration item. Each row carries the parent CI, the child CI, and the relationship type.

operations.name: Search Knowledge
operations.description: Search ServiceNow knowledge base articles through the Knowledge Management API. Returns ranked results with a snippet and the article number, which Get ServiceNow Knowledge Article accepts to fetch the full body.

operations.name: Get Knowledge Article
operations.description: Retrieve the full content of a ServiceNow knowledge article by sys_id or KB number through the Knowledge Management API.

operations.name: Find User
operations.description: Look up ServiceNow users by email, user name, or display name. Use this to resolve the sys_id needed by reference fields such as caller_id, assigned_to, and approver.

operations.name: List Group Members
operations.description: List the members of a ServiceNow group from the Group Member [sys_user_grmember] table. Each row links a user to a group, so use it to find who can be assigned work for an assignment group.

operations.name: Create Record
operations.description: Create a new record in a ServiceNow table

operations.name: Read Records
operations.description: Read records from a ServiceNow table

operations.name: Update Record
operations.description: Update an existing record in a ServiceNow table

operations.name: Delete Record
operations.description: Delete a record from a ServiceNow table

operations.name: Aggregate Records
operations.description: Compute aggregate statistics (count, sum, average, min, max, group by) over a ServiceNow table

operations.name: List Attachments
operations.description: List the attachments on a ServiceNow record

operations.name: Download Attachment
operations.description: Download an attachment file from ServiceNow by its sys_id

operations.name: Upload Attachment
operations.description: Attach a file to a ServiceNow record

triggers.name: ServiceNow Incident Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new incident is created in ServiceNow

triggers.name: ServiceNow Incident Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when an incident is updated in ServiceNow

triggers.name: ServiceNow Change Request Created
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a new change request is created in ServiceNow

triggers.name: ServiceNow Change Request Updated
triggers.description: Trigger workflow when a change request is updated in ServiceNow

triggers.name: ServiceNow Webhook (All Events)
triggers.description: Trigger workflow on any ServiceNow webhook event

integrations.name: SFTP
integrations.description: Transfer files via SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol)
integrations.longDescription: Upload, download, list, and manage files on remote servers via SFTP. Supports both password and private key authentication for secure file transfers.

operations.name: Upload Files
operations.description: Upload files to a remote SFTP server

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from a remote SFTP server

operations.name: List Directory
operations.description: List files and directories on a remote SFTP server

operations.name: Delete File/Directory
operations.description: Delete a file or directory on a remote SFTP server

operations.name: Create Directory
operations.description: Create a directory on a remote SFTP server

integrations.name: SharePoint
integrations.description: Work with pages and lists
integrations.longDescription: Integrate SharePoint into the workflow. Read/create pages, list sites, and work with lists (read, create, update items). Requires OAuth.

operations.name: Create Page
operations.description: Create a new page in a SharePoint site

operations.name: Read Page
operations.description: Read a specific page from a SharePoint site

operations.name: Update Page
operations.description: Update the title and/or content of a SharePoint page

operations.name: Publish Page
operations.description: Publish the latest version of a SharePoint page, making it available to all users

operations.name: Delete Page
operations.description: Delete a page from a SharePoint site

operations.name: List Sites
operations.description: List details of all SharePoint sites

operations.name: Create List
operations.description: Create a new list in a SharePoint site

operations.name: Read List
operations.description: Get metadata (and optionally columns/items) for a SharePoint list

operations.name: Update List Item
operations.description: Update the properties (fields) on a SharePoint list item

operations.name: Add List Item
operations.description: Add a new item to a SharePoint list

operations.name: Get List Item
operations.description: Get a single item (with field values) from a SharePoint list

operations.name: Delete List Item
operations.description: Delete an item from a SharePoint list

operations.name: Upload File
operations.description: Upload files to a SharePoint document library

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from a SharePoint document library

operations.name: Get Drive Item
operations.description: Get metadata for a file or folder in a SharePoint document library

operations.name: Delete File
operations.description: Delete a file (or folder) from a SharePoint document library

integrations.name: Shopify
integrations.description: Manage products, orders, customers, and inventory in your Shopify store
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Shopify into your workflow. Manage products, orders, customers, and inventory. Create, read, update, and delete products. List and manage orders. Handle customer data and adjust inventory levels.

operations.name: Create Product
operations.description: Create a new product in your Shopify store

operations.name: Get Product
operations.description: Get a single product by ID from your Shopify store

operations.name: List Products
operations.description: List products from your Shopify store with optional filtering

operations.name: Update Product
operations.description: Update an existing product in your Shopify store

operations.name: Delete Product
operations.description: Delete a product from your Shopify store

operations.name: Get Order
operations.description: Get a single order by ID from your Shopify store

operations.name: List Orders
operations.description: List orders from your Shopify store with optional filtering

operations.name: Update Order
operations.description: Update an existing order in your Shopify store (note, tags, email)

operations.name: Cancel Order
operations.description: Cancel an order in your Shopify store

operations.name: Create Customer
operations.description: Create a new customer in your Shopify store

operations.name: Get Customer
operations.description: Get a single customer by ID from your Shopify store

operations.name: List Customers
operations.description: List customers from your Shopify store with optional filtering

operations.name: Update Customer
operations.description: Update an existing customer in your Shopify store

operations.name: Delete Customer
operations.description: Delete a customer from your Shopify store

operations.name: List Inventory Items
operations.description: List inventory items from your Shopify store. Use this to find inventory item IDs by SKU.

operations.name: Get Inventory Level
operations.description: Get inventory level for a product variant at a specific location

operations.name: Adjust Inventory
operations.description: Adjust inventory quantity for a product variant at a specific location

operations.name: List Locations
operations.description: List inventory locations from your Shopify store. Use this to find location IDs needed for inventory operations.

operations.name: Create Fulfillment
operations.description: Create a fulfillment to mark order items as shipped. Requires a fulfillment order ID (get this from the order details).

operations.name: List Collections
operations.description: List product collections from your Shopify store. Filter by title, type (custom/smart), or handle.

operations.name: Get Collection

integrations.name: Similarweb
integrations.description: Website traffic and analytics data
integrations.longDescription: Access comprehensive website analytics including traffic estimates, engagement metrics, rankings, and traffic sources using the Similarweb API.

operations.name: Website Overview
operations.description: Get comprehensive website analytics including traffic, rankings, engagement, and traffic sources

operations.name: Traffic Visits
operations.description: Get total website visits over time (desktop and mobile combined)

operations.name: Bounce Rate
operations.description: Get website bounce rate over time (desktop and mobile combined)

operations.name: Pages Per Visit
operations.description: Get average pages per visit over time (desktop and mobile combined)

operations.name: Visit Duration (Desktop)
operations.description: Get average desktop visit duration over time (in seconds)

operations.name: Page Views
operations.description: Get total page views over time (desktop and mobile combined)

integrations.name: Sixtyfour AI
integrations.description: Enrich leads and companies with AI-powered research
integrations.longDescription: Find emails, phone numbers, and enrich lead or company data with contact information, social profiles, and detailed research using Sixtyfour AI.

operations.name: Find Phone
operations.description: Find phone numbers for a lead using Sixtyfour AI.

operations.name: Find Email
operations.description: Find email addresses for a lead using Sixtyfour AI.

operations.name: Enrich Lead
operations.description: Enrich lead information with contact details, social profiles, and company data using Sixtyfour AI.

operations.name: Enrich Company
operations.description: Enrich company data with additional information and find associated people using Sixtyfour AI.

integrations.name: Slack
integrations.description: Send and manage Slack messages, Agent Sessions, streamed replies, views, reactions, conversations, and canvases
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Slack messaging and administration into a workflow. Custom Slack bots can manage Agent Sessions, stream incremental Markdown or structured chunks, react to Agent Session events, and configure Agent View suggested prompts. Standard messaging and management operations support both the Sim app and custom bot credentials.

operations.name: Send Message
operations.description: Send messages to Slack channels or direct messages. Supports Slack mrkdwn formatting.

operations.name: Send Ephemeral Message
operations.description: Send an ephemeral message visible only to a specific user in a channel. Optionally reply in a thread. The message does not persist across sessions.

operations.name: Create Canvas
operations.description: Create and share Slack canvases in channels. Canvases are collaborative documents within Slack.

operations.name: Read Messages
operations.description: Read the latest messages from Slack channels. Retrieve conversation history with filtering options.

operations.name: Get Message
operations.description: Retrieve a specific message by its timestamp. Useful for getting a thread parent message.

operations.name: Get Thread
operations.description: Retrieve an entire thread including the parent message and all replies. Useful for getting full conversation context.

operations.name: Get Thread Replies
operations.description: Fetch every message in a Slack thread, automatically following pagination across all pages. Returns the parent message and the full set of replies.

operations.name: Get Channel History
operations.description: Fetch message history from a Slack channel, automatically following pagination. Optionally filter by a time range to scrape messages since a given timestamp.

operations.name: Get Message Permalink
operations.description: Get a stable permalink URL to a specific Slack message.

operations.name: Set Assistant Status
operations.description: Set or clear the assistant thread status indicator (the loading shimmer) on a Slack AI app thread. Pass an empty status to clear it.

operations.name: Set Assistant Title
operations.description: Set the title of a Slack assistant thread (shown in the AI app thread header).

operations.name: Set Assistant Suggested Prompts
operations.description: Set the clickable suggested prompts shown in a Slack assistant thread (the prompt chips in an AI app).

operations.name: Set Agent Suggested Prompts
operations.description: Set suggested prompts in Slack Agent View, optionally scoped to a specific thread.

operations.name: Set Agent Session Status
operations.description: Create or update the state of a Slack agent session associated with a thread.

operations.name: Rename Agent Session
operations.description: Rename the Slack agent session associated with a thread.

operations.name: List Channels
operations.description: List one page of accessible public and private Slack channels. Pass the returned nextCursor as cursor to fetch the next page.

operations.name: List Channel Members
operations.description: List all members (user IDs) in a Slack channel. Use with Get User Info to resolve IDs to names.

operations.name: List Users
operations.description: List all users in a Slack workspace. Returns user profiles with names and avatars.

operations.name: Get User Info
operations.description: Get detailed information about a specific Slack user by their user ID.

operations.name: Download File
operations.description: Download a file from Slack

operations.name: Update Message
operations.description: Update a message previously sent by the bot in Slack

operations.name: Delete Message
operations.description: Delete a message previously sent by the bot in Slack

operations.name: Add Reaction
operations.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message

operations.name: Remove Reaction
operations.description: Remove an emoji reaction from a Slack message

operations.name: Get Channel Info
operations.description: Get detailed information about a Slack channel by its ID

operations.name: Get User Presence
operations.description: Check whether a Slack user is currently active or away

operations.name: Edit Canvas
operations.description: Edit an existing Slack canvas by inserting, replacing, or deleting content

operations.name: Create Channel Canvas
operations.description: Create a canvas pinned to a Slack channel as its resource hub

operations.name: Get Canvas Info
operations.description: Get Slack canvas file metadata by canvas ID

operations.name: List Canvases
operations.description: List Slack canvases available to the authenticated user or bot

operations.name: Lookup Canvas Sections
operations.description: Find Slack canvas section IDs matching criteria for later edits

operations.name: Delete Canvas
operations.description: Delete a Slack canvas by its canvas ID

operations.name: Create Conversation
operations.description: Create a new public or private channel in a Slack workspace.

operations.name: Invite to Conversation
operations.description: Invite one or more users to a Slack channel. Supports up to 100 users at a time.

operations.name: Open View
operations.description: Open a modal view in Slack using a trigger_id from an interaction payload. Used to display forms, confirmations, and other interactive modals.

operations.name: Update View
operations.description: Update an existing modal view in Slack. Identify the view by view_id or external_id, and provide the updated view payload.

operations.name: Push View
operations.description: Push a new view onto an existing modal stack in Slack. Limited to 2 additional views after the initial modal is opened.

operations.name: Publish View
operations.description: Publish a static view to a user's Home tab in Slack. Used to create or update the app's Home tab experience.

operations.name: Schedule Message
operations.description: Schedule a message to be sent to a Slack channel or DM at a future time.

operations.name: List Scheduled Messages
operations.description: List pending scheduled messages in a Slack workspace, optionally filtered by channel.

operations.name: Delete Scheduled Message
operations.description: Delete a pending scheduled message before it posts to Slack.

operations.name: Archive Conversation
operations.description: Archive a Slack channel so it is closed to new activity.

operations.name: Rename Conversation
operations.description: Rename an existing Slack channel.

operations.name: Set Conversation Topic
operations.description: Set the topic for a Slack channel (max 250 characters).

operations.name: Set Conversation Purpose
operations.description: Set the purpose (description) for a Slack channel (max 250 characters).

install.heading: Add Sim to your Slack workspace
install.intro: Sim connects to Slack through Slack’s official OAuth flow. The “Add to Slack” button lives inside your Sim account (after sign-in). Connect from there and the Sim bot is installed in your Slack workspace. The steps below show exactly how to reach it.

steps.title: Create your free Sim account
steps.body: Sign up at sim.ai. No credit card required.

steps.title: Add a Slack block
steps.body: Open a workflow, drag in a Slack block, and open its credential dropdown.

steps.title: Connect Slack
steps.body: Click Connect Slack, choose your workspace, and approve the requested permissions. This installs the Sim bot in your Slack workspace.

steps.title: Invite the bot and build
steps.body: Invite the Sim bot to the channels it should act in, pick a Slack action, wire it into your agent, and run.

privacy.body: Sim requests only the Slack permissions its actions and triggers need, and never shows private channel names or messages to people who are not members of those channels in Slack.

landingContent.aiDisclaimer: A paid Slack plan is required to use Sim's AI agent in Slack's app container. Other Sim features continue to work on free Slack plans. Sim agents use AI models to generate messages and responses sent to Slack. AI-generated content can be inaccurate or incomplete, so review automated outputs before relying on them, especially for important communications.

integrations.name: Smartlead
integrations.description: Manage Smartlead cold email campaigns, sequences, and leads
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Smartlead into workflows. Create campaigns, write multi-step email sequences, import and categorize leads, pull campaign analytics, and register webhooks for engagement events.

operations.name: List Campaigns
operations.description: Retrieves all Smartlead campaigns for the authenticated account.

operations.name: Get Campaign
operations.description: Retrieves a single Smartlead campaign by ID.

operations.name: Create Campaign
operations.description: Creates a Smartlead campaign. The campaign starts in DRAFTED status; add sequences, email accounts, and a schedule before starting it.

operations.name: Update Campaign Status
operations.description: Starts, pauses, or stops a Smartlead campaign. START requires the campaign to already have a schedule, sequences, and at least one email account.

operations.name: Update Campaign Schedule
operations.description: Sets the sending window, timezone, and throughput limits for a Smartlead campaign. A campaign cannot be started until a schedule exists.

operations.name: Update Campaign Settings
operations.description: Updates tracking, stop-on-activity, and sending settings for a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: Get Campaign Analytics
operations.description: Retrieves lifetime performance totals for a Smartlead campaign — sends, opens, clicks, replies, bounces, and lead counts by state.

operations.name: Get Campaign Analytics by Date
operations.description: Retrieves Smartlead campaign performance totals for a date range. Smartlead rejects ranges longer than roughly one month.

operations.name: Get Campaign Sequences
operations.description: Retrieves the email sequence steps for a Smartlead campaign, including subjects, bodies, and per-step delays.

operations.name: Save Campaign Sequences
operations.description: Replaces the email sequence for a Smartlead campaign. Send every step in one call — steps omitted from the request are removed. An empty subject makes a step reply in the previous thread.

operations.name: Get Campaign Statistics
operations.description: Retrieves per-email statistics rows for a Smartlead campaign, filterable by sequence step, engagement status, and sent-time range.

operations.name: Add Leads to Campaign
operations.description: Adds leads to a Smartlead campaign, up to 400 per call. Returns per-reason counts for leads that were skipped as duplicates, blocked, bounced, or invalid.

operations.name: List Campaign Leads
operations.description: Retrieves the leads in a Smartlead campaign with their per-campaign status.

operations.name: Get Lead by Email
operations.description: Looks up a Smartlead lead by email address and returns the lead record plus every campaign it belongs to.

operations.name: Update Lead
operations.description: Updates a lead in a Smartlead campaign. Smartlead requires the email field even when it is unchanged, and lead edits apply across every campaign the lead belongs to.

operations.name: Update Lead Category
operations.description: Sets the category of a lead in a Smartlead campaign, such as Interested or Not Interested. Use List Lead Categories to resolve a category ID.

operations.name: Pause Lead
operations.description: Pauses a lead in a Smartlead campaign so it stops receiving sequence emails.

operations.name: Resume Lead
operations.description: Resumes a paused lead in a Smartlead campaign, optionally after a delay.

operations.name: List Lead Categories
operations.description: Retrieves the lead categories configured on the Smartlead account, with the category IDs needed to categorize a lead.

operations.name: Get Lead Message History
operations.description: Retrieves the sent-and-received message history for a lead in a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: List Campaign Webhooks
operations.description: Retrieves the webhooks registered on a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: Create or Update Webhook
operations.description: Creates a webhook on a Smartlead campaign, or updates an existing one when a webhook ID is supplied. Smartlead requires at least one lead category.

operations.name: Delete Campaign Webhook
operations.description: Deletes a webhook from a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: Get Webhook Summary
operations.description: Retrieves webhook delivery counts for a Smartlead campaign over a time window, for checking whether events are reaching their destination.

operations.name: Duplicate Campaign
operations.description: Copies a Smartlead campaign, including its sequences and settings. The copy is named "<original> - copy" and starts in DRAFTED status.

operations.name: Delete Campaign
operations.description: Permanently deletes a Smartlead campaign along with its sequences, leads, and webhooks. This cannot be undone.

operations.name: Export Campaign Leads (CSV)
operations.description: Exports every lead in a Smartlead campaign as CSV, including engagement counts and the sequence step last sent to each lead.

operations.name: List Campaign Email Accounts
operations.description: Retrieves the sending email accounts attached to a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: Add Email Accounts to Campaign
operations.description: Attaches sending email accounts to a Smartlead campaign. A campaign needs at least one attached account before it can start.

operations.name: Remove Email Accounts from Campaign
operations.description: Detaches sending email accounts from a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: List Email Accounts
operations.description: Retrieves the sending email accounts on the Smartlead account, including their IDs for attaching to a campaign.

operations.name: Get Campaign Lead Statistics
operations.description: Retrieves per-lead engagement statistics for a Smartlead campaign.

operations.name: Get Campaign Mailbox Statistics
operations.description: Retrieves per-mailbox sending statistics for a Smartlead campaign, for spotting which sending accounts are underperforming.

operations.name: Get Top-Level Analytics by Date
operations.description: Retrieves top-level Smartlead campaign counts for a date range, including positive replies, skipped, failed, and stopped counts not present in the standard analytics.

operations.name: List Lead Activities
operations.description: Retrieves recent lead activity across all Smartlead campaigns — opens, clicks, replies, and status changes. Smartlead exposes no campaign filter on this endpoint.

operations.name: Get Lead by ID
operations.description: Looks up a Smartlead lead by its ID.

operations.name: Unsubscribe Lead from Campaign
operations.description: Unsubscribes a lead from a single Smartlead campaign, leaving it active in other campaigns.

operations.name: Unsubscribe Lead Globally
operations.description: Unsubscribes a lead across every Smartlead campaign and adds it to the account-wide unsubscribe list.

operations.name: Mark Lead Complete
operations.description: Marks a lead as completed in a Smartlead campaign so it stops receiving further sequence steps.

operations.name: Delete Lead from Campaign
operations.description: Removes a lead from a Smartlead campaign. The lead record itself remains on the account.

operations.name: List Inbox Replies
operations.description: Retrieves replies from the Smartlead master inbox across all campaigns, optionally limited to unread replies. Smartlead exposes no campaign filter on this endpoint.

operations.name: List Lead Lists
operations.description: Retrieves the lead lists on the Smartlead account with their lead counts.

operations.name: Get Lead List
operations.description: Retrieves a single Smartlead lead list by ID.

operations.name: Create Lead List
operations.description: Creates a lead list on the Smartlead account.

operations.name: Update Lead List
operations.description: Renames a Smartlead lead list.

operations.name: Delete Lead List
operations.description: Deletes a Smartlead lead list.

operations.name: List Clients
operations.description: Retrieves the clients on a Smartlead agency account, including the client IDs used to scope campaigns and email accounts.

integrations.name: SMTP
integrations.description: Send emails via any SMTP mail server
integrations.longDescription: Send emails using any SMTP server (Gmail, Outlook, custom servers, etc.). Configure SMTP connection settings and send emails with full control over content, recipients, and attachments.

integrations.name: Snowflake
integrations.description: Query data and manage warehouses and tasks in Snowflake
integrations.longDescription: Connect with a Snowflake programmatic access token to execute SQL, synchronize structured rows, load and unload staged data, browse databases and schemas, size and control warehouses, run and schedule tasks, review query and load history, inspect schemas, and call stored procedures.

operations.name: Execute SQL
operations.description: Execute one parameterized SQL statement through the Snowflake SQL API.

operations.name: Get Statement
operations.description: Check a running or completed statement and retrieve exactly one result partition. Canceled or failed statements are returned as errors.

operations.name: Cancel Statement
operations.description: Cancel a running Snowflake SQL API statement.

operations.name: Insert Rows
operations.description: Insert structured JSON rows using bound values.

operations.name: Update Rows
operations.description: Update matching rows with a bound MERGE statement without inserting new rows.

operations.name: Upsert Rows
operations.description: Update matching rows and insert unmatched rows with a bound MERGE statement.

operations.name: Delete Rows
operations.description: Delete rows matching a required set of bound column filters.

operations.name: Load Data
operations.description: Load files from an existing Snowflake stage with COPY INTO.

operations.name: Unload Data
operations.description: Export a Snowflake table to files in a stage with COPY INTO.

operations.name: List Databases
operations.description: List the databases the credential can access.

operations.name: List Schemas
operations.description: List the schemas in a Snowflake database.

operations.name: List Tables
operations.description: List the tables in a Snowflake schema.

operations.name: List Warehouses
operations.description: List warehouses visible to the active Snowflake role.

operations.name: Get Warehouse
operations.description: Get the full details for a Snowflake virtual warehouse.

operations.name: Resume Warehouse
operations.description: Resume a Snowflake virtual warehouse if it is suspended.

operations.name: Suspend Warehouse
operations.description: Suspend a Snowflake virtual warehouse.

operations.name: Alter Warehouse
operations.description: Resize a Snowflake warehouse or change its auto-suspend and auto-resume settings.

operations.name: List Tasks
operations.description: List tasks in a Snowflake schema.

operations.name: Get Task
operations.description: Describe a Snowflake task.

operations.name: Run Task
operations.description: Run a Snowflake task immediately, optionally retrying its last failed graph.

operations.name: Resume Task
operations.description: Resume a suspended Snowflake task so its schedule runs again.

operations.name: Suspend Task
operations.description: Suspend a Snowflake task so its schedule stops triggering runs.

operations.name: List Task Runs
operations.description: Query up to seven days of Snowflake task history, capped at 10000 rows.

operations.name: Get Task Run
operations.description: Find one task history record by query ID within Snowflake’s seven-day window and 10000 most recent records after optional filters.

operations.name: Cancel Task Query
operations.description: Cancel one running task query by query ID with SYSTEM$CANCEL_QUERY. Task runs already in flight are unaffected and must be cancelled individually; a cancelled child marks the task graph run failed, so downstream tasks are skipped.

operations.name: Get Task Run Output
operations.description: Read a task query result with RESULT_SCAN during Snowflake’s 24-hour retention window using the task owner role.

operations.name: List Query History
operations.description: List queries that completed in the last seven days, optionally filtered.

operations.name: List Copy History
operations.description: List staged-file load results for a table over the last fourteen days.

operations.name: Introspect Schema

integrations.name: Splunk
integrations.description: Run SPL searches and manage saved searches and alerts in Splunk
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud into workflows. Run SPL searches synchronously or as asynchronous jobs, fetch results, dispatch saved searches, and inspect fired alerts and indexes.

operations.name: Run Search
operations.description: Run an SPL search synchronously and return its results in a single call (oneshot mode). A oneshot search buffers the whole result set in one response with no paging, so use it for short searches; for anything large use Create Search Job with Get Search Results, which defaults to 100 rows and pages with offset.

operations.name: Create Search Job
operations.description: Start a Splunk search job and return its search ID (sid). The search runs asynchronously — poll its status and fetch results separately.

operations.name: Get Search Job
operations.description: Get the status and progress of a Splunk search job by search ID, including dispatch state, completion progress, and event/result counts.

operations.name: Get Search Results
operations.description: Fetch the transformed results of a completed Splunk search job by search ID, with pagination.

operations.name: Cancel Search Job
operations.description: Cancel a running Splunk search job and delete its result cache.

operations.name: List Saved Searches
operations.description: List saved searches and reports configured in Splunk, including their SPL, schedule, and alert configuration.

operations.name: Get Saved Search
operations.description: Get the configuration of a single Splunk saved search by name, including its SPL, schedule, and alert settings.

operations.name: Dispatch Saved Search
operations.description: Run a Splunk saved search immediately and return the search ID (sid) of the dispatched job.

operations.name: List Fired Alerts
operations.description: List the saved searches with currently triggered (unexpired) Splunk alerts and how many times each has fired.

operations.name: Get Fired Alerts
operations.description: List the unexpired triggered instances of a Splunk alert by saved search name, including severity, trigger time, and the search ID of each firing.

operations.name: List Indexes
operations.description: List the indexes configured on the Splunk instance with their size, event count, and retention settings.

operations.name: List Apps
operations.description: List the apps installed on the Splunk instance with their label, version, author, and enabled state.

integrations.name: Sportmonks
integrations.description: Access Sportmonks football, motorsport, odds, and reference data
integrations.longDescription: Integrate the Sportmonks sports data APIs into the workflow from a single block. Football: fixtures, livescores, leagues, seasons, stages, rounds, teams, squads, players, coaches, referees, venues, standings, topscorers, transfers, schedules, commentaries, TV stations, rivals, expected goals (xG), and predictions. Motorsport: sessions, drivers, teams, championship standings, laps, and pitstops. Odds: pre-match and in-play odds, bookmakers, and markets. Core: continents, countries, regions, cities, types, and time zones.

integrations.name: Trigger.dev
integrations.description: Trigger tasks and manage runs and schedules
integrations.longDescription: Integrate Trigger.dev into the workflow. Trigger and batch trigger background tasks, retrieve and control runs (cancel, replay, reschedule, tags, metadata, events, traces), manage cron schedules, environment variables, queues, deployments, and waitpoint tokens, and query run data with TRQL.

operations.name: Trigger Task
operations.description: Trigger a Trigger.dev task by its identifier with an optional JSON payload. Returns the ID of the created run.

operations.name: Batch Trigger Task
operations.description: Batch trigger a Trigger.dev task with up to 1,000 payloads. All items in the batch run the same task. Returns the batch ID and the created run IDs.

operations.name: Get Batch
operations.description: Retrieve a Trigger.dev batch by its ID, including its status, run IDs, and success and failure counts.

operations.name: Get Batch Results
operations.description: Retrieve the execution results of every run in a Trigger.dev batch, including outputs and error details.

operations.name: Get Run
operations.description: Retrieve a Trigger.dev run by its ID, including status, payload, output, attempts, and timing details.

operations.name: Get Run Result
operations.description: Retrieve the result of a Trigger.dev run: whether it succeeded, its output, and error details. Lighter than Get Run when only the outcome is needed.

operations.name: Get Run Events
operations.description: Retrieve the log and span events of a Trigger.dev run, including messages, levels, durations, and error events.

operations.name: Get Run Trace
operations.description: Retrieve the OpenTelemetry trace of a Trigger.dev run as a tree of spans with timing, errors, and nested children.

operations.name: List Runs
operations.description: List Trigger.dev runs in the environment of the API key, with optional filters for status, task, version, tags, schedule, and creation time.

operations.name: Cancel Run
operations.description: Cancel an in-progress Trigger.dev run. Has no effect if the run is already completed.

operations.name: Replay Run
operations.description: Replay a Trigger.dev run, creating a new run with the same payload and options as the original.

operations.name: Reschedule Run
operations.description: Reschedule a delayed Trigger.dev run with a new delay. Only valid while the run is in the DELAYED state.

operations.name: Add Run Tags
operations.description: Add tags to an existing Trigger.dev run. Runs can have up to 10 tags.

operations.name: Update Run Metadata
operations.description: Replace the metadata of a Trigger.dev run with a new JSON object.

operations.name: Create Schedule
operations.description: Create an imperative cron schedule that triggers a Trigger.dev task on a recurring basis.

operations.name: Get Schedule
operations.description: Retrieve a Trigger.dev schedule by its ID.

operations.name: List Schedules
operations.description: List Trigger.dev schedules in the project, with page-based pagination.

operations.name: Update Schedule
operations.description: Update an imperative Trigger.dev schedule by its ID, replacing its task, cron expression, timezone, and external ID.

operations.name: Delete Schedule
operations.description: Delete an imperative Trigger.dev schedule by its ID.

operations.name: Activate Schedule
operations.description: Activate an imperative Trigger.dev schedule so it resumes triggering its task.

operations.name: Deactivate Schedule
operations.description: Deactivate an imperative Trigger.dev schedule so it stops triggering its task.

operations.name: List Env Vars
operations.description: List the environment variables of a Trigger.dev project environment. Values are returned in plaintext and will appear in workflow outputs and run history — scope this operation carefully.

operations.name: Create Env Var
operations.description: Create an environment variable in a Trigger.dev project environment.

operations.name: Get Env Var

operations.name: Update Env Var
operations.description: Update the value of an environment variable in a Trigger.dev project environment.

operations.name: Delete Env Var
operations.description: Delete an environment variable from a Trigger.dev project environment.

operations.name: Import Env Vars

operations.name: Get Queue
operations.description: Retrieve a Trigger.dev queue by ID, task identifier, or custom queue name, including its running and queued counts.

operations.name: List Queues
operations.description: List the queues in the environment of the API key, including running and queued counts, with page-based pagination.

operations.name: Pause Queue
operations.description: Pause a Trigger.dev queue so no new runs start. Runs that are currently executing continue to completion.

operations.name: Resume Queue
operations.description: Resume a paused Trigger.dev queue so new runs can start again.

operations.name: Override Queue Concurrency
operations.description: Override the concurrency limit of a Trigger.dev queue with a new value.

operations.name: Reset Queue Concurrency
operations.description: Reset the concurrency limit of a Trigger.dev queue back to its base value, removing any override.

operations.name: List Deployments
operations.description: List Trigger.dev deployments in the environment of the API key, with optional status and creation-time filters.

operations.name: Get Deployment
operations.description: Retrieve a Trigger.dev deployment by its ID, including its status, version, and registered tasks.

operations.name: Get Latest Deployment
operations.description: Retrieve the latest Trigger.dev deployment in the environment of the API key.

operations.name: Promote Deployment
operations.description: Promote a Trigger.dev deployment version so new runs execute on it (e.g., to roll back to a previous version).

operations.name: Execute Query
operations.description: Execute a TRQL (SQL-like) query against Trigger.dev run data for reporting and analytics.

operations.name: Get Query Schema

operations.name: Create Waitpoint Token

operations.name: Complete Waitpoint Token

operations.name: Get Waitpoint Token
operations.description: Retrieve a Trigger.dev waitpoint token by its ID, including its status, timeout, and completion data.

operations.name: List Waitpoint Tokens

operations.name: List Timezones
operations.description: List the IANA timezones supported by Trigger.dev schedules, for use as the timezone of a cron schedule.

integrations.name: Upstash
integrations.description: Serverless Redis with Upstash
integrations.longDescription: Connect to Upstash Redis to perform key-value, hash, list, and utility operations via the REST API.

operations.name: Get
operations.description: Get the value of a key from Upstash Redis.

operations.name: Set
operations.description: Set the value of a key in Upstash Redis with an optional expiration time in seconds.

operations.name: Delete
operations.description: Delete a key from Upstash Redis.

operations.name: List Keys
operations.description: List keys matching a pattern in Upstash Redis. Defaults to listing all keys (*).

operations.name: HSET
operations.description: Set a field in a hash stored at a key in Upstash Redis.

operations.name: HGET
operations.description: Get the value of a field in a hash stored at a key in Upstash Redis.

operations.name: HGETALL
operations.description: Get all fields and values of a hash stored at a key in Upstash Redis.

operations.name: INCR
operations.description: Atomically increment the integer value of a key by one in Upstash Redis. If the key does not exist, it is set to 0 before incrementing.

operations.name: INCRBY
operations.description: Increment the integer value of a key by a given amount. Use a negative value to decrement. If the key does not exist, it is set to 0 before the operation.

operations.name: EXISTS
operations.description: Check if a key exists in Upstash Redis. Returns true if the key exists, false otherwise.

operations.name: SETNX
operations.description: Set the value of a key only if it does not already exist. Returns true if the key was set, false if it already existed.

operations.name: LPUSH
operations.description: Prepend a value to the beginning of a list in Upstash Redis. Creates the list if it does not exist.

operations.name: LRANGE
operations.description: Get a range of elements from a list in Upstash Redis. Use 0 and -1 for start and stop to get all elements.

operations.name: EXPIRE
operations.description: Set a timeout on a key in Upstash Redis. After the timeout, the key is deleted.

operations.name: TTL
operations.description: Get the remaining time to live of a key in Upstash Redis. Returns -1 if the key has no expiration, -2 if the key does not exist.

operations.name: Command
operations.description: Execute an arbitrary Redis command against Upstash Redis. Pass the full command as a JSON array (e.g., ["HSET", "myhash", "field1", "value1"]).
